各位.en: Dear classmates, today we are going to discuss this issue.

各位.en: Thanks to everyone's support, we were able to succeed.

各位.en: Finally, I would like to remind everyone to pay attention to safety.

原来.en: So that's how it is; I understand.

原来.en: I originally thought it was hard, but it's actually very easy.

原来.en: No wonder he's so happy; it turns out he got first place in the exam.

约.en: We made an appointment to meet tomorrow at 3 PM.

约.en: There are about ten people, and we can start once we've confirmed.

约.en: He invited me to see a movie this weekend, but I haven't agreed yet.

约.en: Let's set a time to have a good chat, what do you think?

光.en: Turn off the light; the moonlight is enough.

光.en: He only talks and never takes action; people don't trust him much.

光.en: The light in the room is too dim; it's hard to see things.

光.en: Don't just focus on your phone; pay attention when eating.

光.en: He walked barefoot on the floor, looking very relaxed.

法律.en: Everyone is equal before the law.

法律.zh: 他因为不懂法律，吃了不少亏。
法律.en: He suffered a lot because he didn't understand the law.

法律.en: We must abide by the law and not do anything illegal.

法律.en: Although the law has regulations, there are still many difficulties in actual implementation.

父亲.en: My father is a very strict person.

父亲.en: On Father's Day, I wrote a letter to my dad.

父亲.en: When I was a child, my father often took me to the park to fly kites.

父亲.zh: 虽然父亲话不多，但他一直默默支持着我。
父亲.en: Although my father doesn't talk much, he has always silently supported me.

父亲.en: My father is a doctor, very busy at work, but every time he comes home he plays with me.

并且.zh: 他会说英语，并且还会法语。
并且.en: He can speak English, and also French.

并且.en: She is not only smart but also very hardworking.

并且.en: I bought some fruit, and also brought some snacks.

并且.en: He not only completed the task, but did it exceptionally well.

社会.zh: 我们应该多关注社会问题。
社会.en: We should pay more attention to social issues.

社会.zh: 现在的社会竞争越来越激烈了。
社会.en: Competition in today's society is increasingly fierce.

社会.zh: 一个人要适应社会，才能生活得更好。
社会.en: A person must adapt to society in order to live better.

社会.en: The online society makes it easier to get information, but we also need to be careful about fake news.

项.en: This project takes three months to complete.

项.en: He signed up for the marathon event.

项.en: Our company recently launched a new plan.

项.en: The results of this research are very helpful to medicine.

证明.zh: 我们需要一份医院开的健康证明。

证明.en: He proved his ability through his own actions.

证明.en: Although there isn't much evidence, this statement is enough to prove his innocence.

记者.en: She is a sports journalist who often covers football matches.

记者.en: Many journalists are waiting in the press room to ask questions.

记者.zh: 记者要如实报道新闻，不能编造假消息。
记者.en: Journalists must report news truthfully and not fabricate false information.

记者.en: That journalist went to many dangerous places in order to investigate the truth.

底.en: What exactly do you want to say? Just be direct.

底.en: She wore a skirt with a white background and red flowers.

底.en: I have completely figured out this matter, and finally feel confident.

底.en: He's a reliable person; I feel at ease cooperating with him and have confidence.

表示.en: She smiled and said she was very satisfied.

不管.en: No matter how hard it is, I have to try.

不管.en: No matter the weather, we are going.

不管.zh: 他不管别人怎么说，坚持自己的想法。
不管.en: No matter what others say, he sticks to his own ideas.

不管.zh: 不管结果如何，尽力就好。
不管.en: No matter what the result is, just do your best.

谈.en: I want to talk to you about this matter.

谈.en: After talking for three hours, there's still no result.

谈.en: After discussing work, they chatted about life.

This matter requires at least three days.
You should at least make a phone call.

至少.en: Although tired, at least we learned something.
At least give me a chance.

解释.en: He explained for a long time, but I still didn't understand.

解释.en: You must explain clearly why you were late.

解释.en: He explained many times, but I still don't understand.

负责.zh: 你要对自己的行为负责。
负责.en: You must be responsible for your own actions.
This project is taken care of by Xiao Li.

负责.en: As parents, we are responsible for our children's education.

首先.en: First, we need to collect data.

理解.en: After the explanation, he finally understood.

理解.en: Although it's not easy, I hope everyone can understand.

父母.en: Parents always worry about me, and I'm very grateful.

父母.zh: 他父母住在乡下，很少进城。
父母.en: His parents live in the countryside and rarely go to the city.

父母.zh: 虽然父母反对，但他还是坚持了自己的选择。
父母.en: Although his parents opposed it, he still insisted on his own choice.

父母.en: My parents taught me from a young age to be honest in life.

城.en: Once you leave the city, there's farmland with fresh air.

城.zh: 他在城里找了份新工作，下个月搬家。
城.en: He found a new job in the city and will move next month.

城.zh: 这个城虽然不大，但生活很方便。
城.en: This city isn't big, but life is very convenient.

之一.en: Beijing is one of the ancient cities.

之一.en: This is one of my favorite movies.

之一.en: He is one of the best students in our class.

最终.en: We finally decided not to go on the trip.

最终.en: After many discussions, they finally reached an agreement.

最终.zh: 不管多累，最终都要坚持到底。
最终.en: No matter how tired you are, you must persevere until the end.

安排.en: What plans do you have for this weekend?

安排.en: The company arranged for him to go on a business trip to Shanghai next month.

安排.zh: 时间安排得很紧，我们得快一点。
安排.en: The schedule is very tight; we need to hurry up.

敢.en: I dare not walk alone at night.

敢.zh: 他敢在老板面前提意见，真勇敢。

敢.en: As long as you dare to try, there's a chance to succeed.

梦.en: I keep dreaming that I'm flying, and it feels very free.

如果你不满意，可以重新选择。
重新.en: If you're not satisfied, you can choose again.

重新.en: After the malfunction, the system needs to be restarted.

提.en: He raised a very strange question.

提.en: I was just about to mention this, and you said it.

人生.en: His life experience is very rich.

人生.en: No matter what difficulties you encounter, there is always hope in life.

人生.en: Life is like a journey; what matters is not the destination but the scenery along the way.

幸福.en: Being with my family makes me feel very happy.

幸福.en: Happiness is actually very simple, just doing what you like.

幸福.en: She smiles so happily, there must be good news.

自然.en: Don't be nervous, just be natural.

自然.zh: 如果你不想去，就自然地说出来。
自然.en: If you don't want to go, just say it naturally.

自然.zh: 这里的风景很自然，没有人工修饰。
自然.en: The scenery here is very natural, without artificial decoration.

自然.zh: 我们要保护自然，不要乱扔垃圾。
自然.en: We need to protect nature, don't litter.

责任.zh: 作为父母，教育孩子是我们的责任。
责任.en: As parents, educating children is our responsibility.

责任.en: Since you agreed, you must take responsibility.

责任.en: He didn't fulfill his responsibility, so he was fired.

责任.en: Everyone has the responsibility to protect the environment.

失去.en: Only after losing health do you realize its importance.

失去.zh: 如果失去了机会，就很难再得到了。
失去.en: If you lose the opportunity, it's hard to get it again.

失去.zh: 他失去了工作，心情很不好。
失去.en: He lost his job, and his mood is bad.

低.en: Because the temperature is too low, the river froze.

低.en: This cup has low quality, it broke when dropped.

低.en: Looking down at your phone is bad for your neck.

作用.en: He played a very important role in the team.

作用.en: Because this method had little effect, we switched to a new plan.

作用.en: Don't underestimate this small thing, its effect is great.

说明.en: Because time is limited, I'll just briefly explain a few points.

许多.en: Many of my friends went to work in Shanghai.

许多.en: Although I made many efforts, I still failed.

许多.en: There are many fresh fruits in the supermarket.

许多.en: He has read many books, so he knows many stories.

同样.en: These two clothes are equally nice in color.

同样.zh: 虽然方法不同，但效果同样好。
同样.en: Although the methods differ, the effect is equally good.

步.en: He ran a few steps and got tired, so he stopped to rest.

面对.en: Facing so many audience members, she was a bit nervous.

压力.en: Because of exam pressure, she lost a lot of weight.
You need to learn to relieve pressure.

压力.zh: 经济上的压力让他不得不加班赚钱。
压力.en: Financial pressure forced him to work overtime to earn money.

由于.en: Due to rain, the game was cancelled.

由于.zh: 由于他迟到，我们等了很久。
由于.en: Because he was late, we waited a long time.

由于.zh: 由于时间不够，我们只参观了两个景点。
由于.en: Due to insufficient time, we only visited two scenic spots.

由于.zh: 由于生病，他没能来上班。
由于.en: Due to illness, he couldn't come to work.

由于.zh: 由于天气原因，航班延误了两个小时。
由于.en: Due to weather conditions, the flight was delayed by two hours.

母亲.zh: 母亲节那天，我给母亲买了一份礼物。
母亲.en: On Mother's Day, I bought a gift for my mother.

母亲.zh: 虽然母亲工作很忙，但她总是陪我做作业。
母亲.en: Although my mother is busy with work, she always accompanies me doing homework.

母亲.zh: 每次回家，母亲都会做我最爱吃的菜。
母亲.en: Every time I go home, my mother cooks my favorite dishes.

再次.zh: 他再次提醒我不要忘记带钥匙。
再次.en: He reminded me again not to forget the keys.

再次.zh: 如果再次失败，我就放弃了。
再次.en: If I fail again, I'll give up.

再次.zh: 我再次确认一下，明天的会议是九点吗？
再次.en: Let me confirm again, is tomorrow's meeting at nine?

部门.en: Which department does he work in?

部门.zh: 这个部门负责市场推广。
部门.en: This department is responsible for marketing.

部门.zh: 由于部门调整，他被调到销售部了。
部门.en: Due to department restructuring, he was transferred to sales.

部门.zh: 每个部门都要提交年度报告。
部门.en: Every department must submit an annual report.

部门.zh: 我们部门最近招了几个新员工。
部门.en: Our department recently hired several new employees.

放弃.en: I won't give up this opportunity.

放弃.zh: 就算很难，他也舍不得放弃。
放弃.en: Even though it's hard, he can't bear to give up.

放弃.zh: 你如果累了，可以放弃，但别后悔。
放弃.en: If you're tired, you can give up, but don't regret it.

放弃.zh: 她放弃了高薪工作，去追求自己的梦想。
放弃.en: She gave up a high-paying job to pursue her dream.

放弃.zh: 教练说，只要不放弃，就有赢的希望。
放弃.en: The coach said, as long as you don't give up, there is hope to win.

意见.zh: 关于这件事，我想听听你的意见。
意见.en: About this matter, I want to hear your opinion.

意见.zh: 大家意见不统一，所以最后没决定。
意见.en: Everyone's opinions were not unified, so in the end no decision was made.

意见.zh: 老板让我收集每个员工的意见再开会。
意见.en: The boss asked me to collect every employee's opinion before the meeting.

意见.zh: 虽然我有不同意见，但我会尊重大家的选择。
意见.en: Although I have a different opinion, I will respect everyone's choice.

过程.zh: 享受过程比结果更重要。
过程.en: Enjoying the process is more important than the result.

过程.zh: 整个学习过程虽然辛苦，但收获很大。
过程.en: The whole learning process, though hard, brought great gains.

过程.zh: 做蛋糕的过程很有趣，你也可以试试。
过程.en: The process of making a cake is quite fun, you can try it too.

过程.zh: 他不光看结果，还特别关注中间的过程。
过程.en: He not only looks at the result, but also pays special attention to the process in between.

即使.en: Even if it rains, I'll go.

即使.zh: 即使他道歉了，我还是有点生气。
即使.en: Even though he apologized, I'm still a little angry.

即使.zh: 即使你不说，我也知道你在想什么。
即使.en: Even if you don't say it, I know what you're thinking.

即使.zh: 这件事即使再难，我也要把它做完。
即使.en: Even if this matter is very difficult, I still have to finish it.

即使.zh: 即使所有人都不支持我，我也要坚持下去。
即使.en: Even if no one supports me, I will persist.

尽管.zh: 尽管很累，他还是坚持跑完了。
尽管.en: Despite being very tired, he still insisted on finishing the run.

尽管.zh: 尽管天气不好，公园里还是有很多人。
尽管.en: Despite the bad weather, there were still many people in the park.

尽管.zh: 你尽管放心，这件事我会处理好的。
尽管.en: You can rest assured, I will handle this matter well.

尽管.zh: 尽管他不太会说话，但大家都喜欢跟他相处。
尽管.en: Although he is not very talkative, everyone likes to be with him.

深.en: He has a deep impression of this matter.

深.zh: 这个洞太深了，根本看不到底。
深.en: This hole is too deep, you can't see the bottom at all.

深.zh: 他们俩聊得很深，一直聊到凌晨。
深.en: The two of them had a very deep conversation, talking until the early morning.

深.zh: 虽然颜色浅，但是感情很深。
深.en: Although the color is light, the feelings are deep.

各.en: Each person has their own thoughts.

各.zh: 大家各说各的，根本听不清楚。
各.en: Everyone was talking over each other, couldn't hear clearly at all.

各.zh: 明天各科都要考试，我得好好复习。
各.en: Tomorrow there are exams in each subject, I have to review well.

各.zh: 他们两个各买了各的票，没坐在一起。
各.en: The two of them each bought their own tickets and didn't sit together.

各.zh: 放假了，同学们各回各家，路上注意安全。
各.en: School's out, classmates go back to their respective homes, take care on the way.

仍然.zh: 虽然降价了，我仍然觉得太贵。
仍然.en: Although the price dropped, I still think it's too expensive.

仍然.zh: 过了这么久，她仍然记得那件事。
仍然.en: After such a long time, she still remembers that matter.

仍然.zh: 他试了很多方法，但问题仍然存在。
仍然.en: He tried many methods, but the problem still exists.

仍然.zh: 尽管已经退休，他仍然每天早起锻炼。
仍然.en: Although he has retired, he still gets up early every day to exercise.

而是.zh: 不是我不去，而是没时间。
而是.en: It's not that I don't want to go, it's that I don't have time.

而是.zh: 他生气不是因为输，而是因为不公平。
而是.en: He's angry not because he lost, but because it was unfair.

而是.zh: 重要的不是速度，而是坚持。
而是.en: What's important is not speed, but persistence.

而是.zh: 你不是一个人，而是有很多朋友支持你。
而是.en: You are not alone; rather, you have many friends supporting you.

而是.zh: 她说她不要礼物，而是要你多陪陪她。
而是.en: She said she doesn't want a gift, but wants you to spend more time with her.

秒.en: Wait a moment, just three seconds.

秒.zh: 他跑得很快，一秒就冲出去了。
秒.en: He runs very fast; he dashed out in one second.

秒.zh: 每分每秒都很珍贵，别浪费时间。
秒.en: Every minute and every second is precious, don't waste time.

秒.zh: 倒计时开始了，还有十秒。
秒.en: The countdown has started, there are ten seconds left.

秒.zh: 拍照的时候，她说“别动，一秒就好”。
秒.en: When taking a photo, she said 'Don't move, just one second.'

值得.zh: 虽然贵了点，但我觉得很值得。
值得.en: Although it's a bit expensive, I think it's very worth it.

值得.zh: 为了这个目标，再辛苦也值得。
值得.en: For this goal, no matter how hard it is, it's worth it.

值得.zh: 这趟旅行虽然累，但是非常值得。
值得.en: This trip was tiring, but it was totally worth it.

值得.zh: 你觉得花这么多钱值得吗？
值得.en: Do you think spending so much money is worth it?

王.zh: 小王是我们公司的经理。
王.en: Xiao Wang is the manager of our company.
Aunt Wang's cooking is very delicious.
His surname is Wang, not Li.

经历.zh: 这次经历让我成长了很多。
经历.en: This experience made me grow a lot.

经历.zh: 他经历过失败，但没放弃。
经历.en: He experienced failure but didn't give up.

经历.zh: 你能分享一下你的留学经历吗？
经历.en: Can you share your study abroad experience?

经历.zh: 每个人的人生经历都不一样。

讨论.zh: 大家正在讨论明天的计划。
关于这件事，我们需要好好讨论一下。
讨论.en: Regarding this matter, we need to have a good discussion.

讨论.zh: 他们讨论了很久，还是没有结果。
讨论.en: They discussed for a long time, but still no result.

超过.zh: 这辆车时速超过两百公里。
超过.en: This car's speed exceeds 200 kilometers per hour.

超过.zh: 他的成绩超过了很多同学。

超过.en: Let's talk after we surpass them.
The number has already exceeded expectations.

仍.en: He still refuses to give up.

仍.zh: 虽然很累，但他仍坚持工作。
仍.en: Although very tired, he still insists on working.

仍.zh: 过了这么多年，她仍记得那件事。
仍.en: After so many years, she still remembers that thing.
I still believe he is right.

仍.zh: 尽管失败多次，他仍不灰心。
仍.en: Despite failing many times, he still doesn't lose heart.

假.en: Don't cheat people with fake goods.
What do you plan to do during summer vacation?

加入.en: I want to join you guys.
He joined the student council last year.

加入.zh: 你什么时候加入这个俱乐部的？
加入.en: When did you join this club?
Join us, let's work hard together.

兄弟.en: Bro, can you do me a favor?

地址.en: This address is wrong, delivered incorrectly.
Please tell me the new address.

无论.zh: 无论多忙，我都会给你打电话。
无论.en: No matter how busy I am, I will call you.

无论.zh: 无论你信不信，这是真的。
无论.en: Whether you believe it or not, it's true.

无论.zh: 无论天气怎么样，我们都要去爬山。
无论.en: No matter what the weather is like, we are going hiking.

无论.zh: 无论他说什么，你都别理他。
无论.en: No matter what he says, just ignore him.

无论.zh: 无论你做什么决定，我都支持你。
无论.en: No matter what decision you make, I support you.

改.en: I need to change this plan a bit.

改.zh: 你最好改掉这个坏习惯。
改.en: You'd better get rid of this bad habit.

改.zh: 老师帮我改了作文里的错误。
改.en: The teacher helped me correct the mistakes in my essay.

改.zh: 如果你不改，后果会很严重。
改.en: If you don't change, the consequences will be serious.

改.zh: 这个方案需要再改一改，才能通过。
改.en: This plan needs some more changes before it can be approved.

紧张.en: I was very nervous before the exam.
Don't be nervous, take your time.

紧张.zh: 他一上台就紧张得说不出话。
紧张.en: As soon as he got on stage, he was too nervous to speak.

紧张.zh: 虽然我很紧张，但还是完成了任务。
紧张.en: Although I was very nervous, I still finished the task.

紧张.zh: 最近工作压力大，我总觉得很紧张。
紧张.en: Recently, work pressure has been high, and I always feel tense.

加油.en: Come on! You can do it.
Good luck with your exam, don't stay up late.

加油.zh: 我们在比赛时一直给他加油。
加油.en: We cheered him on during the whole competition.

加油.zh: 不管多累，都要给自己加油打气。
加油.en: No matter how tired you are, you have to encourage yourself.

加油.zh: 加油工作，年底就能拿到奖金了。
加油.en: Work hard, and you'll get the bonus at the end of the year.

省.en: I saved a lot of money.
We need to spend less this month.

省.zh: 为了省钱，我们改坐地铁了。
省.en: To save money, we switched to taking the subway.

省.zh: 省点力气吧，别白费功夫了。
省.en: Save your energy, don't waste your effort.

夜.en: He works late into the night every day.

夜.zh: 白天太热，我们夜里再出去散步。
夜.en: It's too hot during the day, so we'll go for a walk at night.

夜.zh: 这个城市夜景很美，值得一看。
夜.en: The night view of this city is beautiful and worth seeing.

仅.zh: 他仅用了三天就完成了工作。
仅.en: He finished the work in only three days.

仅.zh: 不仅我同意，大家都支持这个计划。
仅.en: Not only do I agree, but everyone supports this plan.

仅.zh: 仅剩的一个名额，你要好好把握。
仅.en: There's only one spot left, you should seize it.

十分.zh: 他对工作十分认真负责。
十分.en: He is very serious and responsible about his work.

十分.zh: 虽然价格贵，但质量十分好。
十分.en: Although the price is high, the quality is very good.

十分.zh: 我十分担心他的身体状况。
十分.en: I am very worried about his health condition.

陪.en: I'll go with you to the hospital.
She accompanies her child to do homework every day.

陪.zh: 周末我陪父母去看电影了。
陪.en: I went to see a movie with my parents on the weekend.

陪.zh: 他生病时，我一直陪在他身边。
陪.en: When he was sick, I stayed by his side the whole time.

挂.en: I hung up on her phone call.
A painting is hanging on the wall.

挂.zh: 别挂心，我会处理好这件事。
挂.en: Don't worry, I'll handle this matter.
He hung his backpack on the chair.

本来.zh: 我本来想去的，但是没时间。
本来.en: I originally wanted to go, but I didn't have time.

本来.zh: 本来今天要下雨，结果出太阳了。
本来.en: It was supposed to rain today, but the sun came out.

本来.zh: 他本来是个老师，后来改行做生意了。
本来.en: He was originally a teacher, but later changed careers to do business.

本来.zh: 你本来可以做得更好的，可惜太粗心了。
本来.en: You could have done better originally, but you were too careless.

本来.zh: 这本来是我的错，我不该怪你。
本来.en: This was originally my fault, I shouldn't have blamed you.

基本.en: The basic problems are all solved.

基本.zh: 你至少要掌握基本的知识。
基本.en: You need to at least master the basic knowledge.

基本.zh: 虽然不完美，但基本上已经合格了。
基本.en: Although not perfect, it's basically qualified already.

基本.zh: 这个方案的基本思路是对的，细节再改改。
基本.en: The basic idea of this plan is correct, just tweak the details.

条件.en: The conditions are not good enough.
I agree to all your conditions.
As long as conditions permit, I'll go.

条件.zh: 这家公司的条件很不错，工资高福利好。
条件.en: This company's conditions are very good, high salary and great benefits.

条件.zh: 他因为身体条件不好，没能参加比赛。
条件.en: He couldn't participate in the competition because of poor physical condition.

晚安.zh: 已经很晚了，快睡吧，晚安。
晚安.en: It's already very late, go to sleep, good night.

晚安.zh: 他发了个消息说晚安，然后就关机了。
晚安.en: He sent a message saying goodnight, and then turned off his phone.

广告.zh: 他们在网上打广告卖东西。
广告.en: They advertise online to sell things.

广告.zh: 这个广告的创意很好，很多人喜欢。
广告.en: The creativity of this ad is great, many people like it.

广告.zh: 因为广告投放得准，销量一下子就上去了。
广告.en: Because the ad targeting was precise, sales went up immediately.

提出.zh: 开会时她提出了一些意见。
提出.en: She put forward some opinions during the meeting.

提出.zh: 老板提出要涨工资，大家都很高兴。
提出.en: The boss proposed a salary raise, and everyone was very happy.

提出.zh: 如果你有更好的方案，可以提出来大家讨论。
提出.en: If you have a better plan, you can propose it for discussion.

警察.en: His dad is a police officer.

警察.zh: 遇到小偷要及时报警找警察。
警察.en: If you encounter a thief, call the police promptly.

警察.zh: 警察正在调查那起交通事故。
警察.en: The police are investigating that traffic accident.

警察.zh: 别怕，有警察在，不会有事的。
警察.en: Don't be afraid, with the police here, nothing will happen.

资料.en: Help me look up the information.

资料.zh: 他收集了很多历史资料。
资料.en: He collected a lot of historical data.

资料.zh: 因为资料不全，我们没法做决定。
资料.en: Because the information is incomplete, we can't make a decision.

关键.en: The key is that you need to prepare first.

关键.zh: 找到问题的关键所在才能解决。
关键.en: Only by finding the key to the problem can it be solved.

关键.zh: 这次考试的关键在于复习方法。
关键.en: The key to this exam lies in the review method.

样子.zh: 你看起来不太高兴的样子。
这件衣服样子不错，就是颜色不好。
样子.en: This piece of clothing looks good, but the color is not right.

样子.zh: 他装出一副很懂的样子，其实什么都不会。
样子.en: He pretends to be knowledgeable, but actually knows nothing.

样子.zh: 看你的样子，好像昨晚没睡好。
样子.en: From the look of you, it seems you didn't sleep well last night.

困难.zh: 虽然遇到很多困难，但我们还是坚持下来了。
困难.en: Although we encountered many difficulties, we still persisted.

困难.zh: 学习中文对我来说不太困难。
困难.en: Learning Chinese is not too difficult for me.

困难.zh: 只要努力，再大的困难也能克服。
困难.en: As long as you work hard, even the biggest difficulties can be overcome.

困难.zh: 他生活上有很多困难，需要帮助。
困难.en: He has many difficulties in life and needs help.

专业.zh: 他是一名非常专业的摄影师。
专业.en: He is a very professional photographer.

专业.zh: 虽然他不是学这个专业的，但做得很好。
专业.en: Although he didn't study this major, he does it well.

专业.zh: 这家公司需要招聘专业人才。
专业.en: This company needs to recruit professional talents.

专业.zh: 我对这个专业很感兴趣。
专业.en: I am very interested in this major.

难道.zh: 这件事难道你一点责任都没有吗？
难道.en: Could it be that you have no responsibility in this matter at all?

难道.zh: 他那么用功，难道考试还会不及格？
难道.en: He works so hard; could it be that he will still fail the exam?

难道.zh: 难道你真的相信他的话？
难道.en: Do you really believe his words?

难道.zh: 难道这就是你给我的答案？
难道.en: Is this the answer you give me?

规定.zh: 学校规定学生不能带手机进教室。
规定.en: The school stipulates that students cannot bring phones into the classroom.

规定.zh: 按照规定，你必须提前三天申请。
规定.en: According to the regulations, you must apply three days in advance.

规定.zh: 这个规定已经很长时间没改了。
规定.en: This regulation hasn't been changed for a long time.
What you did violates the regulation.

于是.en: He was very angry, so he left.

于是.zh: 听到这个消息，她很难过，于是哭了起来。
于是.en: After hearing the news, she was very sad, so she started crying.

于是.zh: 我找不到钥匙，于是打电话给妈妈。
于是.en: I couldn't find the keys, so I called my mom.

于是.zh: 天黑了，于是我们决定回家。
于是.en: It got dark, so we decided to go home.

于是.zh: 他先道歉，于是我也原谅了他。
于是.en: He apologized first, so I forgave him.

产生.zh: 他们之间的误会产生了很大的矛盾。
产生.en: The misunderstanding between them generated a big conflict.

产生.zh: 因为长期缺乏沟通，他们之间产生了隔阂。
产生.en: Because of long-term lack of communication, a gap has developed between them.

产生.zh: 这种药物会产生副作用。
产生.en: This medicine can produce side effects.

产生.zh: 新的技术产生了许多就业机会。
产生.en: New technology has created many job opportunities.

通.zh: 因为道路不通，我们只能绕路。
通.en: Because the road is not open, we have to take a detour.

对方.en: Do you know the other person?

对方.zh: 谈判时，我们要先了解对方的需求。
对方.en: When negotiating, we need to first understand the other party's needs.

对方.zh: 如果你不同意，可以直接告诉对方。
对方.en: If you disagree, you can directly tell the other party.

对方.zh: 打球的时候，我们要注意对方的动作。
对方.en: When playing ball, we need to pay attention to the opponent's moves.

对方.zh: 对方已经同意了我们的条件。
对方.en: The other party has already agreed to our terms.

正确.zh: 做决定之前，要确保信息正确。
正确.en: Before making a decision, ensure the information is correct.

正确.zh: 只要方法正确，结果就不会差。
正确.en: As long as the method is correct, the result won't be bad.

爱情.zh: 他们之间的爱情故事很感人。
爱情.en: The love story between them is very touching.

爱情.zh: 虽然爱情很美好，但也要面对现实。

经济.en: This country's economy is growing fast.

经济.zh: 虽然经济有困难，但我们还是要努力。
经济.en: Although the economy is difficult, we still need to work hard.

经济.zh: 因为经济不好，很多公司都裁员了。
经济.en: Because the economy is bad, many companies laid off people.

经济.zh: 经济发展了，大家的生活也变好了。
经济.en: The economy has developed, and everyone's life has improved.

按照.zh: 按照公司的规定，我们要穿正装。
按照.en: According to company rules, we need to wear formal wear.

按照.zh: 请按照说明书上的步骤来操作。
按照.en: Please operate according to the steps in the manual.

按照.zh: 按照法律，这样做是不可以的。
按照.en: According to the law, this is not allowed.

按照.zh: 如果你按照我的建议，就不会出问题。
按照.en: If you follow my advice, there won't be problems.

女性.zh: 虽然她是女性，但她的能力一点也不差。
女性.en: Although she is female, her ability is not inferior at all.

女性.zh: 现在越来越多的女性开始创业。
女性.en: Now more and more women are starting businesses.

女性.zh: 公司里女性员工的比例越来越高。
女性.en: The proportion of female employees in the company is increasing.

女性.zh: 这位女性是一位非常优秀的医生。
女性.en: This woman is a very excellent doctor.

有效.zh: 虽然这个办法简单，但很有效。
有效.en: Although this method is simple, it is very effective.

有效.zh: 如果你按时吃药，治疗会更有效。
有效.en: If you take medicine on time, the treatment will be more effective.

有效.zh: 他的劝说非常有效，她听了以后就同意了。
有效.en: His persuasion was very effective; after hearing it, she agreed.

重点.zh: 老师告诉我们，考试的重点是语法。
重点.en: The teacher told us that the key point of the exam is grammar.

重点.zh: 你说话要抓住重点，不要绕来绕去。
重点.en: You need to get to the point when speaking, don't beat around the bush.

重点.zh: 这次会议的重点是讨论预算。
重点.en: The focus of this meeting is to discuss the budget.

重点.zh: 虽然内容很多，但重点只有几个。
重点.en: Although there is a lot of content, the key points are only a few.

反对.zh: 很多人反对这个计划，因为它太贵了。
反对.en: Many people oppose this plan because it's too expensive.

反对.zh: 虽然有人反对，但我们还是决定去做。
反对.en: Although some opposed, we still decided to do it.

反对.zh: 他反对这个建议，但是说不出理由。
反对.en: He opposed this suggestion but couldn't give a reason.

竟然.zh: 这么大的事情，他竟然不知道。
竟然.en: Such a big thing, he actually didn't know.

竟然.zh: 我以为他不会来，结果他竟然出现了。
竟然.en: I thought he wouldn't come, but unexpectedly he appeared.

竟然.zh: 考试这么难，他竟然考了满分。
竟然.en: The exam was so difficult, yet he got full marks.

竟然.zh: 我们都以为他会生气，他竟然笑了。
竟然.en: We all thought he would be angry, but he actually laughed.

作品.zh: 他的作品在展览上很受欢迎。
作品.en: His works were very popular at the exhibition.

作品.zh: 这位作家的作品影响了很多人。
作品.en: This writer's works influenced many people.

作品.zh: 虽然他的作品不多，但每一部都很经典。
作品.en: Although his works are not many, each one is a classic.

作品.zh: 这幅作品是他花了三年时间完成的。
作品.en: This piece of work took him three years to complete.

倍.en: His speed is three times mine.

倍.zh: 这个月的收入比上个月多了两倍。
倍.en: This month's income is double that of last month.

倍.zh: 因为效率提高了，产量增加了一倍。
这个数字是原来的四倍。
倍.en: This number is four times the original.

准.zh: 他说的话很准，每次都能预测对。
准.en: What he says is very accurate; he predicts correctly every time.

准.zh: 虽然他的判断不准，但大家还是相信他。
准.en: Although his judgment is not accurate, everyone still trusts him.

准.zh: 这个天气预报一点都不准。
准.en: This weather forecast is not accurate at all.

醒.en: He woke up as early as six in the morning.

醒.zh: 听到声音，我马上就醒了。
醒.en: I woke up immediately when I heard the sound.

醒.zh: 要是你醒了，就给我打个电话。
醒.en: Give me a call if you wake up.

讨厌.zh: 因为太吵了，所以我很讨厌这个地方。
讨厌.en: I hate this place because it's too noisy.

讨厌.zh: 虽然他很讨厌，但我还是得跟他合作。
讨厌.en: Even though he's annoying, I still have to work with him.

输.en: He always loses money playing cards.

输.zh: 要是你输了，就请客吃饭。
输.en: If you lose, treat us to dinner.

输.zh: 虽然我们已经很努力了，最后还是输了。
输.en: Even though we tried hard, we still lost in the end.

要是.en: If it rains, I won't go.
If I had money, I would buy it.

要是.zh: 要是你早点儿告诉我，我就不会迟到了。
要是.en: If you had told me earlier, I wouldn't have been late.

要是.zh: 要是明天有空，我们一起去逛街吧。
要是.en: If we're free tomorrow, let's go shopping together.

要是.zh: 要是他不来，我们就自己开始。
要是.en: If he doesn't come, we'll start on our own.

否则.en: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.
You have to work hard, otherwise you'll fail.

否则.zh: 把门关上，否则蚊子会飞进来。
否则.en: Close the door, otherwise mosquitoes will fly in.

否则.zh: 你要好好复习，否则考试过不了。
否则.en: You need to study well, otherwise you won't pass the exam.
Remember to bring an umbrella, otherwise you'll get wet.

免费.en: There's free tasting at the supermarket today.

免费.zh: 如果注册会员，就可以免费看电影。
免费.en: If you sign up as a member, you can watch movies for free.

免费.zh: 这个软件虽然是免费的，但功能很强。
免费.en: Although this software is free, it's very powerful.

牌.en: He likes playing poker the most.

牌.zh: 因为打牌输了，他心情不好。
牌.en: He's in a bad mood because he lost at cards.

牌.zh: 我们公司牌子上写着“欢迎光临”。

动作.en: His dance moves are very graceful.

动作.zh: 教练教我们一个新的动作。
动作.en: The coach taught us a new move.

动作.zh: 要是你动作慢，就赶不上车了。
动作.en: If you're slow, you'll miss the bus.

不够.en: With only three people, we don't have enough hands.

不够.zh: 因为钱不够，所以没买那个包。
不够.en: I didn't buy that bag because I didn't have enough money.

不够.zh: 你的理由不够充分，我不能同意。
不够.en: Your reasons aren't sufficient enough, so I can't agree.

俩.en: The two of us will go.

俩.zh: 要是你们俩都不去，那只好我一个人去了。
俩.en: If neither of you two goes, then I'll have to go alone.

增加.zh: 因为下雨，我们增加了室内活动。
增加.en: Because of rain, we increased indoor activities.

增加.zh: 每天运动能增加你的体力。
增加.en: Exercising daily can increase your stamina.

增加.zh: 最近游客数量明显增加了。
增加.en: Recently the number of tourists has increased significantly.

增加.zh: 除了吃饭，我还想增加一些水果。
增加.en: Besides meals, I also want to add some fruit.

举行.en: The wedding will be held tomorrow.

举行.zh: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
举行.en: The school holds a sports meet every year.

举行.zh: 为了庆祝节日，我们举行了一场晚会。
举行.en: To celebrate the holiday, we held a party.

举行.zh: 虽然下雨了，但比赛还是按计划举行。
举行.en: Although it rained, the competition was still held as planned.

想法.zh: 他跟我谈了他的新想法，我觉得不错。
想法.en: He talked to me about his new idea, I think it's good.

想法.zh: 经过讨论，大家的想法变得一致了。
想法.en: After discussion, everyone's ideas became consistent.

落.en: Leaves fell all over the ground.

落.zh: 雨停了，花瓣落在地上很漂亮。
落.en: The rain stopped, petals fell on the ground beautifully.

落.zh: 因为风太大，帽子落进了水里。
落.en: Because the wind was too strong, the hat fell into the water.

著名.en: This city is famous for its food.

著名.zh: 北京有很多著名的景点，比如故宫。
著名.en: Beijing has many famous attractions, like the Forbidden City.

著名.zh: 那位著名歌手要来开演唱会。
著名.en: That famous singer is coming to hold a concert.

著名.zh: 虽然他很著名，但他还是很谦虚。
著名.en: Although he is very famous, he is still modest.

拒绝.zh: 他拒绝帮忙，因为那天他很忙。
拒绝.en: He refused to help because he was very busy that day.
I refuse to answer this question.

拒绝.zh: 虽然我很想去，但我还是拒绝了。
拒绝.en: Although I really wanted to go, I still refused.

梦想.en: My dream is to be a doctor.

梦想.zh: 他从小就有环游世界的梦想。
梦想.en: He has had a dream of traveling the world since childhood.

梦想.zh: 经过努力，她终于实现了自己的梦想。
梦想.en: Through hard work, she finally realized her dream.

梦想.zh: 不管遇到什么困难，我都不想放弃梦想。
梦想.en: No matter what difficulties I encounter, I don't want to give up my dreams.

帅.en: You look handsome in this outfit.

帅.zh: 那个演员不仅演技好，长得也帅。
帅.en: That actor not only has good acting skills, but also looks handsome.
What's the use of being handsome?

帅.zh: 我朋友都说我哥哥特别帅。
帅.en: My friends all say my brother is especially handsome.

受伤.zh: 打篮球的时候他受伤了。
受伤.en: He got hurt while playing basketball.

受伤.zh: 因为不小心摔倒了，她的膝盖受伤了。
受伤.en: Because she accidentally fell, her knee was injured.

受伤.zh: 虽然受伤了，但他还是坚持完成了比赛。
受伤.en: Although injured, he still insisted on finishing the competition.

不仅.en: He is not only smart but also hardworking.

不仅.zh: 不仅我喜欢，我朋友也喜欢。
不仅.en: Not only do I like it, but my friend also likes it.

不仅.zh: 这次旅行不仅好玩，而且很便宜。
不仅.en: This trip is not only fun but also very cheap.
This is not only a problem.

不仅.zh: 她不仅会唱歌，还会画画和跳舞。
不仅.en: She can not only sing but also paint and dance.

期.zh: 下个学期我打算选一门美术课。
期.en: Next semester I plan to take an art class.

期.zh: 这个项目的工期很短，我们要抓紧时间。
期.en: The construction period for this project is very short, we need to hurry.
Are you looking forward to this trip?

期.zh: 合同到期了，我们需要续签。
期.en: The contract has expired, we need to renew it.

期.zh: 虽然天气不好，但我们还是按期完成了任务。
期.en: Although the weather was bad, we still completed the task on schedule.

姑娘.zh: 隔壁家的姑娘考上大学了，大家都为她高兴。
姑娘.en: The girl next door got into university, everyone is happy for her.

姑娘.zh: 姑娘，请问这附近有地铁站吗？
姑娘.en: Miss, is there a subway station nearby?

姑娘.zh: 她是个很善良的姑娘，总爱帮助别人。
姑娘.en: She is a very kind girl, always willing to help others.

姑娘.zh: 这位姑娘不但长得漂亮，而且特别有才华。
姑娘.en: This young lady is not only beautiful but also very talented.

顺利.en: I hope your surgery goes smoothly.

顺利.zh: 这次面试不太顺利，我有点紧张。
顺利.en: This interview wasn't very smooth; I was a bit nervous.

顺利.zh: 虽然路上堵车，但我们还是顺利到达了机场。
顺利.en: Although there was a traffic jam, we still arrived at the airport smoothly.

顺利.zh: 只要准备充分，事情就会顺利很多。
顺利.en: As long as you prepare well, things will go much more smoothly.

艺术.zh: 这个城市有很多艺术展览。
艺术.en: This city has many art exhibitions.

艺术.zh: 说话也是一门艺术，要学会好好表达。
艺术.en: Speaking is also an art; you need to learn to express yourself well.

艺术.zh: 我虽然不太懂艺术，但我觉得这幅画很美。
艺术.en: Although I don't know much about art, I think this painting is beautiful.

艺术.zh: 他把生活过成了一种艺术，每天都很精致。
艺术.en: He turned life into an art form, living elegantly every day.

麻烦.zh: 这件事太麻烦了，我不想做。
麻烦.en: This is too troublesome; I don't want to do it.

麻烦.zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？会不会太麻烦你？
麻烦.en: Can you do me a favor? Will it be too much trouble for you?

麻烦.zh: 如果遇到麻烦，一定要及时告诉我们。
麻烦.en: If you run into trouble, be sure to let us know in time.

麻烦.zh: 麻烦你等一下，我马上就好。
麻烦.en: Please wait a moment, I'll be right with you.

美好.zh: 今天天气真好，心情很美好。
美好.en: The weather is great today; I feel wonderful.

美好.zh: 祝你有一个美好的未来。
回忆过去的美好时光，总是让人感到温暖。
美好.en: Remembering the good times in the past always makes people feel warm.

美好.zh: 只要努力，生活一定会变得更美好。
美好.en: As long as you work hard, life will definitely become better.

美好.zh: 这个小镇虽然不大，但处处都是美好的风景。
美好.en: Although this small town is not big, there are beautiful scenery everywhere.

申请.zh: 你要提前申请签证，不然来不及。
申请.en: You need to apply for the visa in advance, otherwise it will be too late.

申请.zh: 他的留学申请被批准了。
申请.en: His study abroad application was approved.

申请.zh: 申请这个奖学金需要提交很多材料。
申请.en: Applying for this scholarship requires submitting a lot of materials.

申请.zh: 如果你对这个职位感兴趣，请尽快提交申请。
申请.en: If you are interested in this position, please submit your application as soon as possible.

各种.en: There are all kinds of fruits in the supermarket.
He likes to collect all kinds of stamps.

各种.zh: 网上有各种学习资源，你可以自己找。
各种.en: There are all kinds of learning resources online; you can find them yourself.

各种.zh: 为了健康，我们要吃各种不同的蔬菜。
各种.en: For health, we should eat various kinds of vegetables.

各种.zh: 这个商店卖的东西很全，各种日用品的都有。
各种.en: This store sells a wide range of items, including all kinds of daily necessities.

演出.zh: 她第一次上台演出，有点紧张。
演出.en: It was her first time performing on stage, and she was a bit nervous.

演出.zh: 演出结束后，观众们热烈鼓掌。
演出.en: After the performance ended, the audience applauded warmly.

演出.zh: 这场演出因为疫情推迟到了下个月。
演出.en: This performance has been postponed to next month due to the pandemic.

演出.zh: 我买了两张票，你要不要一起去看演出？
演出.en: I bought two tickets; do you want to go see the performance together?

竞争.en: The job competition is very fierce now.

竞争.zh: 这两家公司一直在竞争同一个市场。
竞争.en: These two companies have been competing for the same market.

竞争.zh: 竞争虽然残酷，但也能让人进步。
竞争.en: Although competition is harsh, it can also make people improve.

竞争.zh: 我们要在竞争中保持冷静，才能做出正确的决定。
竞争.en: We need to stay calm in competition to make the right decisions.

竞争.zh: 这次比赛有二十个选手参加，竞争非常大。
竞争.en: There are twenty contestants in this competition, so the competition is very intense.

估计.en: I guess it will rain today.

估计.zh: 他估计这次考试能考九十分以上。
估计.en: He estimates he can get over 90 on this exam.

估计.zh: 虽然我没看到，但我估计他应该已经走了。
估计.en: Although I didn't see, I guess he should have left already.
How much do you estimate this bag costs?

估计.zh: 他们估计明年房价会降一点。
估计.en: They estimate house prices will drop a bit next year.

失败.zh: 虽然我失败了，但我不会放弃努力。
失败.en: Although I failed, I won't give up trying.

失败.zh: 因为准备不足，所以比赛失败了。
失败.en: Because of insufficient preparation, the competition failed.
Failure is the mother of success.

失败.zh: 他不想再经历一次失败。
失败.en: He doesn't want to experience another failure.

世纪.zh: 这个建筑已经有几个世纪的历史了。
世纪.en: This building has a history of several centuries.

世纪.zh: 虽然我们生活在不同世纪，但思想很相似。
世纪.en: Although we live in different centuries, our thoughts are similar.

世纪.zh: 二十世纪发生了很多大事。
世纪.en: Many major events happened in the 20th century.

世纪.zh: 这个世纪初科技发展很快。
世纪.en: Technology developed very fast at the beginning of this century.

证.en: Did you get your certificate ready?

证.zh: 没有证就不能参加考试。
证.en: Without a certificate, you cannot take the exam.

证.zh: 因为我的证丢了，所以进不去。
证.en: Because I lost my certificate, I can't get in.
This certificate is fake, don't believe it.

证.zh: 他花了很多钱买这个证。
证.en: He spent a lot of money to buy this certificate.

不得不.zh: 因为下雨，我们不得不取消计划。
不得不.en: Because of rain, we have to cancel the plan.

不得不.zh: 虽然我不想去，但是我不得不去。
不得不.en: Although I don't want to go, I have to go.

不得不.zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。
不得不.en: He had to admit he was wrong.

不得不.zh: 由于时间不够，我们不得不加快速度。
不得不.en: Due to lack of time, we have to speed up.

取得.zh: 经过努力，她取得了很好的成绩。
取得.en: After hard work, she achieved very good results.

取得.zh: 如果取得同意，我们就可以开始。
取得.en: If we obtain consent, we can start.

取得.zh: 这个项目取得了很大进展。
取得.en: This project has made great progress.

取得.zh: 他通过考试取得了证书。
取得.en: He passed the exam and obtained a certificate.

允许.zh: 老师允许我们提前十分钟下课。
允许.en: The teacher allowed us to leave class ten minutes early.

允许.zh: 只要家长允许，我们就可以去。
允许.en: As long as parents allow, we can go.

允许.zh: 这件事不允许任何人知道。
允许.en: This matter is not allowed to be known by anyone.
Do you allow me to bring friends?

教授.zh: 这位教授教我们现代文学。
教授.en: This professor teaches us modern literature.

教授.zh: 虽然教授很严格，但是我们都很喜欢他。
教授.en: Although the professor is very strict, we all like him very much.

教授.zh: 我下周要跟教授讨论论文。
教授.en: I will discuss my thesis with the professor next week.

教授.zh: 教授昨天给了一个讲座。
教授.en: The professor gave a lecture yesterday.

演.en: He has acted in many TV dramas.

演.zh: 虽然演得不错，但剧情有点无聊。
演.en: Although the acting was good, the plot was a bit boring.
This role is difficult to play.

错过.zh: 因为堵车，我错过了会议。
错过.en: Because of traffic jam, I missed the meeting.

错过.zh: 如果你早点来，就不会错过开场。
错过.en: If you came earlier, you wouldn't miss the opening.

错过.zh: 他错过了最后一班公交车。

顿.zh: 我们晚上吃了一顿火锅。
顿.en: We ate a hotpot meal tonight.

顿.zh: 他说话顿了一下，然后继续。
顿.en: He paused in his speech, then continued.

顿.zh: 这顿饭吃得真痛快，一顿顶三顿。
顿.en: This meal was so satisfying, one meal equals three.

顿.zh: 每天一顿水果对身体好。
顿.en: Eating fruit once a day is good for health.

顿.zh: 他累得一顿饭都没吃完就睡着了。
顿.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep before finishing a meal.

吸引.zh: 她的笑容吸引了很多人的目光。
吸引.en: Her smile attracted many people's gazes.

吸引.zh: 这本书的封面吸引了我。
吸引.en: The cover of this book attracted me.

吸引.zh: 因为他唱歌好听，吸引了不少粉丝。
吸引.en: Because he sings well, he attracted many fans.

吸引.zh: 这家店的香味从老远就吸引顾客过来。
吸引.en: The fragrance of this shop attracts customers from far away.

之中.en: Who is the smartest among them?

之中.zh: 在这次比赛之中，虽然他年纪最小，但表现最好。
之中.en: In this competition, although he is the youngest, he performed the best.

之中.zh: 朋友之中，只有他喜欢爬山，所以常约我一起去。
之中.en: Among friends, only he likes hiking, so he often invites me to go together.

之中.zh: 在众多选项之中，我选择了最便宜的那个。
之中.en: Among many options, I chose the cheapest one.

之中.zh: 人群之中，我一眼就看见了她。
之中.en: In the crowd, I saw her at a glance.

背.zh: 他背上的伤疤是小时候摔的，所以一直很在意。
背.en: The scar on his back is from a fall when he was little, so he has always been self-conscious about it.
She carried a big bag on her back.

背.zh: 你一直背对着我，我根本看不见你的表情。
背.en: You have been facing away from me, I can't see your expression at all.

共同.zh: 我们共同承担了这项工作的责任。
共同.en: We jointly took on the responsibility for this work.

共同.zh: 这件事需要大家共同努力。
共同.en: This matter requires everyone's joint effort.

共同.zh: 共同的目标让我们走到一起。
既然是共同的决定，我就支持。
共同.en: Since it's a joint decision, I support it.

一生.zh: 既然是一生难得的机会，就要好好把握。
一生.en: Since it's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, you should seize it.

一生.zh: 我一生最大的愿望就是环游世界。
一生.en: My biggest wish in life is to travel around the world.

一生.zh: 他一生都在研究这个课题。
一生.en: He spent his whole life researching this topic.

一生.zh: 父母为子女操劳了一生，却从不抱怨。
一生.en: Parents toil for their children all their lives, but never complain.

杂志.en: This magazine comes out every month.

杂志.zh: 他在杂志上看到一篇好文章。
杂志.en: He saw a good article in a magazine.
Where did you put the magazine?

杂志.zh: 虽然我不常买杂志，但偶尔会翻一翻。
杂志.en: Although I don't often buy magazines, I occasionally flip through them.

既然.zh: 既然你来了，就一起吃饭吧。
既然.en: Since you're here, let's eat together.
Since that's the case, forget it.

既然.zh: 既然决定要做，就努力做好。
既然.en: Since we've decided to do it, let's work hard to do it well.

既然.zh: 既然大家都同意，那就这样吧。
既然.en: Since everyone agrees, then it's settled.

既然.zh: 既然你已经知道了，我就不多说了。
既然.en: Since you already know, I won't say more.

货.en: This batch of goods is good quality.
He went to restock goods yesterday.

货.zh: 我们店的货一直很受欢迎，所以总是卖得快。
货.en: Our store's goods are always popular, so they sell quickly.

货.zh: 这家店的货比别家便宜。
货.en: This store's goods are cheaper than others.

货.zh: 买之前要检查一下货有没有问题。
货.en: Before buying, you should check if the goods have any issues.

停止.zh: 机器突然停止了运转，大家都吓了一跳。
停止.en: The machine suddenly stopped running, and everyone was startled.

停止.zh: 因为天气原因，比赛停止了。
停止.en: Because of weather, the game stopped.

停止.zh: 公司决定停止这个项目。
停止.en: The company decided to stop this project.

提醒.en: He reminded me that there's a meeting tomorrow.

提醒.zh: 虽然你提醒了，但我还是忘了。
提醒.en: Although you reminded me, I still forgot.

提醒.zh: 妈妈经常提醒我多喝热水。
提醒.en: Mom often reminds me to drink more hot water.

提醒.zh: 老师提醒大家注意安全。
提醒.en: The teacher reminded everyone to pay attention to safety.

演员.zh: 那个演员演过很多有名的电影。
演员.en: That actor has acted in many famous movies.

演员.zh: 虽然他是演员，但一直很低调。
演员.en: Although he is an actor, he has always been low-key.

演员.zh: 我最喜欢的演员是周星驰。
演员.en: My favorite actor is Stephen Chow.

演员.zh: 演员需要花时间背很多台词。
演员.en: Actors need to spend time memorizing a lot of lines.

态度.zh: 他对工作态度非常认真，大家都喜欢他。
态度.en: He has a very serious attitude towards work, and everyone likes him.

态度.zh: 不管别人怎么说，我态度不变。
态度.en: No matter what others say, my attitude won't change.

态度.zh: 她对人态度很友好，大家都很喜欢她。
态度.en: She has a very friendly attitude towards people, and everyone likes her.

态度.zh: 不管遇到什么困难，我们都应该保持积极的态度。
态度.en: No matter what difficulties we encounter, we should maintain a positive attitude.

周围.en: See if there are people around.

周围.zh: 我周围的邻居都很热情。
周围.en: The neighbors around me are all very warm.

周围.zh: 因为周围太吵，我听不清。
周围.en: Because it's too noisy around, I can't hear clearly.
Pay attention to changes in the surrounding environment.

周围.zh: 他看了看周围的情况，决定留下来。
周围.en: He looked at the situation around and decided to stay.

小组.zh: 如果小组合作，效率会更高。
小组.en: If the group cooperates, efficiency will be higher.
She is the leader of our group.

小组.zh: 小组讨论的时候，大家都很积极。
小组.en: During the group discussion, everyone was very active.

复杂.zh: 人际关系有时候确实很复杂。
复杂.en: Interpersonal relationships are indeed sometimes very complex.

复杂.zh: 虽然情况复杂，但我们有办法解决。
复杂.en: Although the situation is complex, we have a way to solve it.

复杂.zh: 这个机器的操作流程很复杂。
复杂.en: The operation process of this machine is very complex.

复杂.zh: 别把事情想得太复杂，其实很简单。
复杂.en: Don't think things too complex; actually it's very simple.

幅.en: This is really a good painting.
There is a landscape painting hanging on the wall.

幅.zh: 他送我一幅画，我很喜欢。
幅.en: He gave me a painting, and I like it very much.
This piece of calligraphy is beautifully written.

幅.zh: 她收藏了一幅名画，价值很高。
幅.en: She collected a famous painting of high value.

数字.zh: 数字技术发展得越来越快。
数字.en: Digital technology is developing faster and faster.

数字.zh: 因为数字太大，我算错了。
数字.en: Because the number was too big, I miscalculated.

数字.zh: 数字游戏很有意思，可以锻炼大脑。
数字.en: Number games are very interesting and can exercise the brain.

数字.zh: 他用数字记录每天的开销。
数字.en: He uses numbers to record daily expenses.

压.en: He pressed the book under the table.

压.zh: 因为东西太多，箱子被压坏了。
压.en: Because there were too many things, the box was crushed.

压.zh: 这座桥能压住多少重量？
压.en: How much weight can this bridge bear?

压.zh: 她用手压住伤口，不让血流出来。
压.en: She pressed the wound with her hand to stop the blood from flowing.

邀请.zh: 他邀请我去参加他的婚礼。
邀请.en: He invited me to attend his wedding.

邀请.zh: 如果你有空，我邀请你来看电影。
邀请.en: If you have time, I invite you to watch a movie.

邀请.zh: 我们邀请老师一起拍照留念。
邀请.en: We invited the teacher to take photos together as a souvenir.

加上.zh: 周末加班，加上路上堵车，今天真累坏了。
加上.en: Working overtime on the weekend, plus traffic jams on the road, I'm really exhausted today.

加上.zh: 再加上一点盐，味道会更好。
加上.en: Add a little more salt, the taste will be better.

加上.zh: 你算错了，把运费加上去才对。
加上.en: You miscalculated; you need to add the shipping cost.

加上.zh: 家里本来就忙，加上孩子生病，更乱了。
加上.en: The household was already busy, plus the child got sick, it's even more chaotic.

队员.en: Have all the team members arrived?

队员.zh: 我们队的每个队员都很努力。
队员.en: Every member of our team works very hard.

队员.zh: 教练正在和队员们开会。
队员.en: The coach is having a meeting with the team members.

队员.zh: 新来的队员技术特别好，大家都想跟他一组。
队员.en: The new team member is really skilled, everyone wants to be in his group.

队员.zh: 比赛输了，但队员们没有互相埋怨。
队员.en: We lost the game, but the team members didn't blame each other.

交通.en: The transportation here is very convenient.

交通.zh: 早晚高峰的交通真的很堵。
交通.en: The traffic during rush hour in the morning and evening is really congested.

交通.zh: 因为交通问题，我迟到了二十分钟。
交通.en: Because of traffic issues, I was twenty minutes late.

交通.zh: 坐地铁比开车快，还能避开交通堵塞。
交通.en: Taking the subway is faster than driving, and you can also avoid traffic jams.

交通.zh: 公司附近交通不错，公交地铁都有。
交通.en: The transportation near the company is good, with both buses and the subway.

优秀.zh: 这次考试，优秀的学生可以免试。
优秀.en: In this exam, excellent students can be exempted.

优秀.zh: 她不仅成绩优秀，而且人缘也很好。
优秀.en: She not only has excellent grades but also gets along well with others.

优秀.zh: 我们公司需要招聘更多优秀人才。
优秀.en: Our company needs to recruit more excellent talent.

优秀.zh: 这部电影被评为年度优秀作品。
优秀.en: This movie was rated as the year's outstanding work.

亮.en: It's dawn, time to get up.

亮.zh: 你把灯打开，房间就亮了。
亮.en: Turn on the light, and the room will be bright.

亮.zh: 她的眼睛很亮，像星星一样。
亮.en: Her eyes are very bright, like stars.

亮.zh: 手机屏幕太亮了，我调暗一点。
亮.en: The phone screen is too bright, I'll dim it a bit.

亮.zh: 虽然天还没亮，但我们已经出发了。
亮.en: Although it's not yet dawn, we have already set off.

篇.en: This essay is very well written.

篇.zh: 我昨天读了篇很有意思的小说。
篇.en: I read a very interesting novel yesterday.

篇.zh: 他每天写一篇日记，已经坚持一年了。
篇.en: He writes a diary entry every day and has kept it up for a year.

篇.zh: 这篇文章一共有三篇评论。
篇.en: This article has three comments in total.

篇.zh: 刚才那篇报道里提到的事件是真的吗？
篇.en: Is the incident mentioned in that report just now real?

儿童.zh: 这个公园是专门为儿童设计的。
儿童.en: This park is specially designed for children.

儿童.zh: 儿童医院人特别多，最好提前预约。
儿童.en: The children's hospital is very crowded, it's best to make an appointment in advance.

儿童.zh: 我家楼下的儿童游乐场很受欢迎。
儿童.en: The children's playground downstairs from my place is very popular.

儿童.zh: 作为儿童，他们的好奇心是很强的。
儿童.en: As children, their curiosity is very strong.

出口.en: The exit is on the left.

出口.zh: 请问这个商场的出口在几楼？
出口.en: Excuse me, which floor is the exit of this mall on?

出口.zh: 地震时，大家需要从安全出口撤离。
出口.en: During an earthquake, everyone needs to evacuate via the emergency exit.

出口.zh: 这家公司主要做出口生意，很少做国内。
出口.en: This company mainly does export business, rarely domestic.

出口.zh: 别忘了把出口的标志画清楚。
出口.en: Don't forget to draw the exit sign clearly.

既.en: He is both smart and hardworking.

既.zh: 这家店既便宜又好吃，我们经常去。
既.en: This shop is both cheap and delicious, we go there often.

既.zh: 你既来了，就多坐一会儿吧。
既.en: Since you're here, stay a while longer.

既.zh: 这个方案既节省时间，又能提高效率。
既.en: This plan both saves time and increases efficiency.

既.zh: 她既是我们的老师，也是我们的朋友。
既.en: She is both our teacher and our friend.

手里.zh: 他手里拎着一大袋东西。
手里.en: He is carrying a big bag in his hand.

手里.zh: 我把钱放在你手里了，别丢了。
手里.en: I put the money in your hand, don't lose it.

手里.zh: 她手里抱着孩子，还要提包，真辛苦。
手里.en: She has a child in her arms and also has to carry a bag, it's really tough.

手里.zh: 手里有证据，就不用怕他们赖账。
手里.en: If you have evidence in hand, you don't need to worry about them defaulting.

味道.zh: 我特别喜欢妈妈做的红烧肉的味道。
味道.en: I really like the taste of my mom's braised pork.

味道.zh: 虽然这家店装修一般，但味道真的很好。
味道.en: Although this restaurant's decoration is average, the food tastes really good.

味道.zh: 你闻到什么奇怪的味道了吗？
那瓶香水味道太浓了，我不喜欢。
味道.en: That bottle of perfume has too strong a scent; I don't like it.

千万.zh: 这件事你千万别告诉别人。
千万.en: Don't you dare tell anyone about this.

千万.zh: 他千万富翁，但生活还是很朴素。
千万.en: He's a multimillionaire, but still lives a simple life.

千万.zh: 千万记得带上护照，不然会麻烦。
千万.en: Remember to bring your passport, otherwise there'll be trouble.

千万.zh: 过马路时千万要看好红绿灯。
千万.en: When crossing the street, be sure to look at the traffic lights.

距离.en: We are very close to the school.

距离.zh: 两地距离大概两百公里。
距离.en: The distance between the two places is about 200 kilometers.

距离.zh: 虽然距离很远，但我们感情很好。
距离.en: Although we are far apart, our relationship is very good.

距离.zh: 你离我远点，保持安全距离。
距离.en: Stay away from me, keep a safe distance.

距离.zh: 手机的距离感应器坏了吗？
距离.en: Is the phone's proximity sensor broken?

轻松.zh: 周末出去走走，心情会轻松很多。
轻松.en: Going out for a walk on the weekend will make you feel much more relaxed.

轻松.zh: 别给自己太大压力，放松一点会更轻松。
轻松.en: Don't put too much pressure on yourself; relaxing a bit will make things easier.

轻松.zh: 如果计划做得好，整个过程就会很轻松。
轻松.en: If the plan is well made, the whole process will be very smooth.

毕业.en: I graduate from university this year.
What do you want to do after graduation?

毕业.zh: 昨天我们参加了毕业典礼。
毕业.en: Yesterday we attended the graduation ceremony.

毕业.zh: 虽然毕业了，但我们还要继续学习。
毕业.en: Even though we've graduated, we still need to keep learning.

毕业.zh: 他毕业后就直接工作了，没有考研。
毕业.en: After graduation he went straight to work without taking the graduate entrance exam.

怀疑.zh: 警察开始怀疑那个人的说法。
怀疑.en: The police began to doubt that person's statement.

怀疑.zh: 虽然大家都相信他，但我还是有点怀疑。
怀疑.en: Although everyone believes him, I still have some doubts.

怀疑.zh: 如果你怀疑他的能力，可以让他试试看。
怀疑.en: If you doubt his ability, you can let him give it a try.

食物.zh: 食物放久了会坏掉，要赶紧吃掉。
食物.en: Food left out for too long will go bad, so eat it quickly.

食物.zh: 超市里的食物种类很多，你可以慢慢选。
食物.en: There are many kinds of food in the supermarket; you can take your time choosing.

食物.zh: 因为食物太辣，他喝了很多水。
食物.en: Because the food was too spicy, he drank a lot of water.

垃圾.en: Throw the trash into the bin.

垃圾.zh: 我们每天都要分类垃圾。
垃圾.en: We have to sort the garbage every day.

垃圾.zh: 垃圾太多会污染环境，所以我们要减少垃圾。
垃圾.en: Too much garbage pollutes the environment, so we need to reduce waste.

垃圾.zh: 周末我会收拾家里的垃圾，然后拿去倒掉。
垃圾.en: On weekends I'll tidy up the household trash and then take it out.

修.en: My phone is broken; it needs to be fixed.

修.zh: 你能帮我修一下电脑吗？
修.en: Can you help me fix the computer?

修.zh: 虽然修了两次，但洗衣机还是有问题。
修.en: Although it's been repaired twice, the washing machine still has problems.

修.zh: 如果你不会修，可以找专业的师傅来。
修.en: If you don't know how to fix it, you can call a professional.

价格.zh: 商品的价格每天都在变。
价格.en: The price of goods changes every day.

价格.zh: 虽然质量很好，但价格太贵了。
价格.en: Although the quality is good, the price is too expensive.

价格.zh: 你问一下价格，我们再决定买不买。
价格.en: Ask about the price, and then we'll decide whether to buy it or not.

价格.zh: 网购时要注意比较不同店铺的价格。
价格.en: When shopping online, pay attention to comparing prices from different stores.

戴.en: It's cold outside, remember to wear a hat.

戴.zh: 她今天戴了一条很漂亮的项链。
戴.en: She is wearing a very beautiful necklace today.

戴.zh: 因为口罩戴久了，耳朵有点疼。
戴.en: Because I've worn a mask for too long, my ears hurt a bit.

戴.zh: 虽然天气很热，但他还是戴着手套工作。
戴.en: Although it's very hot, he still wears gloves while working.

大量.en: He bought a large amount of fruit.

大量.zh: 这个项目需要大量资金。
大量.en: This project requires a large amount of funds.

大量.zh: 大量数据表明，运动有益健康。
大量.en: A large amount of data shows that exercise is good for health.

大量.zh: 由于大量游客涌入，景区变得很拥挤。
大量.en: Due to a large influx of tourists, the scenic area became very crowded.

大量.zh: 公司裁掉了大量员工，然而业务并没有好转。
大量.en: The company laid off a large number of employees, yet the business didn't improve.

究竟.en: What exactly do you want to say?

究竟.zh: 他究竟要不要来，你得问清楚。
究竟.en: Whether he actually wants to come or not, you need to ask clearly.

究竟.zh: 我试了好几次，究竟能不能成功还不知道。
究竟.en: I've tried several times, but I still don't know if it will actually succeed.

究竟.zh: 虽然大家都很着急，但究竟怎么解决，还需要再讨论。
究竟.en: Although everyone is very anxious, how to actually solve it still needs further discussion.

轻.zh: 你说话轻一点，孩子睡着了。
轻.en: Speak more softly, the child is asleep.

轻.zh: 别轻信那些广告，很多都是骗人的。
轻.en: Don't easily believe those ads; many of them are scams.

轻.zh: 虽然任务很轻，但他还是认真完成了。
轻.en: Although the task was very light, he still completed it carefully.

信号.zh: 前面有信号灯，记得减速。
信号.en: There is a traffic light ahead, remember to slow down.

信号.zh: 我给她发了好几条消息，但一直没信号。
信号.en: I sent her several messages, but there's been no signal.

信号.zh: 因为信号太弱，我们没办法视频通话。
信号.en: Because the signal is too weak, we can't have a video call.

信号.zh: 他举起手来，给远处的朋友发了一个信号。
信号.en: He raised his hand and gave a signal to his friend far away.

然而.en: He said he would come, however he didn't.

然而.zh: 这个办法很简单，然而很有效。
然而.en: This method is very simple, yet very effective.

然而.zh: 她学习很努力，然而成绩并不理想。
然而.en: She studies very hard, yet her grades are not ideal.

然而.zh: 外面下着大雨，然而他还是决定出门。
然而.en: It's raining heavily outside, yet he still decided to go out.

然而.zh: 虽然我们准备得很充分，然而比赛还是输了。
然而.en: Although we were well prepared, we still lost the game.

赢得.zh: 她的真诚赢得了大家的信任。
他通过努力赢得了尊重。
赢得.en: He earned respect through hard work.

赢得.zh: 因为表现优秀，她赢得了老板的表扬。
赢得.en: Because of her excellent performance, she won praise from the boss.

赢得.zh: 虽然困难很多，但最终我们赢得了时间。
赢得.en: Although there were many difficulties, we eventually gained time.

交流.en: Communicating more with foreigners can improve oral skills.

交流.en: This meeting promoted the exchange between the two companies.

交流.en: Because of the language barrier, their communication was very difficult.

交流.en: Besides studying, we also share experiences in life.

教练.en: The coach taught me how to swim.

教练.zh: 他找了一个私人健身教练。
教练.en: He hired a personal fitness trainer.

教练.zh: 因为教练的指导，我的进步很快。
教练.en: Thanks to the coach's guidance, I improved quickly.

教练.zh: 足球教练要求我们每天训练两个小时。
教练.en: The football coach requires us to train two hours every day.

兴奋.en: She was very excited to hear the news.

明天要去旅游，我兴奋得睡不着。
兴奋.en: I'm going on a trip tomorrow, I'm too excited to sleep.

兴奋.zh: 比赛赢了之后，全队都很兴奋。
兴奋.en: After winning the game, the whole team was very excited.

兴奋.zh: 虽然很累，但一想到结果就特别兴奋。
兴奋.en: Although very tired, I get especially excited when I think of the result.

付.en: You need to pay a deposit before we can ship.
He paid the rent and then moved out.

付.en: Don't worry, I've already paid the bill.

付.en: This store only takes cash, you can't pay by card.

全球.en: Global warming is a big problem.

全球.zh: 这家公司的产品销往全球各地。
全球.en: This company's products are sold all over the world.

全球.zh: 全球疫情影响了很多人。
全球.en: The global pandemic affected many people.
He dreams of traveling around the world.

全球.zh: 虽然全球经济发展很快，但是贫富差距依然很大。
全球.en: Although the global economy is developing rapidly, the gap between rich and poor is still large.

色.en: What color do you like best?

色.zh: 他的脸色不太好，是不是生病了？
色.en: His complexion looks bad, is he sick?

色.en: This piece of clothing is too bright in color.
What role does that actor play?

困.zh: 因为昨晚没睡好，现在特别困。
困.en: Because I didn't sleep well last night, I'm especially sleepy now.
He is trapped in the elevator.

困.zh: 这个字怎么写？我困住了。
困.en: How do you write this character? I'm stuck.

困.zh: 虽然很困，但我还是坚持完成了作业。
困.en: Although I was very sleepy, I still insisted on finishing my homework.

符合.en: This answer does not meet the requirements.

符合.zh: 你的行为不符合公司的规定。
符合.en: Your behavior does not comply with company regulations.

符合.zh: 他的条件完全符合招聘标准。
符合.en: His qualifications fully meet the recruitment standards.

符合.zh: 实验结果符合我们的预期。
符合.en: The experimental results matched our expectations.

符合.zh: 虽然价格高，但质量符合顾客的期望。
符合.en: Although the price is high, the quality meets customer expectations.

吹.zh: 别听他吹，他说的都是假的。
吹.en: Don't listen to his boasting, everything he says is fake.

吹.zh: 他吹了一口气，蜡烛灭了。
吹.en: He blew a breath, and the candle went out.
She likes to blow the sea breeze at the beach.

吹.en: Because the wind was too strong, my umbrella was blown broken.

取消.en: Because of rain, the game was canceled.

取消.zh: 我们取消了明天的会议。
如果你不按时付款，订单会被取消。
取消.en: If you don't pay on time, the order will be canceled.

躺.en: He is lying on the sofa watching TV.

躺.zh: 别躺着玩手机，对眼睛不好。
躺.en: Don't lie down and play with your phone, it's bad for your eyes.
The patient needs to lie down and rest.

躺.en: The first thing I do after coming home is lie on the bed.

答案.en: The answer to this question is at the back of the book.
The teacher gave the correct answer.
He found the answer to the problem.

答案.zh: 虽然问题很难，但答案其实很简单。
答案.en: Although the question was difficult, the answer was actually very simple.

皮肤.en: In summer, you need to pay attention to sun protection for your skin.

皮肤.zh: 这种护肤品适合敏感皮肤。
皮肤.en: This skincare product is suitable for sensitive skin.
Drinking more water is good for your skin.

浪费.en: Don't waste water, turn off the tap.

浪费.zh: 点这么多菜吃不完，太浪费了。
浪费.en: Ordering so many dishes and not finishing them is such a waste.

浪费.zh: 时间很宝贵，我不想浪费在无聊的事情上。
浪费.en: Time is precious, I don't want to waste it on boring things.

浪费.zh: 如果你不用这张优惠券，就浪费了，不如送给我吧。
浪费.en: If you're not going to use this coupon, it'll go to waste, so why not give it to me?

浪费.zh: 他花钱大手大脚的，每个月都浪费很多钱。
浪费.en: He spends money carelessly and wastes a lot every month.

厉害.en: He is really good at running.

厉害.zh: 今天的风好厉害，差点把我吹倒。
厉害.en: The wind is so strong today, it almost blew me over.

厉害.zh: 你居然能一个人完成这个项目，太厉害了！
厉害.en: You actually completed this project all by yourself, that's amazing!

厉害.zh: 她发烧很厉害，得赶紧去医院。
厉害.en: She has a high fever and needs to go to the hospital immediately.

厉害.zh: 虽然他才学了半年中文，但说得已经很厉害了。
厉害.en: Even though he's only been learning Chinese for half a year, he already speaks it very well.

尊重.zh: 尊重别人就是尊重自己。
如果他不尊重你的意见，你就直接说出来。
尊重.en: If he doesn't respect your opinion, just say it directly.

尊重.zh: 每个文化都有自己的传统，我们要互相尊重。
尊重.en: Every culture has its own traditions, and we need to respect each other.

尊重.zh: 他工作很努力，我很尊重他的职业态度。
尊重.en: He works very hard, and I respect his professional attitude.

激动.en: He was so excited that he couldn't speak.

激动.zh: 听到这个消息，她激动得跳了起来。
激动.en: Hearing the news, she jumped up with excitement.

激动.zh: 别太激动，先冷静一下再说。
激动.en: Don't get too excited, calm down first before talking.

激动.zh: 第一次见到偶像，我激动得手都在发抖。
激动.en: Seeing my idol for the first time, I was so excited my hands were shaking.

激动.zh: 比赛赢了以后，大家都非常激动，抱在一起哭。
激动.en: After winning the game, everyone was so emotional that they hugged and cried.

多么.zh: 你多么聪明，这个问题一下就解出来了。
多么.en: How smart you are, you solved this problem in no time.

多么.zh: 不管多么困难，我都不会放弃。
多么.en: No matter how difficult it is, I won't give up.

多么.zh: 你想象不到，她当时多么生气。
多么.en: You can't imagine how angry she was at that time.

多么.zh: 多么好的机会啊，你一定要抓住它。
多么.en: What a great opportunity, you must seize it.

擦.zh: 他擦了一下汗，继续工作。
擦.en: He wiped his sweat and continued working.

擦.zh: 地板脏了，用拖把擦一擦吧。
擦.en: The floor is dirty, mop it a bit.
After eating, don't forget to wipe your mouth.

擦.zh: 玻璃上有水印，拿干布擦一下就好了。
擦.en: There are water marks on the glass, just wipe it with a dry cloth.

香.zh: 妈妈做的饭很香，我吃了两碗。
香.en: Mom's cooking smells so good, I ate two bowls.

香.zh: 咖啡的香味飘满了整个房间。
香.en: The aroma of coffee filled the entire room.

香.zh: 新买的洗发水特别香，你闻一下。
香.en: The new shampoo smells really nice, take a sniff.

香.zh: 刚烤出来的面包又香又软，谁都想吃。
香.en: The freshly baked bread is fragrant and soft, everyone wants to eat it.

无聊.zh: 周末没事做，觉得好无聊。
无聊.en: With nothing to do on the weekend, I feel so bored.

无聊.zh: 别开这种无聊的玩笑，没意思。
无聊.en: Don't make such boring jokes, they're not funny.

无聊.zh: 一个人在家的日子真无聊，连说话的人都没有。
无聊.en: Staying home alone is really boring, not even anyone to talk to.

无聊.zh: 既然你觉得无聊，不如我们一起出去散步吧。
无聊.en: Since you feel bored, why don't we go for a walk together.

文章.zh: 他每天都会读一篇英语文章。
文章.en: He reads an English article every day.

文章.zh: 你发的文章我看了，很有道理。
文章.en: I read the article you posted, and it makes a lot of sense.

文章.zh: 写文章需要多观察生活，才能有内容。
文章.en: Writing articles requires observing life more to have substance.

文章.zh: 这篇关于环保的文章在网上被转发了无数次。
文章.en: This article about environmental protection has been shared countless times online.

宝宝.zh: 她家的宝宝刚学会走路。
宝宝.en: Her baby just learned to walk.

宝宝.zh: 给宝宝喂奶的时候要小心温度。
宝宝.en: Be careful with the temperature when feeding the baby.

宝宝.zh: 你宝宝长得真快，才几个月就这么大了。
宝宝.en: Your baby is growing so fast, already this big in just a few months.

宝宝.zh: 为了宝宝的健康，她每天都做新鲜的辅食。
宝宝.en: For the baby's health, she makes fresh baby food every day.

地球.en: We need to protect the Earth well.

地球.zh: 从月球上看，地球像个蓝色的球。
地球.en: From the moon, the Earth looks like a blue ball.

地球.zh: 虽然地球很大，但我们也要珍惜资源。
地球.en: Although the Earth is huge, we still need to cherish resources.

地球.zh: 你知道吗？地球绕太阳转一圈要一年。
地球.en: Do you know? It takes one year for the Earth to go around the sun.

内心.en: She is very kind at heart.
Actually, I'm a little scared inside.

内心.zh: 他表面上很冷静，内心却很激动。
内心.en: He looks calm on the outside, but inside he's very excited.

内心.zh: 不管别人怎么说，你都要听从自己的内心。
内心.en: No matter what others say, you should follow your own heart.

内心.zh: 这件事让我内心很不舒服。
内心.en: This matter makes me feel very uncomfortable inside.

发出.en: The alarm suddenly made a sound.

发出.zh: 请向公司发出正式申请。
发出.en: Please send a formal application to the company.

发出.en: The flowers give off a faint fragrance in spring.

发出.en: After he sent out the invitation, everyone agreed.

实际.en: The actual situation is very complicated.

实际.zh: 你说得对，实际就是这样的。
实际.en: You're right, that's actually how it is.

实际.zh: 虽然计划很好，但实际做起来很难。
实际.en: Although the plan is good, it's hard to actually do it.

实际.en: Don't just talk theory, let's look at the actual results.

实际.en: The actual price is much cheaper than the listed price.

美女.en: Excuse me, miss, how do I get to this road?

美女.en: The beautiful actress in this movie is very famous.

美女.zh: 虽然他喜欢美女，但他更看重性格。
美女.en: Although he likes beautiful women, he values personality more.

赶紧.en: Let's eat quickly and go to class.

赶紧.en: It's raining, quickly bring the clothes in.

赶紧.zh: 要是再不走，我们就赶不上车了，赶紧！
赶紧.en: If we don't leave now, we'll miss the bus, hurry!

赶紧.en: He quickly ran over to help, but it was still too late.

年龄.en: People of different ages think differently.

年龄.en: Although he is old, he is still very healthy.

不必.en: Just come, no need to bring gifts.

不必.en: You don't need to tell anyone about this.

不必.en: Since you already know, I don't need to say more.

不必.en: He thinks he's ready and doesn't need to practice anymore.

现金.zh: 现在很少人用现金了，都刷卡。
现金.en: Now few people use cash, everyone uses cards.

现金.en: Because my phone ran out of battery, I had to pay with cash.

可惜.en: It's a pity you came late.

可惜.en: Although it's delicious, it's a pity I'm full.

可惜.zh: 可惜这么好的机会错过了。
可惜.en: It's a pity to miss such a good opportunity.

可惜.zh: 可惜他不在家，不然可以一起吃饭。
可惜.en: It's a pity he's not home, otherwise we could eat together.

阳光.zh: 阳光照进房间，感觉特别温暖。
阳光.en: The sunlight comes into the room, feels very warm.

阳光.zh: 因为阳光太强，所以我戴了墨镜。
阳光.en: Because the sunlight is too strong, I wore sunglasses.

阳光.zh: 我喜欢阳光灿烂的日子。

阳光.en: She always has a sunny smile on her face.

回忆.zh: 这张照片让我想起了童年的回忆。
回忆.en: This photo reminds me of childhood memories.

回忆.zh: 虽然回忆很甜，但也要向前看。
回忆.en: Although memories are sweet, we also need to look forward.

回忆.zh: 他喜欢收藏充满回忆的旧物。
回忆.en: He likes collecting old items full of memories.

回忆.zh: 我们一起创造了很多美好的回忆。
回忆.en: We created many beautiful memories together.

空气.en: Open the window in the morning to let fresh air in.

空气.zh: 因为空气污染严重，所以出门要戴口罩。
空气.en: Because air pollution is serious, wear a mask when going out.

空气.zh: 森林里的空气特别清新。
空气.en: The air in the forest is especially fresh.

空气.zh: 空调让房间里的空气变凉了。
空气.en: The air conditioner cooled the air in the room.

喊.en: Don't shout loudly on the road, it will disturb others.

喊.zh: 如果你迷路了，就喊我的名字。
喊.en: If you get lost, call my name.

喊.en: He shouted too hard, his voice became hoarse.

材料.zh: 做蛋糕需要准备面粉和糖这些材料。
材料.en: Making cake needs to prepare flour and sugar these ingredients.

材料.zh: 因为材料不够，所以今天做不了。
材料.en: Because materials are insufficient, so cannot do it today.

材料.zh: 这篇论文参考了很多历史材料。
材料.en: This paper references many historical materials.

材料.en: He made a small table from waste materials.

熟悉.zh: 新同事还不太熟悉公司的流程。
熟悉.en: The new colleague is not yet familiar with company procedures.

熟悉.zh: 虽然我们刚认识，但感觉很熟悉。
熟悉.en: Although we just met, it feels familiar.

熟悉.zh: 这条路我每天走，非常熟悉。
熟悉.en: I walk this road every day, very familiar.

熟悉.zh: 熟悉的环境让我感到安心。
熟悉.en: The familiar environment makes me feel at ease.

随便.zh: 你想吃什么？随便，我都可以。
随便.en: What do you want to eat? Whatever, I'm fine with anything.
If you don't want to go, up to you.

随便.zh: 她随便穿了件衣服就出门了。
随便.en: She casually put on some clothes and went out.

烦.zh: 别烦我，我今天心情不好。
烦.en: Don't bother me, I'm in a bad mood today.

烦.zh: 因为一直下雨，所以觉得很烦。
烦.en: Because it keeps raining, I feel annoyed.

烦.zh: 他总是问同样的问题，很烦人。
烦.en: He always asks the same question, very annoying.

互相.en: We need to help each other.

互相.zh: 好朋友之间应该互相理解。
互相.en: Good friends should understand each other.

互相.zh: 只有互相尊重，才能和睦相处。
互相.en: Only by respecting each other can we get along harmoniously.

互相.zh: 他们互相看了一眼，笑了。
互相.en: They looked at each other and smiled.

互相.zh: 比赛时队员要互相配合。
互相.en: During the game, teammates need to cooperate with each other.

科技.zh: 最近科技发展很快，很多人都用智能手机。
科技.en: Recently technology has developed fast, many people use smartphones.

科技.zh: 这家公司主要做科技产品。
科技.en: This company mainly makes tech products.

科技.zh: 虽然科技很方便，但也要注意保护隐私。
科技.en: Although technology is convenient, we must also pay attention to privacy.

科技.zh: 科技让我们的工作更高效了。
科技.en: Technology makes our work more efficient.

失望.zh: 这次考试没考好，我觉得很失望。
失望.en: I didn't do well on this exam, I feel very disappointed.

失望.zh: 虽然结果让我失望，但我不会放弃。
失望.en: Although the result disappointed me, I won't give up.

失望.zh: 我对这家餐厅的服务很失望。
失望.en: I'm very disappointed with the service at this restaurant.

印象.zh: 第一次见面，她给我的印象很好。
印象.en: First meeting, she gave me a good impression.

印象.zh: 我对这个城市印象很深。
印象.en: I have a deep impression of this city.

印象.zh: 虽然只见过一面，但我对他的印象不错。
印象.en: Although I only met him once, I have a good impression of him.

印象.zh: 这部电影给我留下了深刻的印象。
印象.en: This movie left a deep impression on me.

相同.zh: 这两个手机的颜色完全相同。
相同.en: The colors of these two phones are exactly the same.

相同.zh: 我们买了相同款式的衣服。
相同.en: We bought clothes of the same style.

相同.zh: 虽然我们来自不同地方，但爱好相同。
相同.en: Although we come from different places, our hobbies are the same.

相同.zh: 这个问题和上一个相同。
相同.en: This question is the same as the previous one.
