烟.zh: 厨房里有很多烟，快开窗户。
烟.en: There is a lot of smoke in the kitchen, open the window quickly.

烟.zh: 因为烟太大，我什么都看不见。
烟.en: Because the smoke is too thick, I can't see anything.
He bought a pack of cigarettes.

生意.zh: 最近生意不好做，很多店都关门了。
生意.en: Recently business is hard to do, many shops have closed.

生意.zh: 我们和这家公司有生意往来。
生意.en: We have business dealings with this company.

生意.zh: 虽然生意很忙，但他还是抽空陪家人。
生意.en: Although business is very busy, he still takes time to accompany his family.

赶.zh: 我得赶在六点之前到公司。
赶.en: I have to get to the company before six o'clock.

赶.zh: 因为起晚了，他赶紧跑去赶公交。
赶.en: Because he got up late, he quickly ran to catch the bus.
We need to catch the next flight.

存.en: Money is deposited in the bank.

存.zh: 你手机里存了很多照片吗？
存.en: Do you have many photos saved in your phone?

存.zh: 这些资料都存在电脑里。
存.en: These materials are all saved in the computer.

存.zh: 虽然存了不少钱，但他还是觉得不够。
存.en: Although he saved quite a bit of money, he still feels it's not enough.

存.zh: 这附近有银行可以存钱。
存.en: There is a bank nearby to deposit money.

桥.zh: 这座桥已经建了三年了。
桥.en: This bridge has been under construction for three years.
After crossing this bridge is the park.

桥.zh: 因为桥断了，我们只能绕路走。
桥.en: Because the bridge is broken, we have to take a detour.
They stand on the bridge taking photos.

仅仅.zh: 我仅仅用了十分钟就做完了。
仅仅.en: I only used ten minutes to finish.

仅仅.zh: 他仅仅看了我一眼就走了。
仅仅.en: He only glanced at me and left.

仅仅.zh: 虽然仅仅是一句话，但让我很感动。
仅仅.en: Although it was just one sentence, it moved me a lot.

仅仅.zh: 我们仅仅需要一点时间。
仅仅.en: We only need a little time.

答应.en: I promise you I'll go tomorrow.

答应.zh: 他已经答应帮忙了，你别担心。
答应.en: He has already agreed to help, don't worry.

答应.zh: 她答应了我一起吃饭，结果却忘了。
答应.en: She agreed to eat with me, but then she forgot.

答应.zh: 只要他答应，我们就马上开始。
答应.en: As long as he agrees, we'll start right away.

答应.zh: 我答应过妈妈不玩手机到很晚。
答应.en: I promised Mom I wouldn't play on my phone until late.

基础.zh: 打好基础才能学得更好。
基础.en: Only with a solid foundation can you learn better.

基础.zh: 他的中文基础很好，所以进步很快。
基础.en: His Chinese foundation is good, so he improves quickly.

基础.zh: 如果没有基础，学起来会非常吃力。
基础.en: If there's no foundation, learning will be very difficult.

基础.zh: 做任何事情都要从基础开始。
基础.en: Whatever you do, you have to start from the basics.

量.en: I don't know how much quantity is needed.

量.zh: 你做的菜量太大了，吃不完。
量.en: The amount of food you made is too much, we can't finish it.

量.zh: 因为天气热，水的量消耗得很快。
量.en: Because it's hot, the amount of water is consumed quickly.

量.zh: 每次做饭的油量要控制好。
量.en: You need to control the amount of oil each time you cook.

适应.en: Have you adapted to the new environment?

适应.zh: 我还在适应这里的生活。
适应.en: I'm still adjusting to life here.

适应.zh: 刚到的时候很不适应，后来慢慢好了。
适应.en: At first I really couldn't adapt, but later it gradually got better.

适应.zh: 如果你不适应，可以考虑换工作。
适应.en: If you can't adapt, you might consider changing jobs.

适应.zh: 适应能力强的孩子更容易交朋友。
适应.en: Children with strong adaptability make friends more easily.

赚.en: He earned a lot of money.
I didn't earn much this month.

赚.zh: 每天工作那么辛苦，赚的却很少。
赚.en: Working so hard every day, yet earning so little.
He earned quite a bit of money by writing books.

赚.zh: 网上有人说可以轻松赚大钱，千万别信。
赚.en: Some people online say you can make big money easily; don't believe them.

猜.en: Stop guessing, I'll tell you directly.
I guess he might not come.

猜.zh: 如果你猜不出来，我可以给你提示。
猜.en: If you can't guess, I can give you a hint.

猜.zh: 大家猜了半天，最后也没猜到。
猜.en: Everyone guessed for a long time, but in the end didn't guess it.

食品.zh: 我在超市买了很多食品。
食品.en: I bought a lot of food at the supermarket.

食品.zh: 进口食品的价格比国产的贵很多。
食品.en: Imported food is much more expensive than domestic.

食品.zh: 因为食品安全很重要，所以我们要小心选择。
食品.en: Because food safety is very important, we need to choose carefully.

大约.en: He is about thirty years old.

大约.zh: 这个工作大约要两个月才能完成。
大约.en: This job takes about two months to finish.

大约.zh: 从这儿到那儿大约有五公里。
大约.en: From here to there is about five kilometers.

大约.zh: 我大约记得他的样子，但记不清了。
大约.en: I roughly remember what he looks like, but can't recall clearly.

奖.en: He won an award this time.

奖.zh: 比赛的第一名可以获得奖金。
奖.en: The first place in the competition can get a cash prize.

奖.zh: 他因为表现好，拿到了一等奖。
奖.en: He got first prize because of his good performance.

奖.zh: 老师给每个孩子发了一个小奖。
奖.en: The teacher gave each child a small reward.

视频.zh: 你昨天发的视频我看了。
视频.en: I watched the video you posted yesterday.

视频.zh: 他喜欢在睡觉前看视频。
视频.en: He likes to watch videos before sleeping.

视频.zh: 因为网络不好，视频一直卡。
视频.en: Because the internet is bad, the video keeps buffering.

视频.zh: 现在很多人用手机拍视频分享生活。
视频.en: Nowadays many people use their phones to shoot videos and share their lives.

提前.en: We arrived at the station early.
Please notify me one day in advance.

提前.zh: 因为要下雨，我们提前结束了比赛。
提前.en: Because it was going to rain, we ended the game early.

提前.zh: 你最好提前订票，不然可能没座位。
提前.en: You'd better book tickets in advance, otherwise there might be no seats.

提前.zh: 她提前完成了所有工作，然后去旅游了。
提前.en: She finished all her work ahead of time and then went traveling.

列.en: The train is on platform three.

列.zh: 他列了一张购物清单给我们。
列.en: He made a shopping list for us.

列.zh: 第一列队伍已经出发了，我们等下一列。
列.en: The first row of people has already left; we'll wait for the next one.

列.zh: 她把需要做的事情列在笔记本上，避免忘记。
列.en: She listed the things that needed to be done in her notebook to avoid forgetting.

暂时.en: He is not at home for now.

暂时.zh: 我们先暂时休息一下，等会儿再继续。
暂时.en: Let's take a short break for now and continue later.

暂时.zh: 因为系统故障，服务暂时停止了。
暂时.en: Due to a system failure, the service has been temporarily suspended.

暂时.zh: 虽然暂时有点困难，但我们会想办法解决。
暂时.en: Although it's a bit difficult for now, we'll find a way to solve it.

积极.en: He is very active in studying.

积极.zh: 你要积极一点参加活动。
积极.en: You should be more active in participating in activities.

积极.zh: 她积极发言，老师表扬了她。
积极.en: She actively spoke up, and the teacher praised her.

积极.zh: 遇到问题要采取积极的态度去面对。
积极.en: When encountering problems, you should adopt a positive attitude to face them.

积极.zh: 虽然失败了，但他仍然保持积极的心态继续努力。
积极.en: Even though he failed, he still maintained a positive mindset and kept working hard.

有着.zh: 这本书有着重要的意义。
这个城市有着悠久的历史。
有着.en: This city has a long history.

有着.zh: 他和你有着完全不同的想法。
有着.en: He has completely different ideas from you.

有着.zh: 中国有着丰富的传统文化，比如书法和茶艺。
有着.en: China has rich traditional culture, such as calligraphy and tea art.

汤.en: The soup is very hot, be careful.

汤.zh: 我想喝一碗西红柿蛋汤。
汤.en: I want a bowl of tomato and egg soup.

汤.zh: 这家店的汤味道特别好，我经常来。
汤.en: The soup at this restaurant tastes especially good; I often come here.

汤.zh: 吃完饭再喝汤，对胃比较好。
汤.en: Drinking soup after a meal is better for the stomach.

响.zh: 雷声太响了，我被吓到了。
响.en: The thunder was so loud that I got scared.

响.zh: 音乐响起来的时候，大家都开始跳舞。
响.en: When the music started playing, everyone began to dance.

响.zh: 闹钟响了半天，他还是不起来。
响.en: The alarm rang for a long time, but he still wouldn't get up.

收入.zh: 我们家的收入主要靠爸爸。
收入.en: Our family's income mainly relies on Dad.

收入.zh: 这个月收入比上个月多了一些。
收入.en: This month's income is a bit more than last month's.

收入.zh: 她换工作后，收入翻了一倍。
收入.en: After changing jobs, her income doubled.

收入.zh: 除了工资，他还有额外的投资收入。
收入.en: Besides his salary, he also has extra investment income.

恐怕.en: I'm afraid it's going to rain today.

恐怕.zh: 这件衣服太贵，恐怕买不起。
恐怕.en: This piece of clothing is too expensive; I'm afraid I can't afford it.

恐怕.zh: 再不走的话，恐怕要迟到了。
恐怕.en: If we don't leave now, I'm afraid we'll be late.

恐怕.zh: 他看起来很不舒服，恐怕是生病了。
恐怕.en: He looks very uncomfortable; I'm afraid he might be sick.

仔细.en: She is very careful in doing things.
Please check it carefully before submitting.

仔细.zh: 他仔细听了每一个人的意见。
仔细.en: He listened carefully to everyone's opinions.

仔细.zh: 这份合同你要仔细看完，有问题再问我。
仔细.en: You need to read this contract carefully; ask me if there are any issues.

严格.zh: 老师对我们要求很严格。
严格.en: The teacher is very strict with us.

严格.zh: 公司有严格的规章制度。
严格.en: The company has strict rules and regulations.

严格.zh: 虽然教练很严格，但大家都很佩服他。
严格.en: Although the coach is very strict, everyone admires him.

严格.zh: 面试时他的态度特别严格。
严格.en: His attitude during the interview was particularly strict.

严格.zh: 父母对我的学习要求严格，所以我成绩一直不错。
严格.en: My parents are strict about my studies, so my grades have always been good.

及时.en: Please reply to my message in time.

及时.zh: 幸亏你及时赶到，不然就赶不上车了。
及时.en: Luckily you arrived in time, otherwise we would have missed the train.

及时.zh: 医生说他能得救是因为送医及时。
及时.en: The doctor said he survived because he was taken to the hospital in time.

及时.zh: 这种药要按时吃，才能及时控制病情。
及时.en: You need to take this medicine on time to control the illness promptly.

及时.zh: 问题出现后，公司及时做出了调整。
及时.en: After the problem arose, the company made adjustments in time.

知识.zh: 他的知识面很广，什么都懂一点。
知识.en: His knowledge is broad; he knows a little about everything.

知识.zh: 网络时代获取知识比以前容易多了。
知识.en: In the internet age, acquiring knowledge is much easier than before.

知识.zh: 光有理论知识不够，还要多实践。
知识.en: It's not enough to have only theoretical knowledge; you also need more practice.

知识.zh: 老师把复杂的知识讲得很简单，我们都听懂了。
知识.en: The teacher explained complex knowledge very simply, and we all understood.

专门.en: I brought a gift specifically for you.

专门.zh: 这家店专门卖手工巧克力。
专门.en: This shop specializes in selling handmade chocolates.

专门.zh: 他专门请了一天假来陪我。
专门.en: He took a day off specifically to accompany me.

专门.zh: 我们公司有专门负责售后服务的部门。
专门.en: Our company has a department specifically responsible for after-sales service.

专门.zh: 为了做这道菜，我专门去超市买了调料。
专门.en: To make this dish, I went to the supermarket specifically to buy seasonings.

脱.en: Please take off your coat before coming in.
He took off his shoes and lay down on the bed.

脱.zh: 运动完记得及时脱掉湿衣服。
脱.en: Remember to take off your wet clothes promptly after exercise.

脱.zh: 这只猫一紧张就会脱毛。
脱.en: This cat sheds fur when it gets nervous.

脱.zh: 他好不容易才从人群中脱身。
脱.en: He finally managed to extricate himself from the crowd.

快速.zh: 这个软件运行速度很快速。
随着技术发展，信息传播越来越快速。
快速.en: With technological development, information spreads faster and faster.

快速.zh: 我们需要快速找到解决方案。
快速.en: We need to find a solution quickly.

快速.zh: 因为订单太多，工人只能快速包装。
快速.en: Because there are too many orders, the workers have to pack quickly.

放松.en: I need to relax well on the weekend.

放松.zh: 听音乐是我放松的方式。
放松.en: Listening to music is my way of relaxing.

放松.zh: 考试结束后，大家可以彻底放松了。
放松.en: After the exam, everyone can completely relax.

放松.zh: 工作再忙，也要找时间放松身体。
放松.en: No matter how busy work is, you need to find time to relax your body.

放松.zh: 他靠在沙发上闭着眼睛，看起来非常放松。
放松.en: He leaned back on the sofa with his eyes closed, looking very relaxed.

举.en: Please raise your hand to answer the question.

举.zh: 他努力把箱子举过头顶。
举.en: He tried to lift the box above his head.

举.zh: 大家举杯庆祝这个好消息。
举.en: Everyone raised their glasses to celebrate the good news.

举.zh: 这个例子举得很好，大家都明白了。
举.en: This example was well given; everyone understood.
His every move is very elegant.

厂.en: My dad works in a factory.

厂.zh: 老厂搬迁后，原址改成了商场。
厂.en: After the old factory moved, the original site was turned into a shopping mall.

厂.zh: 厂里的设备都是进口的。
厂.en: The equipment in the factory is all imported.

厂.zh: 因为环保问题，那家造纸厂被关停了。
厂.en: Because of environmental issues, that paper mill was shut down.

苦.en: He has endured a lot of hardship since childhood.

苦.zh: 学习外语虽然苦，但很有收获。
苦.en: Although learning a foreign language is hard, it is very rewarding.
Mom often says that bitterness comes before sweetness.

苦.zh: 苦瓜虽然味道苦，但营养很高。
苦.en: Although bitter melon tastes bitter, it is highly nutritious.

租.en: I want to rent a house.
We rented a car to go on a trip.

租.zh: 这栋楼的租金太贵了，我租不起。
租.en: The rent for this building is too expensive; I can't afford it.

租.zh: 你租的房子离公司远不远？
租.en: Is the house you rented far from the company?

租.zh: 他租了个共享单车骑到地铁站。
租.en: He rented a shared bike and rode to the subway station.

球队.zh: 这支球队的防守很厉害。
球队.en: This team's defense is very strong.

球队.zh: 因为我们球队配合好，所以经常赢。
球队.en: Because our team has good coordination, we often win.

球队.zh: 我支持的球队今年又拿了冠军。
球队.en: The team I support won the championship again this year.

吸.en: This vacuum cleaner has strong suction.

吸.zh: 他吸了一口气就跳下水了。
吸.en: He took a breath and jumped into the water.
Plants absorb water through their roots.

吸.zh: 用吸管吸饮料的时候小心烫。
吸.en: Be careful of burns when drinking through a straw.

箱.zh: 我把衣服放进箱子里了。
箱.en: I put the clothes into the box.

箱.zh: 你那个行李箱能装多少东西？
箱.en: How much stuff can your suitcase hold?

箱.zh: 快递员把一个箱子放在门口。
箱.en: The delivery guy placed a box at the door.

箱.zh: 冰箱里的食物箱要定期清理。
箱.en: The food compartment in the fridge needs regular cleaning.

单位.en: Which unit do you work for?

单位.zh: 我们单位下个月组织旅游。
单位.en: Our workplace is organizing a trip next month.

单位.zh: 因为单位离家近，所以我走路上下班。
单位.en: Because my workplace is close to home, I walk to and from work.

单位.zh: 每公里的费用按单位计算。
单位.en: The cost per kilometer is calculated by unit.

单位.zh: 这个单位的工资待遇怎么样？
单位.en: How are the salary and benefits at this workplace?

说法.en: This kind of statement is not correct.

说法.zh: 关于这件事，有不同的说法。
说法.en: There are different versions of this matter.

说法.zh: 如果按照他的说法，我们都得等。
说法.en: If we follow his version, we all have to wait.

说法.zh: 民间的说法跟科学不太一样。
说法.en: Folk sayings are quite different from science.

说法.zh: 你的说法有道理，但我还是不同意。
说法.en: Your point makes sense, but I still disagree.

公共.zh: 在图书馆要保持公共秩序。
公共.en: Maintain public order in the library.

公共.zh: 我们不能破坏公共设施。
公共.en: We must not damage public facilities.
Smoking is prohibited in public places.

学院.en: He studies painting at the art college.

学院.zh: 我们学院的图书馆很大。
学院.en: Our college library is very big.

学院.zh: 这个学院今年招了多少新生？
学院.en: How many new students did this college recruit this year?

学院.zh: 他毕业于一所著名的音乐学院。
学院.en: He graduated from a famous music college.

学院.zh: 学院的教授都很认真负责。
学院.en: The professors at the college are all very conscientious and responsible.

费用.en: This month's expenses are too high.

费用.zh: 旅游的费用包括机票和酒店。
费用.en: Travel expenses include airfare and hotel.

费用.zh: 因为费用不够，我们取消了计划。
费用.en: Because the funds were insufficient, we canceled the plan.

费用.zh: 这笔费用的明细你能给我看看吗？
费用.en: Can you show me the details of this expense?
The cost of living keeps rising.

道路.en: The road ahead is under repair.
Because of the snow, the road is very slippery.

道路.zh: 他们正在修一条新的道路。
道路.en: They are building a new road.

道路.zh: 人生的道路不会总是一帆风顺。
道路.en: The path of life won't always be smooth sailing.

能否.zh: 你能否帮我拿一下那个包？
能否.en: Can you help me get that bag?

能否.zh: 明天能否准时到，就看交通了。
能否.en: Whether we can arrive on time tomorrow depends on traffic.

能否.zh: 这件事能否成功还不一定。
能否.en: It's still uncertain whether this matter will succeed.

能否.zh: 你能否告诉我最近的地铁站在哪？
能否.en: Can you tell me where the nearest subway station is?

能否.zh: 如果下雨，活动能否照常进行？
能否.en: If it rains, can the event proceed as usual?

下降.en: The temperature has dropped a lot recently.

下降.zh: 这里的房价开始下降了。
下降.en: Housing prices here have started to decline.

下降.zh: 因为疫情，销售额明显下降。
下降.en: Due to the pandemic, sales have dropped significantly.

下降.zh: 他的视力在慢慢下降，需要配眼镜。
下降.en: His eyesight is gradually declining; he needs glasses.

下降.zh: 自从换了工作，他的压力反而下降了。
下降.en: Since changing jobs, his stress has actually decreased.

旅行.zh: 这次旅行我们去了海边和山里。
旅行.en: On this trip, we went to the seaside and the mountains.

旅行.zh: 旅行前一定要做好攻略。
旅行.en: You must do good planning before a trip.

旅行.zh: 虽然很累，但这次旅行真的很开心。
旅行.en: Although it was tiring, this trip was really enjoyable.

旅行.zh: 他每年都会去国外旅行一次。
旅行.en: He goes on a trip abroad once every year.

公路.zh: 开车走公路比走小路快。
公路.en: Driving on the highway is faster than taking small roads.
Many trees are planted on both sides of the highway.

公路.zh: 因为下雪，公路暂时封闭了。
公路.en: The highway is temporarily closed due to snow.

公路.zh: 沿着这条公路一直开，就能到县城。
公路.en: Drive straight along this highway, and you'll reach the county town.

再说.en: I'll go eat first, and we'll talk when I get back.

再说.zh: 时间太晚了，我们明天再说。
再说.en: It's too late; let's talk about it tomorrow.

再说.zh: 先别急着决定，咱们考虑一下再说。
再说.en: Don't rush to decide; let's think it over and then talk.

土.en: There is a lot of dirt on the ground.
These shoes are covered in dirt.

土.zh: 他说话有点土，但是人很好。
土.en: His way of speaking is a bit rustic, but he's a nice person.
This kind of soil is very suitable for growing flowers.

土.zh: 搬家时，他带了一包家乡的土。
土.en: When moving, he brought a bag of soil from his hometown.

尤其.zh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是草莓。
他什么都吃，尤其爱吃辣的。
尤其.en: He eats everything, especially spicy food.

尤其.zh: 这个地方夏天很热，尤其是中午。
尤其.en: This place is very hot in summer, especially at noon.

尤其.zh: 她的穿着很讲究，尤其是鞋子。
尤其.en: She is very particular about her clothing, especially shoes.

尤其.zh: 做这个工作要有耐心，尤其对细节要特别注意。
尤其.en: You need patience for this job, especially paying close attention to details.

工人.en: The workers are repairing the road.

工人.zh: 爸爸以前是个建筑工人。
工人.en: My dad used to be a construction worker.

工人.zh: 工厂里的工人都很辛苦。
工人.en: The workers in the factory all work very hard.

工人.zh: 为了赶工期，工人每天加班。
工人.en: To meet the deadline, the workers work overtime every day.

工人.zh: 老板给每个工人都发了奖金。
工人.en: The boss gave each worker a bonus.

扔.en: Don't throw trash on the ground.
He threw away all the old clothes.
Throw the ball over here, catch!

扔.zh: 这双鞋太破了，我打算扔掉。
扔.en: These shoes are too worn out; I plan to throw them away.

扔.zh: 他生气地把书扔在了桌子上。
扔.en: He angrily threw the book onto the table.

信心.zh: 这次考试让他失去了信心。
信心.en: This exam made him lose confidence.

信心.zh: 只要努力，信心自然会来。
信心.en: As long as you work hard, confidence will come naturally.
The coach is full of confidence in the team.

信心.zh: 她说话时声音很小，显得很没信心。
信心.en: She spoke in a very low voice, seeming quite lacking in confidence.

博士.zh: 他是我哥哥的博士导师。
博士.en: He is my brother's PhD advisor.

博士.zh: 我姐姐读博士的时候每天都很忙。
博士.en: When my sister was doing her PhD, she was very busy every day.

博士.zh: 虽然他是博士，但他说话特别谦虚。
博士.en: Although he is a PhD, he speaks very modestly.

博士.zh: 那个博士在化学方面很有名。
博士.en: That PhD is very famous in chemistry.

博士.zh: 我们公司新来了一个博士，专门研究人工智能。
博士.en: Our company just hired a PhD who specializes in AI.

故意.en: He didn't break it on purpose.

故意.zh: 她故意迟到，就是想让他着急。
故意.en: She deliberately arrived late just to make him anxious.

故意.zh: 因为弟弟故意捣乱，妈妈很生气。
故意.en: Because the younger brother deliberately made trouble, mom was very angry.

故意.zh: 你别故意说这种话气我。
故意.en: Don't intentionally say such things to anger me.

故意.zh: 我猜他是故意的，不然怎么会那么巧？
故意.en: I guess he did it on purpose, otherwise how could it be so coincidental?

闻.en: Smell this flower, it's so fragrant.

闻.zh: 我走进厨房就闻到了饭菜的味道。
闻.en: As soon as I walked into the kitchen, I smelled the food.

闻.zh: 虽然隔得很远，但他还是闻到了烟味。
闻.en: Although far away, he still smelled the smoke.

闻.zh: 她不喜欢闻烟味，所以不去有烟的地方。
闻.en: She doesn't like to smell cigarette smoke, so she doesn't go to places with smoke.

闻.zh: 你闻一下这牛奶，是不是坏了？
闻.en: Smell this milk, is it spoiled?

村.zh: 他们村很小只有几十户。
村.en: Their village is very small, only dozens of households.

村.zh: 我小时候住在村里面，空气特别好。
村.en: I lived in the village when I was young, the air was especially good.

村.zh: 虽然村里条件不好，但大家都很开心。
村.en: Although the conditions in the village are not good, everyone is very happy.

村.zh: 这个村因为风景美，吸引了很多游客。
村.en: This village attracts many tourists because of its beautiful scenery.

村.zh: 我们村去年修了一条新马路。
村.en: Our village built a new road last year.

看法.zh: 关于这个问题，大家的看法都不一样。
看法.en: Regarding this issue, everyone's opinions are different.

看法.zh: 虽然我的看法和他不同，但我尊重他。
看法.en: Although my opinion is different from his, I respect him.

看法.zh: 你有什么看法就直说，别藏着。
看法.en: If you have any opinion, say it directly, don't hide it.

看法.zh: 她对这件事的看法很乐观。
看法.en: Her view on this matter is very optimistic.

浪漫.zh: 他为了求婚准备了很浪漫的惊喜。
浪漫.en: He prepared a very romantic surprise for the proposal.

浪漫.zh: 虽然他很忙，但还是会做一些浪漫的小事。
浪漫.en: Although he is very busy, he still does some romantic little things.

浪漫.zh: 这部电影真的很浪漫，我看了两遍。
浪漫.en: This movie is really romantic, I watched it twice.

浪漫.zh: 浪漫不一定是花钱，用心更重要。
浪漫.en: Romance doesn't necessarily mean spending money, being attentive is more important.

减少.zh: 为了健康，他减少了吃糖的量。
减少.en: For health, he reduced the amount of sugar he eats.

减少.zh: 因为最近很忙，我减少了和朋友见面的次数。
减少.en: Because I've been busy lately, I've reduced the number of times I meet friends.

减少.zh: 公司决定减少加班时间。
减少.en: The company decided to reduce overtime hours.

缺.zh: 这个学校缺老师，尤其是数学老师。
缺.en: This school lacks teachers, especially math teachers.

缺.zh: 因为缺钱，他们只好取消了旅行计划。
缺.en: Because they lack money, they had to cancel the travel plan.
If you lack anything, just tell me.

缺.zh: 缺了维生素会影响健康。
缺.en: Lack of vitamins can affect health.

辛苦.zh: 妈妈每天工作都很辛苦，我们要多帮她。
辛苦.en: Mom works hard every day, we should help her more.

辛苦.zh: 虽然这份工作很辛苦，但工资还不错。
辛苦.en: Although this job is very hard, the salary is not bad.

辛苦.zh: 旅行虽然辛苦，但看到了美景就值得。
辛苦.en: Although traveling is tiring, it's worth it when you see beautiful scenery.

辛苦.zh: 他们辛苦了一年才攒够钱。
辛苦.en: They worked hard for a year to save enough money.

剩.zh: 菜剩下不少，我们带回家吧。
剩.en: There's quite a bit of leftover food, let's take it home.

剩.zh: 如果还有剩的钱，我们就买点水果。
剩.en: If there is leftover money, we'll buy some fruit.

剩.zh: 他不喜欢吃剩菜，所以每次都做刚刚好。
剩.en: He doesn't like to eat leftovers, so he cooks just enough each time.

剩.zh: 考试还剩五分钟，快点检查。
剩.en: There are five minutes left in the exam, quickly check.

正好.zh: 我正好也想吃火锅，咱们一起去吧。
正好.en: I also happen to want hotpot, let's go together.

正好.zh: 虽然没预约，但正好还有空位。
正好.en: Though no reservation, there happened to be empty seats.
This clothes size is just right.

正好.zh: 他正好在门口碰见了老王。
正好.en: He happened to bump into Lao Wang at the door.

回复.zh: 我昨天发了邮件，他还没回复。
回复.en: I sent an email yesterday, he hasn't replied yet.

回复.zh: 如果你收到消息，记得及时回复。
回复.en: If you receive the message, remember to reply promptly.

回复.zh: 他在微信上回复了一个笑脸。
回复.en: He replied with a smiley on WeChat.
The teacher replied to my question.

判断.zh: 根据现有证据，我们很难判断对错。
判断.en: Based on current evidence, it's hard to judge right or wrong.

判断.zh: 虽然看起来简单，但判断准确不容易。
判断.en: Although it looks simple, judging accurately is not easy.

判断.zh: 你怎么判断一个人可不可靠？
判断.en: How do you judge if someone is reliable?

相互.zh: 夫妻之间应该相互尊重和理解。
相互.en: Husband and wife should respect and understand each other.

相互.zh: 只有相互信任，合作才能成功。
相互.en: Only with mutual trust can cooperation succeed.
We added each other as friends.
This requires mutual cooperation from both sides.

弹.zh: 我小时候学过弹吉他，但现在忘了。
弹.en: I learned to play guitar as a kid, but now I forgot.

弹.zh: 周末我打算学弹尤克里里。
弹.en: This weekend I plan to learn to play the ukulele.

有趣.zh: 昨天看了一部有趣的电影，推荐给你。
有趣.en: I watched an interesting movie yesterday, recommend it to you.

有趣.zh: 虽然工作很累，但内容很有趣。
有趣.en: Although work is tiring, the content is interesting.
He talks in a very interesting way.

有趣.zh: 我遇到一个有趣的陌生人。

公里.en: The school is 2 km from my home.

公里.zh: 他每天跑步五公里，坚持了半年。
公里.en: He runs 5 km every day for half a year.

公里.zh: 因为路上堵车，十公里开了半小时。
公里.en: Because of traffic jam, 10 km took half an hour.

公里.zh: 这个城市很大，东西距离有三十公里。
公里.en: This city is big, east-west distance is 30 km.

公里.zh: 再走一公里就到地铁站了。
公里.en: Walk another 1 km and you'll reach the subway station.

工资.zh: 他嫌工资太低，就换了一份工作。
工资.en: He thought the salary was too low, so he changed jobs.

工资.zh: 虽然工资不高，但福利不错。
工资.en: Although the salary is not high, the benefits are good.

工资.zh: 工资卡里到账了五千块。
工资.en: 5000 yuan arrived in the salary card.
The company will raise salaries next month.

好处.zh: 学一门外语的好处是什么？
好处.en: What are the benefits of learning a foreign language?

好处.zh: 虽然贵一点，但好处是质量好。
好处.en: Though a bit expensive, the benefit is good quality.

好处.zh: 住在这里最大的好处是交通方便。
好处.en: The biggest advantage of living here is convenient transportation.

好处.zh: 你这样做对自己有什么好处？
好处.en: What benefit is there for yourself doing this?

庆祝.zh: 考试通过了，大家一起庆祝吧。
庆祝.en: We passed the exam, let's celebrate together.

庆祝.zh: 为了庆祝结婚纪念日，他买了蛋糕。
庆祝.en: To celebrate the wedding anniversary, he bought a cake.
They celebrate the New Year with fireworks.

伤心.zh: 因为宠物死了，她伤心了好几天。
伤心.en: Because her pet died, she was sad for several days.

伤心.zh: 别伤心了，明天会更好的。
伤心.en: Don't be sad, tomorrow will be better.

伤心.zh: 听到这个消息，她忍不住伤心地哭了。
伤心.en: Hearing the news, she couldn't help but cry sadly.

伤心.zh: 虽然事情过去了，但他一想起还是觉得很伤心。
伤心.en: Although it's over, he still feels very sad when he thinks about it.

眼前.en: The road ahead is very narrow.
Don't only focus on the present, think long-term.

眼前.zh: 一出门，眼前就是一片大海。
眼前.en: As soon as I went out, there was a vast sea before my eyes.

眼前.zh: 他现在眼前最大的问题是没钱交房租。
眼前.en: His biggest problem right now is having no money to pay rent.

眼前.zh: 如果你只看到眼前的困难，就很难坚持下去。
眼前.en: If you only see the difficulties in front of you, it's hard to keep going.

区别.en: What's the difference between these two words?

区别.zh: 虽然很像，但它们的区别很大。
区别.en: Although they look alike, their difference is big.

区别.zh: 你能看出这两幅画的区别吗？
区别.en: Can you tell the difference between these two paintings?

区别.zh: 北京和上海的气候有很大区别。
区别.en: The climates of Beijing and Shanghai are very different.

区别.zh: 我搞不清楚这两个手机型号的区别。
区别.en: I can't figure out the difference between these two phone models.

家长.en: The parent-teacher meeting is next week.
The teacher asked the parents to sign.

家长.zh: 很多家长都担心孩子的成绩。
家长.en: Many parents worry about their children's grades.

家长.zh: 学校要求家长每天接送孩子。
家长.en: The school requires parents to pick up and drop off their kids every day.

家长.zh: 作为家长，你应该多听听孩子的想法。
家长.en: As a parent, you should listen more to your child's thoughts.

将来.en: What do you want to do in the future?

将来.zh: 如果不努力，将来会后悔。
将来.en: If you don't work hard, you'll regret it in the future.

将来.zh: 他打算将来自己开一家店。
将来.en: He plans to open his own shop in the future.

将来.zh: 虽然现在辛苦，但将来一定会更好。
将来.en: Although it's hard now, it will definitely be better in the future.

将来.zh: 我们需要为将来做好充分的准备。
将来.en: We need to make full preparations for the future.

聊天.zh: 昨晚我和朋友聊天聊到很晚。
聊天.en: Last night I chatted with friends until late.

聊天.zh: 他喜欢一边喝茶一边聊天。
聊天.en: He likes to chat while drinking tea.

聊天.zh: 工作累了，我们经常聚在一起聊天。
聊天.en: When tired from work, we often gather to chat.

聊天.zh: 虽然很久没见，但一聊天还是那么开心。
聊天.en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, chatting still makes us happy.

自信.en: More practice will make you more confident.

自信.zh: 他说话时总是充满自信。
别害怕失败，要对自己有自信。
自信.en: Don't be afraid of failure, have confidence in yourself.

自信.zh: 经过这次比赛，我变得更加自信了。
自信.en: After this competition, I became more confident.

小说.zh: 他最近迷上了一部科幻小说。
小说.en: He's recently obsessed with a sci-fi novel.

小说.zh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会读一会儿小说。
小说.en: I read a novel for a while every night before bed.

小说.zh: 虽然这本小说很长，但情节非常吸引人。
小说.en: Although this novel is very long, the plot is very captivating.

稍.en: The soup is a bit salty.
Your clothes are a little too big.
Wait a moment, I'll be right there.

稍.zh: 这份报告稍后我会发给你。
稍.en: I'll send you this report a little later.

教师.en: He is a middle school teacher.

教师.zh: 学校需要招聘几名英语教师。
教师.en: The school needs to recruit a few English teachers.

教师.zh: 作为教师，不仅要教书，还要育人。
教师.en: As a teacher, you should not only teach but also educate.

鼓励.en: Mom encourages me to learn Chinese.

鼓励.zh: 虽然考试没考好，但老师还是鼓励了我。
鼓励.en: Although I didn't do well on the exam, the teacher still encouraged me.

鼓励.zh: 朋友的鼓励让我坚持下来了。
鼓励.en: My friend's encouragement made me persist.

鼓励.zh: 每次我遇到困难，她都会鼓励我继续努力。
鼓励.en: Every time I encounter difficulties, she encourages me to keep working hard.

工厂.zh: 我爸爸在一家汽车工厂上班。
工厂.en: My dad works at a car factory.

工厂.zh: 因为工厂搬走了，很多人失业了。
工厂.en: Because the factory moved away, many people lost their jobs.
The factory is still working at night.

工厂.zh: 以前这里是个工厂，现在变成了商场。
工厂.en: This used to be a factory, but now it has become a shopping mall.

理想.en: His ideal is to become a doctor.

理想.zh: 找一个理想的工作不容易。
理想.en: Finding an ideal job is not easy.

理想.zh: 虽然现实很残酷，但我还是不想放弃理想。
理想.en: Although reality is harsh, I still don't want to give up my ideal.

理想.zh: 每个人都有自己理想的生活。
理想.en: Everyone has their own ideal life.

指出.en: The teacher pointed out my mistake.

指出.zh: 在会议上，他指出了几个重要的问题。
指出.en: At the meeting, he pointed out several important issues.

指出.zh: 如果你看到问题，请直接指出来。
指出.en: If you see a problem, please point it out directly.

指出.zh: 专家指出这种做法对环境有害。
指出.en: Experts point out that this practice is harmful to the environment.

后悔.zh: 买这个包太贵了，我现在很后悔。
后悔.en: This bag was too expensive; I regret it now.

后悔.zh: 如果你现在不努力，以后会后悔的。
后悔.en: If you don't work hard now, you will regret it later.

后悔.zh: 她后悔当初没有听父母的建议。
后悔.en: She regrets not listening to her parents' advice at the time.

举办.zh: 今年奥运会将在巴黎举办。
举办.en: The Olympics will be held in Paris this year.

举办.zh: 因为天气不好，活动没有举办成功。
举办.en: Because of bad weather, the event was not successfully held.

举办.zh: 公司每年都会举办一次年会。
举办.en: The company holds an annual meeting every year.

感动.zh: 看到他的坚持，我特别感动。
感动.en: Seeing his perseverance, I was very moved.

感动.zh: 虽然只是小事，但她的行为让我很感动。
感动.en: Although it was a small thing, her behavior moved me a lot.

获.zh: 在这次比赛中，我们队获了第一名。
获.en: In this competition, our team got first place.

获.zh: 因为表现优秀，他获了公司的表扬。
获.en: Because of excellent performance, he received praise from the company.

获.zh: 经过努力，他终于获了出国留学的机会。
获.en: After hard work, he finally got the opportunity to study abroad.

提到.zh: 在聊天的时候，我提到了那件事。
提到.en: While chatting, I mentioned that matter.

提到.zh: 如果你提到他的名字，大家都会笑。
提到.en: If you mention his name, everyone will laugh.

提到.zh: 昨天的会议上，老板提到了新的计划。
提到.en: At yesterday's meeting, the boss mentioned the new plan.

不如.en: I am not as good as you.

不如.zh: 与其在家看电视，不如出去走走。
不如.en: Rather than watching TV at home, might as well go out for a walk.

不如.zh: 既然这么累，不如休息一下。
不如.en: Since you are so tired, you might as well rest.
Walking is not as fast as cycling.

不如.zh: 这家餐厅的菜不如那家好吃。
不如.en: The food at this restaurant is not as delicious as that one.

顾客.zh: 顾客您好，请问需要什么？
顾客.en: Hello customer, what can I help you with?

顾客.zh: 这家店的顾客总是很多，因为服务好。
顾客.en: This store always has many customers because the service is good.

顾客.zh: 顾客们排队等着结账，有点不耐烦了。
顾客.en: The customers are waiting in line to pay, getting a bit impatient.

顾客.zh: 为了吸引更多顾客，他们推出了打折活动。
顾客.en: To attract more customers, they launched a discount promotion.

顾客.zh: 虽然价格高了点，但老顾客还是愿意来。
顾客.en: Although the price is a bit higher, regular customers still want to come.

流行.en: This song is very popular lately.

流行.zh: 今年流行穿宽松的衣服，很舒服。
流行.en: This year, wearing loose clothes is trendy and very comfortable.

流行.zh: 我不太喜欢流行的东西，觉得容易过时。
流行.en: I don't really like trendy things because they go out of style easily.

流行.zh: 因为这款手机很流行，所以很难买到。
流行.en: Because this phone is very popular, it's hard to buy.

流行.zh: 流行不一定代表好，适合自己的才最重要。
流行.en: Being trendy doesn't necessarily mean good; what suits you is most important.

支付.en: What payment method are you using?

支付.zh: 现在大家出门都不带现金，直接手机支付。
支付.en: Nowadays people don't carry cash when going out; they pay directly with their phones.

支付.zh: 如果支付失败，请检查网络连接。
支付.en: If the payment fails, please check the network connection.

支付.zh: 我昨天用信用卡支付了房租，很方便。
支付.en: I paid the rent with a credit card yesterday; it was very convenient.

支付.zh: 虽然支付方式很多，但我还是习惯用现金。
支付.en: Although there are many payment methods, I'm still used to using cash.

赶快.en: Come eat quickly, the food is getting cold!

赶快.zh: 你要赶快决定，不然机会就没了。
赶快.en: You need to decide quickly, or the opportunity will be gone.

赶快.zh: 外面下雨了，我们赶快回家吧。
赶快.en: It's raining outside, let's hurry home.

赶快.zh: 如果不想迟到，就赶快起床准备。
赶快.en: If you don't want to be late, hurry up and get ready.

赶快.zh: 他赶快跑过去，但还是没赶上公交车。
赶快.en: He hurried over, but still missed the bus.

整理.en: I need to tidy up the room a bit.

整理.zh: 她花了一个小时整理衣橱，扔掉了很多旧衣服。
整理.en: She spent an hour organizing the wardrobe and threw away a lot of old clothes.

整理.zh: 请你把这些文件整理好，放到抽屉里。
整理.en: Please organize these documents and put them in the drawer.

整理.zh: 平时多整理一下，找东西的时候就方便了。
整理.en: If you tidy up regularly, it will be easier to find things.

整理.zh: 因为资料太乱，我花了一整天整理电脑里的文件。
整理.en: Because the files were too messy, I spent a whole day organizing the documents on my computer.

丰富.en: This book has very rich content.

丰富.zh: 多吃水果蔬菜，营养才丰富。
丰富.en: Eat more fruits and vegetables to get rich nutrition.

丰富.zh: 这次旅行让我增长了见识，生活更丰富了。
丰富.en: This trip broadened my horizons and made my life richer.

丰富.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是想办法丰富自己的业余生活。
丰富.en: Although he is very busy with work, he still finds ways to enrich his leisure time.

丰富.zh: 这家餐厅的菜单很丰富，从沙拉到牛排都有。
丰富.en: This restaurant's menu is very diverse, ranging from salads to steaks.

答.en: He thought for a long time before answering.

答.zh: 老师问了一个难题，没人能答对。
答.en: The teacher asked a difficult question, and no one could answer correctly.

答.zh: 如果你知道答案，就快点答吧。
答.en: If you know the answer, just say it quickly.

答.zh: 虽然问题很简单，但他答得非常认真。
答.en: Although the question was very simple, he answered it very seriously.

熊.en: There is a big bear in the zoo.

熊.zh: 孩子睡觉时喜欢抱着小熊玩偶。
熊.en: The child likes to hug a little bear plush toy when sleeping.

熊.zh: 在森林里遇到熊，千万别装死。
熊.en: If you encounter a bear in the forest, never play dead.

熊.zh: 这只熊猫胖乎乎的，特别可爱。
熊.en: This panda is chubby and very cute.

熊.zh: 虽然熊看起来笨笨的，但其实它们很聪明。
熊.en: Although bears look clumsy, they are actually very smart.

原谅.zh: 请原谅我的粗心，下次不会了。
原谅.en: Please forgive my carelessness; it won't happen again.

原谅.zh: 虽然他说了对不起，但她还是不肯原谅他。
原谅.en: Although he said sorry, she still refused to forgive him.

原谅.zh: 如果做错了事，就要诚恳道歉，争取对方原谅。
原谅.en: If you did something wrong, you should apologize sincerely and try to earn the other's forgiveness.

原谅.zh: 原谅别人其实也是放过自己，别总记着不开心的事。
原谅.en: Forgiving others is actually letting yourself go; don't always dwell on unhappy things.

肚子.zh: 昨天吃太多，现在肚子好胀。
肚子.en: I ate too much yesterday, and now my stomach feels bloated.
He laughed so hard that his stomach hurt.

肚子.zh: 早上没吃早饭，肚子一直咕咕叫。
肚子.en: I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so my stomach has been rumbling.

肚子.zh: 跑步前别吃太多，不然肚子会不舒服。
肚子.en: Don't eat too much before running, or your stomach will feel uncomfortable.

大赛.zh: 这次大赛他得了第一名。
大赛.en: He won first place in this competition.

大赛.zh: 我报名参加了那个唱歌大赛。
大赛.en: I signed up for that singing competition.

大赛.zh: 虽然大赛很难，但我还是想试试。
大赛.en: Although the competition is tough, I still want to try.

大赛.zh: 妹妹为准备大赛每天练习到很晚。
大赛.en: My sister practices until late every day to prepare for the competition.

大赛.zh: 大赛的结果明天才公布，大家都很紧张。
大赛.en: The results of the competition won't be announced until tomorrow, so everyone is very nervous.

辣.zh: 我喜欢吃辣，但胃受不了。
辣.en: I like to eat spicy food, but my stomach can't handle it.

辣.zh: 四川菜又麻又辣，特别过瘾。
辣.en: Sichuan food is numb and spicy, very satisfying.

辣.zh: 如果你觉得不够辣，可以再加点辣椒油。
辣.en: If you think it's not spicy enough, you can add some chili oil.

作者.en: Who is the author of this book?

作者.zh: 我喜欢那位作者写的所有小说。
作者.en: I like all the novels written by that author.

作者.zh: 作者在最后一章里揭开了谜底。
作者.en: The author revealed the answer in the last chapter.

作者.zh: 听说作者今天会来书店签名。
作者.en: I heard the author is coming to the bookstore today for a signing.

作者.zh: 这篇文章的作者是我的大学同学。
作者.en: The author of this article is my college classmate.

质量.en: This piece of clothing has good quality.

质量.zh: 他们公司的产品质量很有保障。
质量.en: The quality of their company's products is very reliable.

质量.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但质量很差。
质量.en: Although the price is cheap, the quality is very poor.

质量.zh: 你要注意食物的质量，别买过期的。
质量.en: You need to pay attention to the quality of the food; don't buy expired ones.

质量.zh: 这个项目的质量还需要再检查一遍。
质量.en: The quality of this project still needs to be checked again.

到来.zh: 春天的到来让大家都开心。
到来.en: The arrival of spring makes everyone happy.

到来.zh: 我们准备好了迎接客人的到来。
到来.en: We are ready to welcome the arrival of the guests.

到来.zh: 随着夏天的到来，天气越来越热。
到来.en: With the arrival of summer, the weather gets hotter and hotter.

到来.zh: 他一直在等那个机会的到来。
到来.en: He has been waiting for the arrival of that opportunity.

到来.zh: 新老师的到来给班级带来了很多变化。
到来.en: The arrival of the new teacher brought a lot of changes to the class.

愉快.zh: 我们聊得非常愉快，差点忘了时间。
愉快.en: We chatted very happily and almost forgot the time.

愉快.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但同事之间相处很愉快。
愉快.en: Although work is busy, the colleagues get along very pleasantly.

愉快.zh: 这次聚会大家都很愉快，下次还要来。
愉快.en: Everyone was very happy at this gathering; we'll come again next time.

遇.zh: 我在路上遇见了老同学。
遇.en: I ran into an old classmate on the street.

遇.zh: 我们每次遇见了都会聊很久。
遇.en: Every time we meet, we chat for a long time.

遇.zh: 如果你遇到困难，可以来找我帮忙。
遇.en: If you encounter difficulties, you can come to me for help.

遇.zh: 那天下雨，我正好遇见了她。
遇.en: It rained that day, and I happened to run into her.

寄.en: I sent a letter to you.

寄.zh: 这个包裹寄到北京要几天？
寄.en: How many days does it take to send this package to Beijing?

寄.zh: 他把礼物寄给了远方的朋友。
寄.en: He sent the gift to a friend far away.

寄.zh: 网上买的东西三天就寄到了。
寄.en: The things I bought online arrived in three days.

寄.zh: 因为太忙了，我还没寄出那个文件。
寄.en: Because I'm too busy, I haven't sent out that document yet.

准确.en: This clock's time is not accurate.

准确.zh: 天气预报说今天下雨，果然很准确。
准确.en: The weather forecast said it would rain today, and it was indeed very accurate.

准确.zh: 你要准确地把数字写下来，不能出错。
准确.en: You need to write down the numbers accurately, without mistakes.

准确.zh: 他用了很长时间才找到准确的地址。
准确.en: It took him a long time to find the accurate address.

负责人.en: Who is the person in charge here?
The person in charge of the project is on a business trip.

负责人.zh: 这个问题你得找负责人解决。
负责人.en: You need to find the person in charge to solve this problem.

负责人.zh: 每个部门都有一位负责人。
负责人.en: Each department has a person in charge.

负责人.zh: 负责人说下周三之前必须交报告。
负责人.en: The person in charge said the report must be submitted before next Wednesday.

详细.en: Please say it a bit more detailed.

详细.zh: 他把整个计划详细地解释了一遍。
详细.en: He explained the whole plan in detail.

详细.zh: 我需要一份详细的报告。
虽然时间很紧，但他还是给了我们详细的说明。
详细.en: Although time was tight, he still gave us a detailed explanation.

详细.zh: 你能详细介绍一下你的家乡吗？
详细.en: Can you introduce your hometown in detail?

降.zh: 飞机即将降落在北京国际机场。
降.en: The plane is about to land at Beijing International Airport.
House prices have dropped a bit recently.

降.zh: 因为暴雨，能见度降得很低。
降.en: Because of the heavy rain, visibility dropped very low.

降.zh: 他降职了，现在做普通员工。
降.en: He was demoted, now an ordinary employee.

禁止.zh: 公园里禁止遛狗和骑自行车。
禁止.en: Walking dogs and riding bikes are prohibited in the park.

禁止.zh: 学校禁止学生带手机进教室。
禁止.en: The school prohibits students from bringing phones into the classroom.

禁止.zh: 虽然禁止拍照，但他还是悄悄拍了几张。
禁止.en: Although photography is prohibited, he still secretly took a few photos.

禁止.zh: 这条路上禁止停车，否则会被罚款。
禁止.en: Parking is prohibited on this road, otherwise you'll be fined.

睡着.en: I fell asleep very late last night.

睡着.zh: 孩子听故事听着听着就睡着了。
睡着.en: The child fell asleep while listening to the story.

睡着.zh: 她太累了，一躺下就睡着了。
睡着.en: She was so tired that she fell asleep as soon as she lay down.

睡着.zh: 虽然房间很吵，但他还是很快睡着了。
睡着.en: Although the room was noisy, he still fell asleep quickly.

睡着.zh: 你睡着的时候手机响了好几次。
睡着.en: Your phone rang several times while you were asleep.

度过.en: How do you plan to spend the holiday?

度过.zh: 我们在一起度过了一段快乐的时光。
度过.en: We spent a happy time together.

度过.zh: 他独自一人在国外度过了春节。
度过.en: He spent the Spring Festival alone abroad.

度过.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我们还是度过了一个愉快的周末。
度过.en: Although work was busy, we still had a pleasant weekend.

度过.zh: 这个难关我们一起度过。
度过.en: We'll get through this difficulty together.

冷静.zh: 遇到问题要冷静思考，不要冲动。
冷静.en: When encountering problems, think calmly, don't be impulsive.

冷静.zh: 她总是能保持冷静的态度。
冷静.en: She can always maintain a calm attitude.

冷静.zh: 虽然他很生气，但还是努力让自己冷静下来。
冷静.en: Although he was very angry, he still tried to calm himself down.

冷静.zh: 我们需要冷静地分析一下现在的局势。
冷静.en: We need to calmly analyze the current situation.

袋.zh: 超市提供免费的塑料袋。
袋.en: The supermarket provides free plastic bags.
I bought a bag of rice.

袋.zh: 如果你去购物，记得带个袋。
袋.en: If you go shopping, remember to bring a bag.
He carried a bag of flour on his shoulder.

购物.zh: 现在很多人喜欢在网上购物。
购物.en: Now many people like shopping online.
The shopping mall is packed with people.

购物.zh: 因为打折，她今天购物花了很多钱。
购物.en: Because of the sale, she spent a lot of money shopping today.

购物.zh: 购物之前最好列个清单。
购物.en: It's best to make a list before shopping.

数量.zh: 请控制一下生产的数量。
我们需要的数量是五百个。
数量.en: The quantity we need is five hundred.

数量.zh: 虽然数量不多，但质量很好。
数量.en: Although the quantity is not large, the quality is very good.

数量.zh: 你能告诉我具体的数量吗？
数量.en: Can you tell me the specific quantity?

男性.en: This company has many male employees.

男性.zh: 男性通常比女性更注重实用性。
男性.en: Men usually care more about practicality than women.

男性.zh: 这个产品的目标客户是男性。
男性.en: The target customers of this product are male.

男性.zh: 虽然男性力气大，但女性更细心。
男性.en: Although men are stronger, women are more attentive.

男性.zh: 招聘广告要求男性优先。
男性.en: The job advertisement gives priority to males.

早餐.en: I eat breakfast at seven every day.

早餐.zh: 今天的早餐是面包和牛奶。
早餐.en: Today's breakfast is bread and milk.

早餐.zh: 虽然时间很紧，我还是吃了早餐。
早餐.en: Even though time was tight, I still ate breakfast.

早餐.zh: 周末我喜欢做一顿丰盛的早餐。
早餐.en: On weekends, I like to make a hearty breakfast.

早餐.zh: 你早餐想吃什么？我们去楼下那家店吧。
早餐.en: What do you want for breakfast? Let's go to the shop downstairs.

图片.en: Please make the picture a bit larger.

图片.zh: 我发了几张图片给你，你看到了吗？
图片.en: I sent you a few pictures, did you see them?

图片.zh: 因为网络不好，图片加载得很慢。
图片.en: Because the internet is slow, the pictures load very slowly.

图片.zh: 他手机里存了很多旅行的图片。
图片.en: He has many travel pictures saved on his phone.

相比.zh: 相比昨天，今天暖和多了。
相比.en: Compared to yesterday, today is much warmer.

相比.zh: 这两款手机相比，哪款更好？
相比.en: Compared to these two phones, which one is better?

相比.zh: 相比跑步，我更喜欢游泳。
相比.en: Compared to running, I prefer swimming.

相比.zh: 虽然价格贵一些，但相比质量还是值得的。
相比.en: Although it's more expensive, compared to the quality it's still worth it.

相比.zh: 相比之前的工作，这份工作轻松了不少。
相比.en: Compared to my previous job, this job is much easier.

勇敢.en: Be brave, don't be afraid of failure.

勇敢.zh: 他勇敢地跳进了河里救人。
勇敢.en: He bravely jumped into the river to save someone.

勇敢.zh: 虽然很害怕，但他还是勇敢地站了出来。
勇敢.en: Although he was scared, he still bravely stepped forward.

勇敢.zh: 孩子们在黑暗中表现得很勇敢。
勇敢.en: The children behaved very bravely in the dark.

购买.zh: 我在网上购买了一本书。
购买前请仔细阅读说明。
购买.en: Please read the instructions carefully before purchasing.

购买.zh: 他购买了很多生活用品。
购买.en: He purchased a lot of daily necessities.

购买.zh: 如果你喜欢，可以点击这里购买。
购买.en: If you like it, you can click here to purchase.

购买.zh: 因为打折，很多人都在购买这款产品。
购买.en: Because of the discount, many people are purchasing this product.

乘.en: I take the subway to work.

乘.zh: 你可以乘公交车到那里。
乘.en: You can take the bus to get there.
Let's take a plane to Shanghai.

乘.zh: 如果时间够，我们也可以乘火车。
乘.en: If there's enough time, we could also take the train.

乘.zh: 他每天早上乘电梯上楼。
乘.en: He takes the elevator upstairs every morning.

订.zh: 你想订什么口味的蛋糕？
订.en: What flavor cake do you want to order?

订.zh: 请帮我订两张明天的电影票。
订.en: Please help me book two movie tickets for tomorrow.

订.zh: 因为假期人多，最好提前订位。
订.en: Because there are many people during the holiday, it's best to reserve a seat in advance.

订.zh: 他订了外卖，半小时后送到。
订.en: He ordered takeout, and it will be delivered in half an hour.

早晨.en: The morning air is very fresh.

早晨.zh: 我习惯早晨喝一杯咖啡。
早晨.en: I'm used to drinking a cup of coffee in the morning.

早晨.zh: 每天早晨他都去公园跑步。
早晨.en: He goes running in the park every morning.

早晨.zh: 今天早晨我起晚了，差点迟到。
早晨.en: I got up late this morning and almost arrived late.

早晨.zh: 虽然早晨很冷，但他还是坚持锻炼。
早晨.en: Although it was cold in the morning, he still insisted on exercising.

卫生.zh: 这家餐厅的卫生条件不错。
卫生.en: The hygiene conditions at this restaurant are good.

卫生.zh: 厨房的卫生需要每天打扫。
卫生.en: The kitchen needs to be cleaned daily for hygiene.

卫生.zh: 因为卫生检查不合格，那家店关门了。
卫生.en: Because it failed the hygiene inspection, that shop closed down.

卫生.zh: 小孩子要养成讲卫生的好习惯。
卫生.en: Children should develop good hygiene habits.

巧克力.zh: 这块巧克力是黑巧克力。
巧克力.en: This piece of chocolate is dark chocolate.

巧克力.zh: 她送了我一盒巧克力当礼物。
巧克力.en: She gave me a box of chocolate as a gift.

巧克力.zh: 巧克力吃多了容易发胖。
巧克力.en: Eating too much chocolate can easily make you gain weight.

巧克力.zh: 因为天气太热，巧克力都化了。
巧克力.en: Because the weather is too hot, the chocolate melted.

加强.zh: 公司决定加强安全管理。
加强.en: The company decided to strengthen safety management.

加强.zh: 为了应对疫情，政府加强了防控措施。
加强.en: To deal with the pandemic, the government strengthened prevention and control measures.

加强.zh: 他最近在加强英语口语练习，因为要出国。
加强.en: He's been intensifying his spoken English practice lately because he's going abroad.

加强.zh: 球队通过训练加强了团队合作，所以成绩提高了。
加强.en: The team strengthened teamwork through training, so their performance improved.

做法.en: This approach is not quite right.
I don't agree with his approach.

做法.zh: 这个菜的做法很简单，你试试看。
做法.en: The recipe for this dish is very simple, give it a try.

做法.zh: 他们那种做法太冒险了，我们得小心。
做法.en: That method of theirs is too risky; we need to be careful.

做法.zh: 老师教了我们一种新的解题做法，效果很好。
做法.en: The teacher taught us a new way to solve problems, and it works really well.

骄傲.zh: 我为我的孩子感到骄傲。
骄傲.en: I am proud of my child.

骄傲.zh: 骄傲使人落后，谦虚使人进步。
骄傲.en: Pride makes one fall behind, modesty makes one progress.

骄傲.zh: 她得了第一名，全家都很骄傲。
骄傲.en: She came in first, and the whole family is very proud.

骄傲.zh: 不要因为一点成绩就骄傲，要继续努力。
骄傲.en: Don't get proud over a little achievement; keep working hard.

歌手.zh: 我最喜欢的歌手是周杰伦。
歌手.en: My favorite singer is Jay Chou.

歌手.zh: 这位歌手的新专辑下个月发行。
歌手.en: This singer's new album will be released next month.

歌手.zh: 很多歌手在出道前都参加过比赛。
歌手.en: Many singers participated in competitions before their debut.

作家.zh: 这个作家写的书很有意思。
作家.en: The books written by this author are very interesting.

作家.zh: 那位作家最近得了文学奖。
作家.en: That writer recently won a literary award.

作家.zh: 作家需要经常观察生活，才能写出好作品。
作家.en: Writers need to observe life often to produce good works.

作家.zh: 他从小就想当作家，现在终于实现了梦想。
作家.en: He wanted to become a writer since childhood, and now he has finally realized his dream.

各地.en: People all over the country are celebrating.

各地.zh: 这道菜在各地都很流行。
来自各地的朋友聚在一起吃饭。

亚洲.en: Asian food culture is very rich and diverse.

例如.en: Many animals, such as cats and dogs, are very cute.

例如.en: He has many hobbies, such as painting and singing.

大大.zh: 这房子大大超出了预算。
大大.en: This house greatly exceeded the budget.

大大.zh: 你只要多练习，就能大大进步。
大大.en: If you just practice more, you can improve greatly.

大大.zh: 有了新地铁，出门方便大大提高了。
大大.en: With the new subway, travel convenience has greatly increased.

大大.zh: 这次改革大大改善了员工的工作环境。
大大.en: This reform greatly improved the working environment for employees.

大大.zh: 他不但没生气，反而大大夸了我一顿。
大大.en: He not only didn't get angry, but instead greatly praised me.

帽子.en: It's cold outside, remember to wear a hat.

帽子.zh: 他买了一顶红色的帽子送给她。
帽子.en: He bought a red hat and gave it to her.

帽子.zh: 你别随便给人扣帽子，要有证据。
帽子.en: Don't just label people arbitrarily; you need evidence.

帽子.zh: 这顶帽子有点大，戴着总是往下滑。
帽子.en: This hat is a bit big, it always slides down when I wear it.

夜晚.en: The stars are very bright at night.

夜晚.zh: 我喜欢在安静的夜晚看书。
夜晚.en: I like to read books in the quiet night.

夜晚.zh: 我们决定在夜晚去海边散步。
夜晚.en: We decided to take a walk by the sea at night.

夜晚.zh: 一到夜晚，这条街就变得特别热闹。
夜晚.en: As soon as night falls, this street becomes especially lively.

夜晚.zh: 他常常工作到深夜，几乎每个夜晚都睡得很晚。
夜晚.en: He often works late into the night, sleeping very late almost every night.

抬.zh: 他们俩一起把箱子抬上楼。
抬.en: The two of them carried the box upstairs together.
Lift your foot, I'll sweep the floor.

抬.zh: 伤员被大家小心地抬上了救护车。
抬.en: The injured person was carefully carried onto the ambulance by everyone.

抬.zh: 别总抬杠，好好听人家说完。
抬.en: Don't always argue for the sake of arguing; listen to what others have to say first.

主意.en: I thought of a good idea.

主意.zh: 你拿主意吧，我们都听你的。
主意.en: You make the decision; we'll all follow you.

主意.zh: 大家七嘴八舌，谁也拿不定主意。
主意.en: Everyone was talking at once, and no one could make up their mind.

主意.zh: 他主意特别多，每次聚会都靠他策划。
主意.en: He has a lot of ideas; every party relies on his planning.

主意.zh: 这件事得慎重考虑，别轻易改变主意。
主意.en: This matter needs careful consideration; don't change your mind easily.

桶.en: The water bucket is empty; go get some water.

桶.zh: 这桶油够我们吃两个月。
桶.en: This barrel of oil is enough for us to eat for two months.

桶.zh: 他把脏衣服都扔进桶里泡着。
桶.en: He threw all the dirty clothes into the bucket to soak.

桶.zh: 楼下有个垃圾桶，你顺手带下去吧。
桶.en: There's a trash can downstairs; take it down when you go.

桶.zh: 工地上一桶一桶的水泥正等着搅拌呢。
桶.en: Barrels of cement are waiting to be mixed at the construction site.

街道.zh: 街道两边种满了樱花树。
街道.en: Both sides of the street are planted with cherry blossom trees.

街道.zh: 你沿着这条街道直走，就能看到超市。
街道.en: Walk straight along this street, and you'll see the supermarket.

街道.zh: 每到周末，街道上就挤满了逛街的人。
街道.en: Every weekend, the streets are crowded with shoppers.

街道.zh: 我们社区的街道办最近组织了免费体检活动。
街道.en: The street office in our community recently organized a free health check-up event.

晚餐.zh: 我 usually 自己做晚餐吃。
今晚的晚餐特别丰盛，有鱼有虾。
晚餐.en: Tonight's dinner is especially sumptuous, with fish and shrimp.

晚餐.zh: 他邀请我去他家吃晚餐，我答应了。
晚餐.en: He invited me to his place for dinner, and I agreed.

晚餐.zh: 虽然下班很晚，但我还是会和家人一起吃晚餐。
晚餐.en: Even though I get off work very late, I still have dinner with my family.

高速.en: You can't stop on the highway.

高速.zh: 我们坐高铁比开高速快多了。
高速.en: Taking the high-speed rail is much faster than driving on the highway.

高速.zh: 今天高速堵车，我迟到了一个小时。
高速.en: There was a traffic jam on the highway today, so I was an hour late.

高速.zh: 开车上高速之前最好检查一下轮胎。
高速.en: It's best to check the tires before driving onto the highway.

高速.zh: 这条新修的高速公路大大缩短了两座城市的距离。
高速.en: This newly built expressway greatly shortens the distance between the two cities.

观看.en: Did you watch the game last night?

观看.zh: 因为下雨，我们只能在家观看视频。
观看.en: Because it was raining, we could only watch videos at home.

观看.zh: 他喜欢在周末观看纪录片。
观看.en: He likes to watch documentaries on weekends.

观看.zh: 虽然票很贵，但我们还是去现场观看了演唱会。
观看.en: Although the tickets were expensive, we still went to watch the concert live.

大哥.en: My older brother is thirty years old this year.

大哥.zh: 大哥，这件事你帮我想想办法。
大哥.en: Big brother, help me think of a way to handle this.

大哥.zh: 他在家里排行老大，我们都叫他大哥。
大哥.en: He is the eldest at home, so we all call him big brother.

大哥.zh: 虽然大哥工作很忙，但他常抽空陪家人。
大哥.en: Although big brother is very busy with work, he often makes time for his family.

此外.en: In addition, he can also speak English.

此外.zh: 这家店东西便宜，此外服务也好。
此外.en: This store has cheap things, and besides that, the service is good.

此外.zh: 我学了两年中文，此外还学过一点日语。
此外.en: I studied Chinese for two years, and in addition, I learned a bit of Japanese.

此外.zh: 他不仅成绩好，此外还参加了许多活动。
此外.en: He not only has good grades, but also participates in many activities.

此外.zh: 我们需要买食物和水，此外还要准备一些药品。
此外.en: We need to buy food and water, and in addition, we need to prepare some medicine.

奖金.en: This year's bonus is a lot.

奖金.zh: 他拿到了一笔不小的奖金。
因为业绩好，公司发了年终奖金。
奖金.en: Because of good performance, the company gave out year-end bonuses.

奖金.zh: 老板说，如果项目成功，每人都有奖金。
奖金.en: The boss said that if the project succeeds, everyone will get a bonus.

奖金.zh: 虽然奖金不多，但也是对工作的肯定。
奖金.en: Although the bonus is not much, it is still an affirmation of work.

盐.en: There's too much salt in this dish.

盐.zh: 医生让我少吃盐，对身体好。
盐.en: The doctor told me to eat less salt; it's good for health.

盐.zh: 煮汤的时候，别忘了加一点盐。
盐.en: When making soup, don't forget to add a little salt.

盐.zh: 超市里的盐种类很多，有海盐和湖盐。
盐.en: There are many kinds of salt in the supermarket, such as sea salt and lake salt.

功夫.en: He has practiced kung fu for ten years.
Learning kung fu requires a lot of patience.

功夫.zh: 他花了很大功夫才学会做饭。
功夫.en: He put a lot of effort into learning how to cook.

功夫.zh: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针。
功夫.en: With constant effort, an iron rod can be ground into a needle.

功夫.zh: 这部电影里的功夫场面非常精彩。
功夫.en: The kung fu scenes in this movie are very exciting.

少年.zh: 他是个热爱运动的少年。
这个少年非常聪明，成绩很好。
少年.en: This teenager is very smart and gets good grades.

少年.zh: 少年时期是一个人成长的关键阶段。
少年.en: Adolescence is a key stage in a person's growth.

少年.zh: 我认识的那个少年现在已经成为一名医生了。
少年.en: That teenager I knew has now become a doctor.

少年.zh: 虽然他是少年，但做事已经非常成熟。
少年.en: Although he is a teenager, he already handles things very maturely.

减.en: I lost a jin (0.5 kg) of weight today.
This number minus three equals five.

减.zh: 为了健康，他减少了熬夜次数。
减.en: For his health, he reduced the number of times he stays up late.

减.zh: 公司计划明年减掉一些不必要的开支。
减.en: The company plans to cut some unnecessary expenses next year.

减.zh: 虽然工资没减，但福利少了一些。
减.en: Although the salary hasn't been reduced, the benefits have decreased a bit.

难受.zh: 听到这个消息，他特别难受。
难受.en: After hearing this news, he felt particularly upset.

难受.zh: 天气太热了，待在屋里很难受。
难受.en: The weather is too hot; staying inside is very uncomfortable.

难受.zh: 看到朋友难过，我心里也很难受。
难受.en: Seeing my friend sad, I also feel distressed inside.

难受.zh: 虽然考试没考好，但不要太难受，下次努力就好。
难受.en: Although you didn't do well on the exam, don't be too upset; just work hard next time.

基本上.zh: 这个工作基本上做完了。
我基本上每天都去健身房。
基本上.en: I basically go to the gym every day.

基本上.zh: 虽然还有些小问题，但基本上已经解决了。
基本上.en: Although there are still some small issues, it's basically solved.

基本上.zh: 这个计划基本上是按照我们的想法来制定的。
基本上.en: This plan was basically made according to our ideas.

民族.en: We are the same ethnic group.

民族.zh: 中国有很多民族，大家都生活得很和谐。
民族.en: China has many ethnic groups, and everyone lives harmoniously.

民族.zh: 每个民族都有自己的文化。
民族.en: Each ethnic group has its own culture.

民族.zh: 虽然我们是不同的民族，但相处得很好。
民族.en: Although we are different ethnic groups, we get along well.

民族.zh: 我特别想了解这个民族的历史。
民族.en: I especially want to learn about the history of this ethnic group.

航班.zh: 去上海的航班明天早上八点起飞。
航班.en: The flight to Shanghai departs tomorrow at 8 am.

航班.zh: 因为天气不好，很多航班都取消了。
航班.en: Because the weather is bad, many flights have been cancelled.

航班.zh: 航班上提供的餐食不错。
航班.en: The meals provided on the flight are good.

偶尔.en: I occasionally drink a little alcohol.

偶尔.zh: 他偶尔会去健身房锻炼身体。
偶尔.en: He occasionally goes to the gym to exercise.

偶尔.zh: 虽然我很少吃甜食，但偶尔也会吃一点。
偶尔.en: Although I rarely eat sweets, I occasionally have a little.

偶尔.zh: 我偶尔会想起以前的事情。
偶尔.en: I occasionally think about past things.

约会.zh: 他今晚和女朋友有个约会。
约会.en: He has a date with his girlfriend tonight.
Being late for a date is not good.

约会.zh: 因为我明天要加班，所以只能取消约会。
约会.en: Because I have to work overtime tomorrow, I have to cancel the date.

约会.zh: 他们第一次约会是在咖啡厅。
约会.en: Their first date was at a coffee shop.

商品.zh: 网上买的商品两天就到了。
商品.en: The product bought online arrived in two days.

商品.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但商品质量很好。
商品.en: Although the price is cheap, the product quality is very good.

商品.zh: 这家店的商品种类很多。
商品.en: This store has many kinds of products.

末.en: What do you want to do on the weekend?

末.zh: 这个月末我们有一个考试。
末.en: We have an exam at the end of this month.
It's the end of the year, work is busy.

末.zh: 因为快期末了，所以大家都在复习。
末.en: Because the end of term is near, everyone is reviewing.

细.zh: 他做事很细心，从不马虎。
细.en: He is very careful in doing things, never careless.

细.zh: 虽然这个细节很小，但是很重要。
细.en: Although this detail is very small, it is very important.
She has long and thin hair.

受不了.en: I really can't stand it anymore.

受不了.zh: 这种噪音我完全受不了。
受不了.en: I can't stand this kind of noise at all.
It's so hot I can't stand it.

受不了.zh: 因为天天加班，他实在受不了了。
受不了.en: Because of working overtime every day, he really can't stand it.
I can't stand her constant nagging.

厚.zh: 冬天要穿厚一点的衣服。
厚.en: In winter, you need to wear thicker clothes.

厚.zh: 虽然雪很厚，但路还是可以走。
厚.en: Although the snow is thick, the road is still passable.

厚.zh: 他脸皮很厚，怎么说都不听。
厚.en: He is thick-skinned, doesn't listen no matter what.

护士.en: The nurse will come right away.

护士.zh: 她是一名很有耐心的护士。
护士.en: She is a very patient nurse.

护士.zh: 因为护士很细心，所以病人恢复得快。
护士.en: Because the nurse is very careful, the patient recovers quickly.

参观.zh: 明天我们去参观博物馆。
参观.en: Tomorrow we are going to visit the museum.

参观.zh: 我打算周末参观那个新开的科技馆。
参观.en: I plan to visit that newly opened science museum on the weekend.

参观.zh: 因为时间不够，我们只能参观两个景点。
参观.en: Because time is limited, we can only visit two scenic spots.

参观.zh: 这次参观让我学到了很多历史知识。
参观.en: This visit taught me a lot of historical knowledge.

参观.zh: 如果你有空，可以和我们一起参观工厂。
参观.en: If you have time, you can join us to visit the factory.

顺便.en: I bought a bottle of water while I was at it.

顺便.zh: 你去超市的话，顺便帮我带点水果。
顺便.en: If you go to the supermarket, bring me some fruit on the way.

顺便.zh: 下班后我顺便去银行取了钱。
顺便.en: After work, I stopped by the bank to withdraw some money.

顺便.zh: 他路过书店，顺便给我买了本书。
顺便.en: He passed by the bookstore and bought me a book on the way.

顺便.zh: 如果你去图书馆，顺便帮我还一下这本书，好吗？
顺便.en: If you go to the library, could you return this book for me while you're at it?

友谊.zh: 真正的友谊需要时间和信任。
友谊.en: True friendship requires time and trust.

友谊.zh: 虽然我们住得很远，但友谊从未改变。
友谊.en: Although we live far apart, our friendship has never changed.

友谊.zh: 他们之间的友谊是从小学开始的。
友谊.en: The friendship between them started in elementary school.

友谊.zh: 这次旅行加深了我们之间的友谊。
友谊.en: This trip deepened the friendship between us.

笨.en: I did this problem in such a stupid way.

笨.zh: 他其实不笨，只是懒而已。
笨.en: He's actually not stupid, just lazy.

笨.zh: 我弟弟虽然笨，但是很努力。
笨.en: My younger brother may be slow, but he works very hard.

笨.zh: 别笑我笨，我只是第一次做这个。
笨.en: Don't laugh at me for being clumsy; this is my first time doing it.

笨.zh: 这个办法有点笨，不过挺管用的。
笨.en: This method is a bit clumsy, but it works pretty well.

大厅.en: There are a lot of people in the hall.

大厅.zh: 酒店的大厅非常宽敞明亮。
大厅.en: The hotel lobby is very spacious and bright.

大厅.zh: 走进大厅，我看到一个巨大的水晶吊灯。
大厅.en: Walking into the hall, I saw a huge crystal chandelier.

大厅.zh: 请在一楼大厅等我，我马上下来。
大厅.en: Please wait for me in the lobby on the first floor; I'll be right down.

大楼.zh: 那座大楼是去年新建的。
大楼.en: That building was newly built last year.

大楼.zh: 我们公司在这栋大楼的二十层。
大楼.en: Our company is on the 20th floor of this building.

大楼.zh: 因为地震，那栋大楼出现了裂缝。
大楼.en: Because of the earthquake, cracks appeared in that building.

大楼.zh: 这栋大楼里有很多不同的公司。
大楼.en: There are many different companies in this building.

耐心.zh: 教孩子需要很大的耐心。
耐心.en: Teaching children requires a lot of patience.

耐心.zh: 他很有耐心，从不发脾气。
耐心.en: He is very patient and never loses his temper.

耐心.zh: 如果你没有耐心，就做不好这件事。
耐心.en: If you don't have patience, you won't do this job well.

耐心.zh: 虽然老师很忙，但她对学生很有耐心。
耐心.en: Although the teacher is very busy, she is very patient with her students.

加快.en: We need to speed up the work progress.

加快.zh: 为了按时完成，我们必须加快步伐。
加快.en: In order to finish on time, we must quicken our pace.

加快.zh: 如果再不加快，我们就来不及了。
加快.en: If we don't speed up, we won't make it in time.

加快.zh: 医生建议他加快康复训练。
加快.en: The doctor advised him to accelerate his rehabilitation training.

远离.en: Please stay away from the dangerous area.

远离.zh: 我选择远离那些负能量的人。
远离.en: I choose to stay away from those negative people.

远离.zh: 为了健康，你应该远离垃圾食品。
远离.en: For your health, you should stay away from junk food.

远离.zh: 他搬到乡下，远离城市的喧嚣。
远离.en: He moved to the countryside, away from the noise of the city.

远离.zh: 吸烟有害健康，请远离烟草。
远离.en: Smoking is harmful to health, so please stay away from tobacco.

开玩笑.en: He often jokes with his colleagues.

开玩笑.zh: 你不应该拿别人的缺点开玩笑。
开玩笑.en: You shouldn't make jokes about other people's weaknesses.
Even joking should have its limits.

各个.zh: 各个商店都关门了，我们只好回家。
各个.en: All the shops are closed, so we had to go home.

各个.zh: 这个问题各个部门都要注意。
各个.en: This issue requires attention from every department.

各个.zh: 虽然各个方案都不错，但我们还是选了这个。
各个.en: Although each plan is good, we still chose this one.

各个.zh: 各个城市的风俗都不一样。
各个.en: Customs vary from city to city.

参赛.en: He decided to enter the competition.

参赛.zh: 很多选手从外地赶来参赛。
参赛.en: Many contestants came from other places to compete.

参赛.zh: 因为准备不足，他最后没有参赛。
参赛.en: Because he was unprepared, he didn't end up participating.

参赛.zh: 这次比赛参赛人数很多。
参赛.en: The number of participants in this competition is large.

参赛.zh: 她参赛的作品是一幅画。
参赛.en: Her entry for the competition is a painting.

演唱.zh: 歌手在台上演唱时，观众都很激动。
演唱.en: When the singer performed on stage, the audience was very excited.

演唱.zh: 虽然他不擅长演唱，但还是勇敢地上了台。
演唱.en: Although he is not good at singing, he bravely went on stage.

演唱.zh: 这次演唱会的演唱嘉宾是谁？
演唱.en: Who is the singing guest at this concert?

演唱.zh: 他演唱的版本比原唱还好听。
演唱.en: His version of the song sounds even better than the original.

植物.zh: 我家阳台上种了很多植物，特别好看。
植物.en: I have many plants on my balcony, very beautiful.

植物.zh: 因为没浇水，这些植物都枯萎了。
植物.en: Because they weren't watered, these plants all withered.

植物.zh: 这种植物的叶子可以入药。
植物.en: The leaves of this plant can be used as medicine.

日期.zh: 请把会议日期定在下周三。
日期.en: Please set the meeting date for next Wednesday.

日期.zh: 虽然日期改了，但地点不变。
日期.en: Although the date changed, the location remains the same.

日期.zh: 这个文件的日期写错了。
日期.en: The date on this document is written wrong.

日期.zh: 我们得确认一下出发日期。
日期.en: We need to confirm the departure date.

查看.zh: 我查看了一下天气预报，明天会下雨。
查看.en: I checked the weather forecast; it will rain tomorrow.

查看.zh: 如果有什么问题，请查看说明书。
查看.en: If there are any issues, please check the manual.

查看.zh: 他让我帮他查看一下成绩。
查看.en: He asked me to check his grades for him.

查看.zh: 查看历史记录可以找到答案。
查看.en: Checking the history can find the answer.

从此.en: They never saw each other again from then on.

从此.zh: 自从那次旅行后，她从此爱上了登山。
从此.en: After that trip, she fell in love with mountain climbing from then on.

从此.zh: 这件事让他很伤心，从此再也不提了。
从此.en: This incident made him very sad, and he never mentioned it again from then on.
From then on, we became good friends.

从此.zh: 从那以后，他从此改变了生活方式。
从此.en: After that, he changed his lifestyle from then on.

对面.en: My home is right across from the school.

对面.zh: 对面那家餐厅的菜很好吃。
对面.en: The food at the restaurant across the street is delicious.

对面.zh: 你走到对面，然后左转就到了。
对面.en: You walk to the opposite side, then turn left and you'll arrive.
The building across the street is under construction.

播放.zh: 请播放一下昨天录的视频。
播放.en: Please play the video recorded yesterday.

播放.zh: 因为设备坏了，无法播放音乐。
播放.en: Because the equipment is broken, music cannot be played.

播放.zh: 这个电台每天播放流行歌曲。
播放.en: This radio station plays pop songs every day.

播放.zh: 电影播放到一半突然停了。

其次.zh: 首先，我们要准备材料；其次，开始制作。
其次.en: First, we need to prepare materials; secondly, start making.

其次.zh: 你最重要的是学习，其次是运动。
其次.en: The most important thing is study, next is exercise.

其次.zh: 他喜欢这本书，其次是那本。
其次.en: He likes this book, and next is that one.

其次.zh: 首先解决吃饭问题，其次再考虑出去玩。
其次.en: First solve the food problem, then consider going out.

其次.zh: 成绩不是唯一，其次的品德也很重要。
其次.en: Grades are not the only thing; secondly, character is also important.

眼镜.zh: 他昨天新买了一副眼镜。
眼镜.en: He bought a new pair of glasses yesterday.

眼镜.zh: 因为近视，我每天都得戴眼镜。
眼镜.en: Because I'm nearsighted, I have to wear glasses every day.

眼镜.zh: 这副眼镜是朋友送给我的生日礼物。
眼镜.en: These glasses are a birthday gift from my friend.

体重.zh: 虽然我吃得很多，但体重没变。
体重.en: Although I eat a lot, my weight hasn't changed.

体重.zh: 医生建议我控制体重，多运动。
体重.en: The doctor advised me to control my weight and exercise more.

面试.en: She performed well in the interview.
This interview is very important to me.

面试.zh: 如果面试通过了，我就能换工作。
面试.en: If I pass the interview, I can change jobs.

面试.zh: 为了准备面试，我练习了好几天。
面试.en: I practiced for several days to prepare for the interview.

敲.en: Don't hit the keyboard hard; it will break.

敲.zh: 有人敲门，我去看看是谁。
敲.en: Someone is knocking at the door; I'll go see who it is.

敲.zh: 我敲了三下门，但没人回应。
敲.en: I knocked three times on the door, but no one answered.

迟.zh: 因为堵车，我上班迟到了。
迟.en: Because of traffic, I was late for work.

迟.zh: 他迟到了十分钟，老板很不高兴。
迟.en: He was ten minutes late, and the boss was very upset.

脾气.en: You've been in a bad mood lately.

脾气.zh: 她脾气来得快去得也快。
脾气.en: Her temper flares up quickly but fades fast.

脾气.zh: 虽然她脾气不好，但人很善良。
脾气.en: Although she has a bad temper, she is very kind.

脾气.zh: 我爸爸发脾气的时候，我们都不敢说话。
脾气.en: When my dad loses his temper, we all dare not speak.

会员.en: I am a member of this store.
Becoming a member gives you a discount.
Did you get a membership card?

会员.zh: 如果加入会员，就能享受更多优惠。
会员.en: If you become a member, you can enjoy more benefits.

会员.zh: 这个网站需要注册会员才能看视频。
会员.en: This website requires you to register as a member to watch videos.

翻译.en: Can you help me translate this?
How do you translate this sentence?

翻译.zh: 我翻译完这篇文章就休息。
翻译.en: I'll rest after I finish translating this article.

翻译.zh: 因为不懂英文，我需要找一个翻译帮忙。
翻译.en: Because I don't know English, I need to find a translator to help.

烦恼.en: He has a lot of worries now.

烦恼.zh: 工作上的烦恼让我睡不着。
烦恼.en: Work worries keep me up at night.

烦恼.zh: 虽然生活有烦恼，但也要开心。
烦恼.en: Although life has worries, you should still be happy.

烦恼.zh: 我总是为小事烦恼，这样不好。
烦恼.en: I always worry about small things; that's not good.

特点.zh: 这个手机的特点是什么？
特点.en: What are the features of this phone?
His characteristic is being very attentive.

特点.zh: 每个地方都有不同的特点。
我喜欢这部电影的特点是很真实。
特点.en: What I like about this movie is that it's very realistic.

特点.zh: 这件衣服最大的特点是耐穿又好看。
特点.en: The biggest feature of this clothing is that it's durable and good-looking.

往往.zh: 周末的时候，我往往和朋友一起爬山。
往往.en: On weekends, I often go hiking with friends.

往往.zh: 她往往把事情想得太复杂，结果反而更麻烦。
往往.en: She often overcomplicates things, which ends up causing more trouble.

往往.zh: 虽然这家店便宜，但质量往往不太好。
往往.en: Although this store is cheap, the quality is often not very good.

往往.zh: 小孩子往往不喜欢吃蔬菜，不过也有例外。
往往.en: Children often don't like eating vegetables, but there are exceptions.

风景.zh: 一路上风景特别好，我们拍了很多照片。
风景.en: The scenery along the way was great; we took many photos.

风景.zh: 虽然这个城市很热闹，但是自然风景很少。
风景.en: Although this city is bustling, there is little natural scenery.

风景.zh: 去黄山看风景是我一直以来的愿望。
风景.en: Going to Huangshan to see the scenery has always been my wish.

风景.zh: 我们坐在山顶上，一边聊天一边欣赏风景。
风景.en: We sat on the mountaintop, chatting and enjoying the scenery.

笑话.en: Don't laugh at me; I'm still learning.

笑话.zh: 这个笑话太好笑了，我笑了半天。
笑话.en: This joke was so funny that I laughed for a long time.

笑话.zh: 他喜欢在网上看段子，然后讲笑话给我听。
笑话.en: He likes to watch memes online and then tell me jokes.

笑话.zh: 虽然是个老笑话，但每次听都觉得很有意思。
笑话.en: Although it's an old joke, I still find it interesting every time I hear it.

凉.en: The water is cold; I can't drink it.

凉.zh: 晚上风大，记得多穿点，别着凉了。
凉.en: It's windy at night; remember to dress warmly so you don't catch a cold.

凉.zh: 这碗汤已经凉了，我帮你热一下吧。
凉.en: This bowl of soup has already cooled down; let me heat it up for you.

凉.zh: 因为天气变凉，所以我们决定取消户外活动。
凉.en: Because the weather turned cool, we decided to cancel the outdoor activity.

球迷.zh: 球迷们都在为球队加油。
球迷.en: The fans are all cheering for the team.

球迷.zh: 这场比赛吸引了成千上万的球迷。
球迷.en: This match attracted tens of thousands of fans.

球迷.zh: 虽然输了球，但球迷们依然热情不减。
球迷.en: Even though the team lost, the fans remained enthusiastic.

球迷.zh: 我弟弟是个足球迷，每场球赛都不错过。
球迷.en: My younger brother is a soccer fan; he never misses a match.

路过.zh: 路过的时候，我看到一只小猫。
路过.en: When I passed by, I saw a little cat.

路过.zh: 他每天上班都会路过这个公园。
路过.en: He passes by this park every day on his way to work.

路过.zh: 我只是路过这里，没想到遇到了老朋友。
路过.en: I was just passing through here, and unexpectedly met an old friend.

路过.zh: 因为路过花店，我就顺便买了一束花送给她。
路过.en: Because I was passing by a flower shop, I bought a bouquet for her on a whim.

海洋.zh: 我喜欢看关于海洋的纪录片。
海洋.en: I like watching documentaries about the ocean.

海洋.zh: 海洋里有很多种鱼，五颜六色的。
海洋.en: There are many kinds of fish in the ocean, all colorful.

海洋.zh: 我们应该保护海洋环境，减少塑料垃圾。
海洋.en: We should protect the ocean environment and reduce plastic waste.

海洋.zh: 虽然海洋很美，但游泳时一定要注意安全。
海洋.en: Although the ocean is beautiful, you must pay attention to safety when swimming.

窗户.en: There is a little bird outside the window.
It's raining; remember to close the windows properly.

窗户.zh: 这个房间的窗户很大，阳光特别好。
窗户.en: The windows in this room are very big, and the sunlight is great.

窗户.zh: 因为窗户坏了，所以风一直往里吹。
窗户.en: Because the window is broken, the wind keeps blowing in.

平常.zh: 这件衣服很平常，没什么特别的。
平常.en: This piece of clothing is very ordinary; nothing special.

平常.zh: 我平常不怎么吃辣，今天破例了。
平常.en: I don't usually eat spicy food, but I made an exception today.

平常.zh: 虽然她平常话不多，但心里什么都明白。
平常.en: Although she doesn't talk much usually, she understands everything in her heart.

平常.zh: 周末我平常会去健身房，不过这周太累了就没去。
平常.en: On weekends I usually go to the gym, but this week I was too tired and didn't go.

文字.en: This passage of text is very touching.

文字.zh: 这本书的文字很简单，适合初学者。
文字.en: The text in this book is very simple, suitable for beginners.

文字.zh: 他发来的消息文字很少，但意思很明白。
文字.en: The message he sent had very few words, but the meaning was clear.

文字.zh: 因为文字表达能力有限，所以他更喜欢用图片交流。
文字.en: Because his ability to express in writing is limited, he prefers to communicate with pictures.

家具.en: This set of furniture is very beautiful.

家具.zh: 我最近在找一些便宜的二手家具。
家具.en: I've been looking for some cheap second-hand furniture recently.

家具.zh: 因为要搬家，所以我把旧家具都卖掉了。
家具.en: Because I'm moving, I sold all my old furniture.

家具.zh: 这家店的家具都是实木的，质量很好。
家具.en: The furniture in this store is all solid wood, with good quality.

家具.zh: 你喜欢哪种风格的家具？
家具.en: What style of furniture do you like?

眼里.en: He only has money and power in his eyes.

眼里.zh: 在她眼里，这个孩子永远都是最棒的。
眼里.en: In her eyes, this child is always the best.

眼里.zh: 虽然别人觉得很难，但在我眼里这不算什么。
眼里.en: Although others think it's difficult, in my eyes it's nothing.

眼里.zh: 你眼里还有没有我这个朋友？
眼里.en: Do you still have me as a friend in your eyes?

眼里.zh: 从你眼里我看出了你的失望。
眼里.en: I could see your disappointment in your eyes.

不在乎.zh: 他好像对考试结果完全不在乎。
不在乎.en: He seems to completely not care about the exam results.

不在乎.zh: 虽然别人怎么说，但我不在乎。
不在乎.en: No matter what others say, I don't care.

不在乎.zh: 她在乎的是过程，不在乎结果。
不在乎.en: What she cares about is the process, not the result.
Don't you care about my feelings?

电视剧.en: I'm watching a new TV drama.

电视剧.zh: 最近那部古装电视剧特别火，你看了吗？
电视剧.en: That recent historical drama is very popular, have you watched it?

电视剧.zh: 因为电视剧太长，我只看了一半。
电视剧.en: Because the drama is too long, I only watched half of it.

电视剧.zh: 我妈妈每天都要追好几部电视剧。
电视剧.en: My mom chases several TV dramas every day.

电视剧.zh: 你觉得这部电视剧的结局怎么样？
电视剧.en: What do you think of the ending of this TV drama?

棵.en: There is a big tree in front of the door.

棵.zh: 我每天早上都会给那棵小树浇水。
棵.en: Every morning I water that little tree.

棵.zh: 如果这棵花再不开，我就换一盆。
棵.en: If this flower still doesn't bloom, I'll change to another pot.

棵.zh: 院子里种了好几棵果树。
棵.en: Several fruit trees are planted in the yard.

棵.zh: 那棵老树已经有上百年了。
棵.en: That old tree is over a hundred years old.

粗.zh: 他的声音很粗，像个中年人。
粗.en: His voice is very gruff, like a middle-aged man.

粗.zh: 虽然这根柱子很粗，但不够结实。
粗.en: Although this pillar is thick, it's not solid enough.

粗.zh: 这种布料太粗了，不适合做衣服。
粗.en: This fabric is too coarse, not suitable for making clothes.

粗.zh: 这面条太粗了，我喜欢细的。
粗.en: These noodles are too thick, I like thin ones.

身份证.zh: 我昨天去派出所补办了一张身份证。
身份证.en: I went to the police station yesterday to get a replacement ID card.

身份证.zh: 因为忘了带身份证，所以没坐成飞机。
身份证.en: Because I forgot my ID card, I missed the flight.

身份证.zh: 你的身份证快过期了，记得去换。
身份证.en: Your ID card is about to expire, remember to renew it.

身份证.zh: 入住酒店需要登记身份证。
身份证.en: Checking into a hotel requires registering your ID card.

商量.zh: 这件事我得跟家人商量商量。
商量.en: I need to discuss this matter with my family.

商量.zh: 如果你不同意，我们可以再商量。
商量.en: If you don't agree, we can discuss further.

商量.zh: 他们正在商量明天去哪玩。
商量.en: They are discussing where to go tomorrow.

商量.zh: 别一个人做决定，先跟我商量一下。
商量.en: Don't make a decision alone, discuss it with me first.

多年.en: We've known each other for many years.

多年.zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于成功了。
多年.en: After many years of hard work, he finally succeeded.

多年.zh: 虽然分别多年，但我们还是好朋友。
多年.en: Although we've been apart for many years, we are still good friends.

多年.zh: 多年以前我来过这个地方。
多年.en: Many years ago, I came to this place.
A habit of many years is hard to change.

收费.zh: 这个网站看视频是免费的，不收费。
收费.en: Watching videos on this website is free, no charge.

收费.zh: 因为高速要收费，所以我们走了小路。
收费.en: Because the highway charges a toll, we took the small road.

收费.zh: 这个景点对老年人不收费。
收费.en: This scenic spot doesn't charge for elderly people.

小伙子.en: This young guy is really capable.

小伙子.zh: 小伙子，你帮我搬一下箱子好吗？
小伙子.en: Young man, can you help me move the box?

小伙子.zh: 虽然他是小伙子，但做事很稳重。
小伙子.en: Although he is a young guy, he is very steady in doing things.

小伙子.zh: 那个小伙子每天跑步锻炼身体。
小伙子.en: That young guy runs every day to exercise.

小伙子.zh: 小伙子们，咱们一起去打球吧！
小伙子.en: Young guys, let's go play ball together!

午餐.zh: 我通常在公司附近吃午餐。
午餐.en: I usually eat lunch near the company.

午餐.zh: 因为早上吃太饱，午餐我只喝了碗汤。
午餐.en: Because I ate too much in the morning, I only had a bowl of soup for lunch.

午餐.zh: 午餐时间到了，我们去食堂吧。
午餐.en: Lunch time is here, let's go to the cafeteria.

好友.zh: 我和好友约好了周末一起看电影。
好友.en: My close friend and I have arranged to watch a movie together on the weekend.

好友.zh: 虽然我们好久没见，但好友还是那么懂我。
好友.en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, my close friend still understands me so well.

好友.zh: 他是我从小玩到大的好友。
好友.en: He is a close friend I grew up playing with.

好友.zh: 有好友在身边，什么困难都不怕。
好友.en: With close friends around, I'm not afraid of any difficulty.

排队.en: Everyone line up to get on the bus.

排队.zh: 虽然排队很无聊，但为了好吃的也值得。
排队.en: Although queuing is boring, it's worth it for good food.

排队.zh: 在医院排队挂号花了一个小时。
排队.en: It took an hour to queue for registration at the hospital.

等到.zh: 等到他来了我们再开始吃饭。
等到.en: Let's wait until he arrives before we start eating.

等到.zh: 如果等到明天，可能就来不及了。
等到.en: If we wait until tomorrow, it might be too late.

等到.zh: 我等到半夜他还没回来。
等到.en: I waited until midnight and he still hasn't returned.

等到.zh: 等到电影结束我才发现手机没电了。
等到.en: I didn't realize my phone was dead until the movie ended.

稍微.zh: 这个汤稍微有点咸，但还可以喝。
稍微.en: This soup is a little salty, but still drinkable.

稍微.zh: 如果你稍微努力一点，就能通过考试。
稍微.en: If you work a little harder, you can pass the exam.

稍微.zh: 颜色稍微深一点更好看。
稍微.en: A slightly darker color looks nicer.

稍微.zh: 他稍微休息了一下又继续工作。
稍微.en: He rested a little and then continued working.

胖子.en: That fat guy runs very fast.

胖子.zh: 我们班有个胖子特别幽默。
胖子.en: There is a fat guy in our class who is very humorous.

胖子.zh: 虽然他是个胖子，但身体很健康。
胖子.en: Although he is a fat person, his body is very healthy.

胖子.zh: 大家都叫他小胖子，他也不生气。
胖子.en: Everyone calls him Little Fatty, and he doesn't get angry.

汗.en: After running, my head was covered in sweat.

汗.zh: 因为天气太热，稍微动一下就出汗。
汗.en: Because the weather is too hot, just a little movement makes me sweat.
He was so nervous that his palms were sweaty.
Wipe your sweat, don't catch a cold.

缺少.zh: 我觉得这个计划缺少一些细节。
缺少.en: I think this plan lacks some details.

缺少.zh: 如果缺少睡眠，第二天就没精神。
缺少.en: If you lack sleep, you won't have energy the next day.

缺少.zh: 我们团队缺少一个设计师。
他因为缺少经验，所以没被录取。
缺少.en: He wasn't accepted because he lacked experience.

环保.en: We need to be environmentally friendly.

环保.zh: 现在越来越多的人开始注重环保。
环保.en: Now more and more people are paying attention to environmental protection.

环保.zh: 虽然环保很重要，但很多人还是乱扔垃圾。
环保.en: Although environmental protection is important, many people still litter.

环保.zh: 这个购物袋是环保材料做的。
环保.en: This shopping bag is made of eco-friendly materials.

环保.zh: 垃圾分类是一种环保行为。
环保.en: Waste sorting is an environmentally friendly behavior.

家乡.en: I miss my hometown a lot.

家乡.zh: 每次放假我都回家乡看看。
家乡.en: I go back to my hometown every holiday.

家乡.zh: 虽然我在大城市工作，但我的家乡永远是我的根。
家乡.en: Although I work in a big city, my hometown will always be my root.

家乡.zh: 家乡的变化很大，很多老房子都拆了。
家乡.en: My hometown has changed a lot; many old houses have been demolished.

阅读.zh: 我每天都会花一小时阅读。
阅读.en: I spend an hour reading every day.

阅读.zh: 因为工作太忙，我已经很久没有阅读了。
阅读.en: Because of work, I haven't read for a long time.

阅读.zh: 阅读习惯要从小培养，这样对孩子有好处。
阅读.en: Reading habits should be cultivated from a young age; this is good for children.

发送.en: When will you send the notice?

发送.zh: 他把照片发送到了群里，大家都看到了。
发送.en: He sent the photo to the group chat, and everyone saw it.

发送.zh: 我刚发送完消息，他就回复了。
发送.en: I had just sent the message when he replied.

读者.zh: 作为读者，我喜欢科幻小说。
读者.en: As a reader, I like science fiction.

读者.zh: 杂志社在征集读者意见。
读者.en: The magazine is soliciting reader opinions.

读者.zh: 这位作者和读者互动很频繁，经常回信。
读者.en: This author interacts frequently with readers and often replies to letters.

读者.zh: 虽然读者不多，但每个评论他都认真看。
读者.en: Although there aren't many readers, he reads every comment carefully.

多数.zh: 多数人都同意这个方案。
多数.en: Most people agree with this plan.

多数.zh: 这里的多数房子都是新盖的。
多数.en: Most of the houses here are newly built.

多数.zh: 虽然有些人反对，但多数还是支持。
多数.en: Although some oppose it, the majority still support it.

多数.zh: 在多数情况下，这样做是安全的。
多数.en: In most cases, doing this is safe.

推出.en: The company launched a new product.

推出.zh: 他们下个月推出新服务。
推出.en: They will launch a new service next month.

推出.zh: 这家店推出了优惠活动。
因为市场需求大，他们推出了限量版。
推出.en: Because of high market demand, they launched a limited edition.

推出.zh: 最近推出的那款手机卖得特别好。
推出.en: The phone launched recently is selling very well.

巧.en: What a coincidence, you're here too!

巧.zh: 她手很巧，会做各种手工。
巧.en: She is very handy and can make all kinds of crafts.

巧.zh: 我们巧遇了老朋友，聊了很久。
巧.en: We ran into an old friend by chance and chatted for a long time.

巧.zh: 他说话很巧，总是能让别人开心。
巧.en: He speaks very tactfully and always makes others happy.

多次.zh: 我多次提醒他注意安全。
多次.en: I reminded him many times to be careful.

多次.zh: 他多次迟到，老板很不高兴。
多次.en: He was late many times, and the boss was very unhappy.

多次.zh: 她多次参加比赛，终于拿了奖。
多次.en: She participated in competitions many times and finally won an award.

多次.zh: 虽然我多次解释，他还是不理解。
多次.en: Although I explained many times, he still didn't understand.

多次.zh: 这个实验多次失败，但他们没有放弃。
多次.en: This experiment failed many times, but they didn't give up.

男女.zh: 这家公司男女员工各一半。
男女.en: This company has an equal number of male and female employees.

男女.zh: 这个活动男女都可以参加。
男女.en: Both men and women can participate in this activity.

男女.zh: 很多工作不分男女，只要有能力。
男女.en: Many jobs are not distinguished by gender, as long as you have ability.

男女.zh: 男女思维方式不同，但需要互相理解。
男女.en: Men and women think differently, but they need to understand each other.

收回.zh: 公司决定收回那个产品。
收回.en: The company decided to recall that product.

收回.zh: 他说错话后马上收回了。
收回.en: He immediately took back his words after saying something wrong.

收回.zh: 因为质量问题，厂家被迫收回所有商品。
收回.en: Due to quality issues, the manufacturer was forced to recall all products.

教学.en: Her teaching method is very good.

教学.zh: 因为教学经验丰富，所以学生们都很喜欢她。
教学.en: Because she has rich teaching experience, students all like her.

教学.zh: 这个学校的教学质量非常高。
教学.en: The teaching quality of this school is very high.

教学.zh: 虽然教学任务很重，但他从不抱怨。
教学.en: Although the teaching task is heavy, he never complains.
He decided to engage in teaching work.

座位.zh: 演出开始了，我们得快点儿找到座位。
座位.en: The show has started, we need to find seats quickly.

座位.zh: 如果你想要靠窗的座位，就得提前预订。
座位.en: If you want a window seat, you need to book in advance.
The seats on the plane are very comfortable.
Please sit according to seat numbers.

首都.en: Beijing is the capital of China.

首都.zh: 每个国家都有自己的首都。
首都.en: Every country has its own capital.

首都.zh: 虽然东京是日本的首都，但大阪也很繁华。
首都.en: Although Tokyo is the capital of Japan, Osaka is also bustling.
He went on a business trip to the capital.
The population of the capital is very large.

吃惊.zh: 听到这个消息，大家都非常吃惊。
吃惊.en: Hearing this news, everyone was very surprised.

吃惊.zh: 因为结果太意外了，所以我很吃惊。
吃惊.en: Because the result was too unexpected, I was very surprised.
Don't be surprised, this is true.
She looked at me in surprise.

忽然.zh: 我正走着，忽然下起了大雨。
忽然.en: I was walking when suddenly it started raining heavily.

忽然.zh: 虽然刚才还是晴天，但是忽然下起了雨。
忽然.en: Although it was sunny just now, suddenly it started raining.

暂停.zh: 因为天气不好，活动暂时暂停了。
暂停.en: Because the weather is bad, the activity was temporarily suspended.

暂停.zh: 如果你累了，可以暂停休息一会儿。
暂停.en: If you are tired, you can pause and rest for a while.
The meeting paused for ten minutes.

羡慕.zh: 大家都很羡慕她的好运气。
虽然我很羡慕他，但我知道他也很努力。
羡慕.en: Although I envy him, I know he works hard too.

羡慕.zh: 别羡慕别人，做好自己就行了。
羡慕.en: Don't envy others, just be yourself.

羡慕.zh: 她羡慕地看着别人的新手机。
羡慕.en: She looked at others' new phones with envy.

报名.zh: 他报名参加了明天的马拉松比赛。
报名.en: He signed up for tomorrow's marathon.

报名.zh: 如果你想参加比赛，就得提前报名。
报名.en: If you want to join the competition, you need to register early.

报名.zh: 报名人数已经超过一百了。
报名.en: The number of registrants has exceeded one hundred.

此次.zh: 此次的活动比上次有趣多了。
此次.en: This event is much more interesting than last time.

此次.zh: 虽然此次考试很难，但我还是通过了。
此次.en: Although this exam was hard, I still passed.

此次.zh: 此次旅行让我学到了很多。
此次.en: This trip taught me a lot.

此次.zh: 此次机会难得，你要好好把握。
