此次.en: This opportunity is rare, you should seize it.

日记.en: She insists on writing a diary every day.

日记.zh: 虽然很忙，但我还是会写日记。
日记.en: Although very busy, I still write a diary.

日记.zh: 这本日记记录了她的童年。
他把秘密都写在日记里。
日记.en: He writes all secrets in his diary.

逛.en: Let's go for a walk in the park.

逛.zh: 周末我喜欢和朋友一起逛商场，但什么也不买。
逛.en: On weekends I like to go window-shopping with friends, but I don't buy anything.

逛.zh: 如果你有空，我们可以一起去逛夜市。
逛.en: If you're free, we can go to the night market together.

逛.zh: 他每天下午都去街上逛逛。
逛.en: He takes a stroll on the street every afternoon.

逛.zh: 逛书店是我的爱好之一。
逛.en: Browsing bookstores is one of my hobbies.

好笑.zh: 他讲的故事太搞笑了，大家都觉得好笑。
好笑.en: The story he told was hilarious; everyone thought it was funny.

好笑.zh: 虽然你觉得好笑，但我一点都不觉得。
好笑.en: Although you think it's funny, I don't find it amusing at all.

好笑.zh: 那个视频里的表情特别好笑。
好笑.en: The expression in that video is particularly funny.

好笑.zh: 别笑了，这件事没什么好笑的。
好笑.en: Stop laughing; there's nothing funny about this.

健身.en: I go to the gym every day to work out.

健身.zh: 为了保持健康，他坚持健身已经三年了。
健身.en: To stay healthy, he has been working out consistently for three years.

健身.zh: 因为工作太忙，我最近很少健身。
健身.en: Because work is too busy, I've rarely exercised recently.

健身.zh: 健身不仅让身体变好，还能减压。
健身.en: Exercise not only improves your body, but also relieves stress.

健身.zh: 她健身的时候喜欢听音乐。
健身.en: She likes to listen to music while working out.

减轻.zh: 多做运动可以减轻工作和生活带来的压力。
减轻.en: Exercising more can reduce the stress from work and life.

减轻.zh: 如果你能早睡早起，就能减轻疲劳感。
减轻.en: If you can go to bed early and wake up early, you can reduce fatigue.

减轻.zh: 政府正在想办法减轻市民的负担。
减轻.en: The government is trying to reduce the burden on citizens.

减轻.zh: 这个新政策减轻了我们的经济压力。
减轻.en: This new policy has eased our financial pressure.

总结.zh: 我们来总结一下今天的会议。
年终总结报告要写得详细一些。
总结.en: The year-end summary report should be written in more detail.

总结.zh: 首先发言，然后大家一起总结。
总结.en: First, give your speech, then everyone will summarize together.

总结.zh: 学习结束后，老师让我们写一篇总结。
总结.en: After the study session, the teacher asked us to write a summary.

总结.zh: 总结这次经验，对我们以后的工作很有帮助。
总结.en: Summarizing this experience will be very helpful for our future work.

南部.en: The climate in southern China is warm.

南部.zh: 今年南部地区降雨量比往年多。
南部.en: This year, rainfall in the southern region is higher than previous years.

南部.zh: 他住在城市的南部，而我住在北部。
南部.en: He lives in the southern part of the city, while I live in the northern part.

南部.zh: 南部的旅游景点吸引了大量游客。
南部.en: The tourist attractions in the south attract a large number of visitors.

南部.zh: 这条河从北部流向南部。
南部.en: This river flows from the north to the south.

打扰.zh: 他在工作的时候不喜欢被别人打扰。
打扰.en: He doesn't like to be disturbed while working.

打扰.zh: 如果你很忙，我就不打扰你了。
打扰.en: If you're busy, I won't bother you.

打扰.zh: 晚上十点以后请不要打扰邻居。
打扰.en: Please don't disturb the neighbors after 10 p.m.

打扰.zh: 这个噪音一直打扰我睡觉。
打扰.en: This noise keeps disturbing my sleep.

江.en: The Yangtze River is the longest river in China.

江.zh: 我们坐船沿着江游览，风景很美。
江.en: We took a boat trip along the river, and the scenery was beautiful.

江.zh: 虽然江面很宽，但水流并不急。
江.en: Although the river is wide, the current is not fast.
Both banks of the river are lined with willow trees.

江.zh: 这条江从西向东流入大海。
江.en: This river flows from west to east into the sea.

幽默.zh: 我喜欢和幽默的人做朋友，因为很开心。
幽默.en: I like to be friends with humorous people because it's very cheerful.

幽默.zh: 虽然他很幽默，但有时也会很严肃。
幽默.en: Although he is humorous, sometimes he can be very serious.

幽默.zh: 这个电影里的对白非常幽默。
幽默.en: The dialogue in this movie is very witty.

幽默.zh: 他的幽默感让大家都喜欢他。
幽默.en: His sense of humor makes everyone like him.

办事.zh: 他办事效率很高，大家都信任他。
办事.en: He is very efficient in handling tasks, so everyone trusts him.

办事.zh: 因为要办事，所以下午请了半天假。
办事.en: Because I had errands to run, I took half a day off in the afternoon.

办事.zh: 你办事真靠谱，每次都按时完成。
办事.en: You are really reliable in getting things done, finishing on time every time.

塑料.zh: 虽然塑料很轻，但是不容易降解。
塑料.en: Although plastic is light, it doesn't decompose easily.

塑料.zh: 我买了一个塑料的收纳盒放文具。
塑料.en: I bought a plastic storage box for stationery.

塑料.zh: 因为塑料制品对环境不好，我现在尽量少用。
塑料.en: Because plastic products are bad for the environment, I try to use less now.

做梦.en: I had a dream last night.

做梦.zh: 你别做梦了，这事不可能。
做梦.en: Don't dream on, this is impossible.

做梦.zh: 他经常做梦梦到自己会飞。
做梦.en: He often dreams that he can fly.

做梦.zh: 我做梦也没想到会在这里遇见你。
做梦.en: I never dreamed I would meet you here.

做梦.zh: 虽然她说要买跑车，但我觉得她是在做梦。
做梦.en: Although she said she wants to buy a sports car, I think she's daydreaming.

互联网.en: The internet is very important now.

互联网.zh: 互联网上什么信息都能找到。
互联网.en: You can find any information on the internet.

互联网.zh: 如果没有互联网，工作会很不方便。
互联网.en: Without the internet, work would be very inconvenient.

互联网.zh: 他靠互联网创业赚了不少钱。
互联网.en: He started a business on the internet and made a lot of money.

互联网.zh: 因为互联网发展太快，很多传统行业都变了。
互联网.en: Because the internet develops so fast, many traditional industries have changed.

误会.zh: 别误会，我不是那个意思。
误会.en: Don't misunderstand, I didn't mean that.

误会.zh: 我们之间有点小误会，需要解释清楚。
误会.en: There's a small misunderstanding between us that needs to be clarified.

误会.zh: 如果你不说明白，别人很容易误会你。
误会.en: If you don't explain clearly, others can easily misunderstand you.

打工.en: I work part-time at a restaurant.
He wants to work part-time during summer vacation to earn money.

打工.zh: 很多大学生都会利用课余时间打工。
打工.en: Many college students work part-time in their spare time.

打工.zh: 虽然打工很累，但能学到不少东西。
打工.en: Although working part-time is tiring, you can learn a lot.

打工.zh: 他一边上学一边打工，生活很充实。
打工.en: He goes to school and works part-time at the same time, life is very fulfilling.

台上.en: He is giving a speech on stage.
The performance on stage was wonderful.
She was a bit nervous standing on stage.

台上.zh: 演员们在台上演得特别投入。
台上.en: The actors performed very intently on stage.

台上.zh: 虽然台下人很多，她在台上还是很自信。
台上.en: Although there were many people off stage, she was still confident on stage.

星星.en: The stars in the sky are really bright.

星星.zh: 今晚看不到星星，因为云太多了。
星星.en: We can't see stars tonight because there are too many clouds.

星星.zh: 小时候我经常数天上的星星。
星星.en: When I was young, I often counted the stars in the sky.

星星.zh: 虽然城市里很难看到星星，但乡下很容易。
星星.en: Although it's hard to see stars in the city, it's easy in the countryside.

获取.zh: 他从网上获取了很多资料。
获取.en: He obtained a lot of materials from the internet.

获取.zh: 我们得想办法获取更多的支持。
获取.en: We need to find a way to get more support.

获取.zh: 通过这次培训，我获取了新技能。
获取.en: Through this training, I acquired new skills.

获取.zh: 如果他不努力，很难获取成功。
获取.en: If he doesn't work hard, it's hard to achieve success.

抱歉.zh: 我为我刚才说的话感到抱歉。
抱歉.en: I'm sorry for what I said just now.

抱歉.zh: 抱歉打扰你一下，请问厕所在哪？
抱歉.en: Sorry to bother you, where is the restroom?

抱歉.zh: 虽然他说了抱歉，但我还是有点生气。
抱歉.en: Although he said sorry, I'm still a bit angry.

师傅.zh: 我跟着一位老师傅学做菜。
师傅.en: I learned cooking from an old master.

师傅.zh: 师傅，麻烦你开快点，我赶时间。
师傅.en: Master, please drive faster, I'm in a hurry.

师傅.zh: 虽然师傅年纪大了，但技术一点没退步。
师傅.en: Although the master is old, his skills haven't declined at all.

钢琴.zh: 我每天练一个小时的钢琴。
钢琴.en: I practice piano for an hour every day.

钢琴.zh: 他买了架新钢琴，特别开心。
钢琴.en: He bought a new piano and was very happy.

钢琴.zh: 虽然我喜欢钢琴，但学起来真不容易。
钢琴.en: Although I like the piano, learning it is really not easy.

钢琴.zh: 我家那架旧钢琴已经很多年没调音了。
钢琴.en: That old piano at my house hasn't been tuned for many years.

不满.en: He is very dissatisfied with the result.

不满.zh: 员工们对加班表示不满。
不满.en: The employees expressed dissatisfaction with overtime.

不满.zh: 因为服务太差，顾客表达了很多不满。
不满.en: Because the service was so bad, customers expressed a lot of dissatisfaction.

不满.zh: 不满的情绪在团队里慢慢传开了。
不满.en: The feeling of dissatisfaction slowly spread in the team.

不满.zh: 尽管老板道歉了，他的不满还是没有消除。
不满.en: Even though the boss apologized, his dissatisfaction still did not go away.

镜子.en: She puts on makeup in front of the mirror.

镜子.zh: 洗手间的镜子被孩子弄脏了。
镜子.en: The mirror in the bathroom was dirtied by the child.

镜子.zh: 我们买了个大镜子放在客厅。
镜子.en: We bought a large mirror and put it in the living room.

镜子.zh: 如果你每天都照镜子，就会注意到自己的变化。
镜子.en: If you look in the mirror every day, you will notice changes in yourself.

例子.zh: 老师用生活中的例子来解释语法。
例子.en: The teacher used examples from daily life to explain grammar.

例子.zh: 比如这个例子，就说明了问题所在。
例子.en: For example, this example illustrates where the problem lies.

例子.zh: 为了让大家更明白，他举了好几个具体的例子。
例子.en: In order to make everyone understand better, he gave several specific examples.

赶上.zh: 你还能赶上最后一班车。
赶上.en: You can still catch the last bus.

赶上.zh: 他跑得快，终于赶上了队伍。
赶上.en: He ran fast and finally caught up with the group.

赶上.zh: 因为堵车，我没赶上会议的开始。
赶上.en: Because of the traffic jam, I didn't make it to the start of the meeting.

赶上.zh: 只要你努力，就能赶上其他同学的进度。
赶上.en: As long as you work hard, you can catch up with the progress of your classmates.

招呼.zh: 进门时要跟长辈打招呼。
招呼.en: You should greet elders when entering a door.

招呼.zh: 她没听见我的招呼，直接走了。
招呼.en: She didn't hear my greeting and just left.

招呼.zh: 大家互相打了个招呼就散开了。
招呼.en: Everyone greeted each other and then dispersed.

招呼.zh: 如果你见到他，记得替我打个招呼。
招呼.en: If you see him, remember to say hello for me.

合格.en: This product is not up to standard.

合格.zh: 只有合格的人才能上岗。
合格.en: Only qualified people can take the job.

合格.zh: 检查结果显示所有样品都合格。
合格.en: The inspection results showed that all samples were up to standard.

合格.zh: 为了拿到合格证书，他复习了很久。
合格.en: In order to get the qualification certificate, he studied for a long time.

东部.en: Eastern China has a large population.
Shanghai is on the eastern coast.
We plan to travel to the eastern region.

东部.zh: 东部地区的经济发展得比较快。
东部.en: The economy in the eastern region develops relatively quickly.

东部.zh: 与西部相比，东部的生活节奏更快。
东部.en: Compared to the west, the pace of life in the east is faster.

亲戚.en: During Spring Festival, we visit relatives.

亲戚.zh: 每年过年，亲戚们都会聚在一起。
亲戚.en: Every New Year, relatives gather together.

亲戚.zh: 虽然亲戚不多，但大家关系很好。
亲戚.en: Although there aren't many relatives, everyone has good relationships.

胸部.zh: 扩胸运动可以锻炼胸部。
胸部.en: Chest expansion exercises can work out the chest.

胸部.zh: 她胸口疼，可能是胸部的问题。
胸部.en: She has chest pain; it might be a problem with the chest area.

胸部.zh: 检查时医生用手按了按他的胸部。
胸部.en: During the checkup, the doctor pressed on his chest with his hand.

胸部.zh: 因为胸部不舒服，他去医院做了检查。
胸部.en: Because of chest discomfort, he went to the hospital for a checkup.

客气.zh: 如果你们不客气，我就不好意思了。
客气.en: If you are not polite, I will be embarrassed.

客气.zh: 他对我很客气，总是说谢谢。
客气.en: He is very polite to me, always saying thank you.

客气.zh: 你太客气了，这只是一点小意思。
客气.en: You are too polite, this is just a small token.

琴.en: I like listening to the sound of the instrument.

琴.zh: 他每天练琴两小时，进步很快。
琴.en: He practices the piano two hours every day, making fast progress.

琴.zh: 虽然学琴很难，但她一直坚持。
琴.en: Although learning the instrument is hard, she keeps persisting.

琴.zh: 这把琴是我爷爷留给我的。
琴.en: This instrument was left to me by my grandfather.

日常.zh: 除了工作，我还有很多日常琐事要做。
日常.en: Besides work, I have many daily chores to do.

日常.zh: 如果你能养成良好的日常习惯，生活会更有规律。
日常.en: If you can develop good daily habits, life will be more regular.

日常.zh: 手机已经成为我们日常生活的一部分。
日常.en: Mobile phones have become part of our daily life.

力气.zh: 搬这个箱子需要很大的力气。
力气.en: Moving this box requires a lot of strength.

力气.zh: 虽然他很瘦，但是力气却不小。
力气.en: Although he is thin, his strength is not small.

力气.zh: 你省点力气，别做那么多无用功。
力气.en: Save your strength, don't do so much useless work.

缺点.en: His weakness is being too lazy.

缺点.zh: 每个人都有自己的缺点，我们要学会接受。
缺点.en: Everyone has their own shortcomings, we need to learn to accept.

缺点.zh: 如果你能改正这个缺点，会变得更好。
缺点.en: If you can correct this weakness, you will become better.

缺点.zh: 这个产品的缺点是价格太贵。
缺点.en: The drawback of this product is that the price is too expensive.

少数.zh: 在大多数情况下，少数意见也很重要。
少数.en: In most situations, minority opinions are also important.

少数.zh: 虽然只有少数人支持，但我们还是要坚持。
少数.en: Although only a minority supports, we still need to persist.

少数.zh: 少数服从多数是常见的规则。
少数.en: The minority submits to the majority is a common rule.

没错.zh: 没错，他昨天确实来过了。
没错.en: That's right, he did come yesterday.

没错.zh: 你说得没错，但我们还是得小心。
没错.en: You are right, but we still need to be careful.

没错.zh: 没错，这就是我们需要的答案。
没错.en: Exactly, this is the answer we need.

胳膊.zh: 跑步时胳膊要自然摆动。
胳膊.en: When running, arms should swing naturally.

胳膊.zh: 他不仅胳膊粗，力气也很大。
胳膊.en: Not only are his arms thick, but he also has great strength.

胳膊.zh: 睡觉时把胳膊压在身下会麻。
胳膊.en: Sleeping with your arm under your body will make it numb.

办公.en: I am working in the office.

办公.zh: 周末我还要加班办公，真累。
办公.en: I have to work overtime on weekends, so tiring.

办公.zh: 如果你需要办公用品，可以去楼下买。
办公.en: If you need office supplies, you can buy them downstairs.

办公.zh: 他每天办公八小时，很辛苦。
办公.en: He works eight hours every day, very hard.

打败.zh: 在比赛中，我们终于打败了对手。
打败.en: In the competition, we finally defeated the opponent.

打败.zh: 虽然敌人很强大，但我们还是打败了他们。
打败.en: Although the enemy was strong, we still defeated them.

打败.zh: 他通过努力打败了所有竞争者。
打败.en: He defeated all competitors through hard work.

抽烟.en: He always smokes on the balcony.

抽烟.zh: 这里不能抽烟，请去外面。
抽烟.en: You can't smoke here, please go outside.

抽烟.zh: 我爸爸抽烟抽了好多年了。
抽烟.en: My father has been smoking for many years.

抽烟.zh: 虽然抽烟有害健康，但他还是戒不掉。
抽烟.en: Although smoking is harmful to health, he still can't quit.

抽烟.zh: 她闻到烟味就咳嗽，所以没人敢在她面前抽烟。
抽烟.en: She coughs when she smells smoke, so no one dares to smoke in front of her.

拉开.en: Please help me pull open the curtains.
He slowly pulled open the drawer.

拉开.zh: 一进门她就拉开了外套拉链。
拉开.en: As soon as she entered, she unzipped her jacket.

拉开.zh: 我用力一拉，门就拉开了。
拉开.en: I gave a hard pull and the door opened.

拉开.zh: 因为太热了，他直接把窗户拉开了一条缝。
拉开.en: Because it was too hot, he directly pulled the window open a crack.

大规模.zh: 公司要进行大规模裁员。
大规模.en: The company is going to carry out large-scale layoffs.

大规模.zh: 政府计划大规模修建新公路。
大规模.en: The government plans to build new roads on a large scale.

大规模.zh: 这次地震后，开始了大规模的救援行动。
大规模.en: After this earthquake, a large-scale rescue operation began.

大规模.zh: 因为疫情，他们取消了大规模聚会。
大规模.en: Because of the pandemic, they canceled large-scale gatherings.

北部.en: I live in the northern part of the city.
The northern part of this country is very cold.

北部.zh: 中国北部冬天会下大雪。
北部.en: Northern China gets heavy snow in winter.

北部.zh: 我们打算去北部山区旅行。
北部.en: We plan to travel to the northern mountainous area.

北部.zh: 虽然北部天气不好，但风景很美。
北部.en: Although the weather in the north is bad, the scenery is beautiful.

度假.en: We want to go to the beach for a vacation.

度假.zh: 你今年夏天去哪里度假？
度假.en: Where are you going for vacation this summer?

度假.zh: 他们每年都会去泰国度假。
度假.en: They go to Thailand for vacation every year.

度假.zh: 因为工作太忙，她很久没度假了。
度假.en: Because work is so busy, she hasn't had a vacation for a long time.

度假.zh: 这次度假我们租了一个小别墅。
度假.en: For this vacation, we rented a small villa.

老虎.en: The tiger is the king of the forest.

老虎.zh: 动物园里有两只大老虎。
老虎.en: There are two big tigers in the zoo.

老虎.zh: 小朋友很怕老虎的声音。
老虎.en: Children are very afraid of the tiger's roar.

老虎.zh: 我在电视上看过老虎捕猎。
老虎.en: I've seen tigers hunting on TV.

老虎.zh: 虽然他属虎，但他一点都不像老虎那么凶。
老虎.en: Although he was born in the Year of the Tiger, he is not fierce like a tiger at all.

停车场.en: The car is parked in the parking lot.

停车场.zh: 商场地下有个大停车场。
停车场.en: There is a large parking lot underground in the mall.

停车场.zh: 因为停车场满了，我们只好停在外面。
停车场.en: Because the parking lot was full, we had to park outside.

停车场.zh: 你记得停车场在几楼吗？
停车场.en: Do you remember which floor the parking lot is on?

牌子.zh: 这块牌子写着“禁止入内”。
你喜欢什么牌子的手机？
牌子.en: What brand of phone do you like?
The sign at the store entrance is very conspicuous.

牌子.zh: 他买了一个名牌子的包送给她。
牌子.en: He bought a famous brand bag for her.

牌子.zh: 虽然这牌子不贵，但质量很好。
牌子.en: Although this brand is not expensive, the quality is very good.

乘坐.en: I take the subway to work.
Please take the elevator to the third floor.
She likes to travel by train.

乘坐.zh: 这次出差我选择乘坐飞机。
乘坐.en: For this business trip, I chose to take a plane.

乘坐.zh: 因为堵车，乘坐公交比开车更快。
乘坐.en: Because of traffic jams, taking the bus is faster than driving.

诚实.en: Honesty is more important than cleverness.

诚实.zh: 如果你不诚实，别人就不会信任你。
诚实.en: If you are not honest, others won't trust you.

诚实.zh: 她诚实地说出了自己的想法。

毛衣.zh: 我昨天买了一件红色的毛衣。
毛衣.en: I bought a red sweater yesterday.

毛衣.zh: 天气冷了，你该穿件毛衣出门。
毛衣.en: It's getting cold, you should wear a sweater to go out.

毛衣.zh: 妈妈给我织的毛衣我一直舍不得穿。
毛衣.en: I can't bear to wear the sweater my mom knitted for me.
Is this sweater made of wool?

出租.en: I want to rent out my parking space.

出租.zh: 他们打算把二楼出租给一家公司。
出租.en: They plan to rent out the second floor to a company.

出租.zh: 因为要搬家，所以决定把旧房子出租出去。
出租.en: Because we're moving, we decided to rent out the old house.

出租.zh: 这里出租自行车，一小时十块钱。
出租.en: Bicycles are rented here, ten yuan per hour.

男士.en: There's a men-only passage over there.

男士.zh: 这件衬衫适合上班的男士穿。
男士.en: This shirt is suitable for men who go to work.

男士.zh: 那家店只卖男士服装和配饰。
男士.en: That store only sells men's clothing and accessories.

男士.zh: 如果男士想参加，请提前报名。
男士.en: If men want to participate, please register in advance.

老是.en: He always forgets to bring his keys.

老是.zh: 我老是记不住她的电话号码。
老是.en: I always can't remember her phone number.

老是.zh: 别老是玩手机，出去走走。
老是.en: Don't always play on your phone, go out for a walk.

老是.zh: 他老是说同样的话，我都听烦了。
老是.en: He always says the same thing, I'm tired of hearing it.

上门.zh: 明天有师傅上门修空调。
上门.en: A technician is coming to repair the air conditioner tomorrow.

上门.zh: 她不好意思主动上门拜访。
上门.en: She felt embarrassed to visit on her own initiative.

上门.zh: 因为快递太大，快递员不肯上门。
上门.en: Because the parcel was too big, the delivery driver refused to come to the door.

上门.zh: 我们约好周末上门看货。
上门.en: We made an appointment to come and see the goods this weekend.

童年.zh: 你还记得童年的小伙伴吗？
童年.en: Do you still remember your childhood friends?

童年.zh: 童年的时候，我经常去外婆家玩。
童年.en: During my childhood, I often went to my grandma's house to play.

童年.zh: 每次看到这张照片，就会想起我的童年。
童年.en: Every time I see this photo, I think of my childhood.

童年.zh: 他童年的梦想是当一名飞行员。
童年.en: His childhood dream was to become a pilot.

从中.en: We can all benefit from it.
He made a lot of money from it.

从中.zh: 这个故事告诉我们一个道理，希望你能从中学习。
从中.en: This story teaches us a lesson, I hope you can learn from it.

从中.zh: 如果你认真观察，就能从中发现规律。
从中.en: If you observe carefully, you can find patterns from it.

从中.zh: 我从中体会到了友谊的重要性。
从中.en: I came to realize the importance of friendship from it.

市区.en: I live in the city center.
Traffic in the city center is very congested.

市区.zh: 这家店在市区开了很多分店。
市区.en: This store has opened many branches in the city center.

市区.zh: 因为工作原因，他搬到了市区住。
市区.en: Because of work, he moved to live in the city center.

市区.zh: 从这里到市区开车要一个小时。
市区.en: It takes an hour to drive from here to the city center.

现有.en: The existing stock is running low.

现有.zh: 根据现有条件，我们只能做到这样。
现有.en: Based on the existing conditions, this is the best we can do.

现有.zh: 现有资金还不够买新设备。
现有.en: The current funds are not enough to buy new equipment.

现有.zh: 如果你想加入，现有名额还剩三个。
现有.en: If you want to join, there are three spots left.

月份.en: The weather is very hot this month.
Which month were you born in?
July is the start of summer vacation.

月份.zh: 我打算明年三月份去日本旅行。
月份.en: I plan to travel to Japan in March next year.

月份.zh: 因为订单太多，这个月份的产量翻倍了。
月份.en: Because there are too many orders, production this month has doubled.

孙子.en: My grandson is three years old this year.

孙子.zh: 因为孙子喜欢画画，所以我常带他去公园。
孙子.en: Because my grandson likes to draw, I often take him to the park.

孙子.zh: 我孙子昨天学会了骑自行车。
孙子.en: My grandson learned to ride a bike yesterday.

孙子.zh: 孙子放假的时候经常来我家玩。
孙子.en: My grandson often comes to my house to play during holidays.

优点.zh: 学习汉语的一个优点是能交到新朋友。
优点.en: One advantage of learning Chinese is being able to make new friends.

优点.zh: 这个手机的优点就是电池耐用。
优点.en: The advantage of this phone is its long-lasting battery.

优点.zh: 虽然价格有点贵，但它的优点很多。
优点.en: Although the price is a bit expensive, it has many advantages.

优点.zh: 每个人都有自己的优点和缺点。
优点.en: Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses.

客厅.en: My living room is very comfortable.
There is a TV in the living room.

客厅.zh: 客人来了以后，我们先在客厅坐一会儿。
客厅.en: After guests arrive, we first sit in the living room for a while.

客厅.zh: 因为客厅太小，所以我们就换了一个大一点的。
客厅.en: Because the living room was too small, we replaced it with a larger one.
I play on my phone in the living room.

难忘.zh: 那个夏天的晚上让我特别难忘。
难忘.en: That summer night is especially unforgettable for me.

难忘.zh: 虽然已经过了很久，但那段经历仍然难忘。
难忘.en: Although it has been a long time, that experience is still unforgettable.

难忘.zh: 难忘的回忆总是藏在心里。
难忘.en: Unforgettable memories are always hidden in the heart.

难忘.zh: 你最难忘的一件事情是什么？
难忘.en: What is your most unforgettable thing?

旅馆.zh: 我们住的旅馆离火车站很近。
旅馆.en: The hotel we stayed at is very close to the train station.

旅馆.zh: 因为旅馆满房了，所以我们只能换一家。
旅馆.en: Because the hotel was fully booked, we had to switch to another one.

旅馆.zh: 这家旅馆的服务态度非常好。
旅馆.en: The service attitude of this hotel is very good.

旅馆.zh: 你上次出差住的是哪个旅馆？
旅馆.en: Which hotel did you stay at during your last business trip?

来不及.zh: 我早上起晚了，来不及吃早饭。
来不及.en: I woke up late this morning and didn't have time to eat breakfast.

来不及.zh: 因为路上堵车，所以我们来不及赶上飞机。
来不及.en: Because of the traffic jam, we didn't have time to catch the plane.

来不及.zh: 时间太短，根本来不及准备。
来不及.en: The time is too short, there's simply not enough time to prepare.

来不及.zh: 作业太多，我来不及写完。
来不及.en: There is too much homework, I can't finish it in time.

普遍.zh: 在中国，使用手机支付已经很普遍了。
普遍.en: In China, using mobile payment has become very common.

普遍.zh: 虽然这种做法很普遍，但我觉得不太好。
普遍.en: Although this practice is common, I think it's not very good.

普遍.zh: 现在年轻人普遍喜欢用社交媒体。
普遍.en: Nowadays, young people generally like to use social media.

普遍.zh: 这个问题在考试中普遍存在。
普遍.en: This problem commonly exists in exams.

爱心.zh: 这家公司经常组织爱心活动。
爱心.en: This company often organizes charity events.

爱心.zh: 因为大家都很有爱心，所以捐赠了很多物品。
爱心.en: Because everyone is very compassionate, they donated many items.

爱心.zh: 他用爱心帮助了许多流浪动物。
爱心.en: He helped many stray animals with compassion.

爱心.zh: 爱心捐赠活动正在进行中。
爱心.en: The charity donation event is ongoing.

旅客.zh: 所有旅客请到三号登机口排队。
旅客.en: All passengers please line up at gate 3.

旅客.zh: 因为天气不好，很多旅客都滞留在了机场。
旅客.en: Because of bad weather, many travelers were stuck at the airport.
There are a lot of travelers at the train station.

旅客.zh: 这位旅客在找他的行李。
旅客.en: This passenger is looking for his luggage.

替代.zh: 我们找不到合适的替代方案。
替代.en: We can't find a suitable alternative plan.

替代.zh: 如果这个材料缺货，我们可以用别的替代。
替代.en: If this material is out of stock, we can use another as a substitute.

替代.zh: 人工成本太高，公司想用机器替代工人。
替代.en: Labor costs are too high, the company wants to replace workers with machines.

替代.zh: 这个角色没有人能替代。
替代.en: No one can replace this role.

美金.en: Do you have any US dollars on you?

美金.zh: 去美国旅行最好带些美金。
美金.en: It's best to bring some US dollars when traveling to the US.

美金.zh: 因为汇率变化，现在美金比人民币贵了很多。
美金.en: Because of exchange rate changes, the US dollar is now much more expensive than the renminbi.

美金.zh: 我昨天用美金付了房租。
美金.en: I paid the rent with US dollars yesterday.

美金.zh: 虽然美金涨了，但我们的生意没受影响。
美金.en: Although the US dollar has risen, our business hasn't been affected.

价钱.zh: 你觉得这个包价钱合理吗？
价钱.en: Do you think the price of this bag is reasonable?

价钱.zh: 价钱虽然高，但是质量很好。
价钱.en: Although the price is high, the quality is very good.

价钱.zh: 我买手机前先比较了价钱。
价钱.en: I compared the prices before buying the phone.

价钱.zh: 这家店的价钱比其他地方便宜不少。
价钱.en: The prices at this store are quite a bit cheaper than elsewhere.

外出.en: Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

外出.zh: 因为下雨，我们取消了外出的计划。
外出.en: Because it's raining, we canceled our plans to go out.

外出.zh: 他每周都会外出运动一次。
外出.en: He goes out to exercise once a week.

外出.zh: 如果你要外出，请告诉我一声。
外出.en: If you're going out, please let me know.

证件.zh: 出国旅行一定要带好证件。
证件.en: You must bring your documents when traveling abroad.

证件.zh: 办理手续需要身份证和其他证件。
证件.en: Processing the procedures requires an ID card and other documents.

证件.zh: 因为证件不全，他没能通过安检。
证件.en: Because his documents were incomplete, he couldn't get through security.

修理.en: My phone is broken and needs to be repaired.

修理.zh: 他正在修理那辆自行车。
因为冰箱坏了，我找人来修理。
修理.en: Because the fridge broke down, I called someone to repair it.

修理.zh: 这台电脑修理了三次还是有问题。
修理.en: This computer has been repaired three times and still has problems.

修理.zh: 如果你不会修理，可以找师傅帮忙。
修理.en: If you don't know how to repair it, you can ask a technician for help.

穿上.en: It's very cold today, put on a sweater.

穿上.zh: 出门之前记得穿上鞋子和袜子。
穿上.en: Remember to put on your shoes and socks before going out.

穿上.zh: 他穿上新衣服显得很精神。
穿上.en: He looks very energetic in his new clothes.

穿上.zh: 如果你觉得冷，就穿上这件大衣。
穿上.en: If you feel cold, put on this coat.

吸烟.en: He is smoking on the balcony.

吸烟.zh: 虽然吸烟有害健康，但他戒不掉。
吸烟.en: Although smoking is harmful to health, he can't quit.

吸烟.zh: 吸烟的人最好少去公共场所。
吸烟.en: People who smoke should avoid public places.

吸烟.zh: 因为吸烟会导致肺癌，所以很多人选择戒烟。
吸烟.en: Because smoking can cause lung cancer, many people choose to quit.

入口.en: The entrance is on the left.
The subway entrance is very noticeable.

入口.zh: 从这个入口进去，然后右转就到了。
入口.en: Go in through this entrance, then turn right and you'll arrive.

入口.zh: 请找到商场的入口再进去。
入口.en: Please find the entrance to the mall before going in.

入口.zh: 因为入口太小，很多人没注意到。
入口.en: Because the entrance was too small, many people didn't notice it.

加班.en: I have to work overtime again today.
He often works overtime until very late.

加班.zh: 因为项目截止日期快到了，大家都要加班。
加班.en: Because the project deadline is approaching, everyone has to work overtime.
Working overtime on weekends pays double.

加班.zh: 如果你不想加班，可以早点完成工作。
加班.en: If you don't want to work overtime, you can finish your work early.

将要.en: The game is about to start.
He will go abroad to study next week.

将要.zh: 因为天气不好，航班将要延误。
将要.en: Because of bad weather, the flight will be delayed.

将要.zh: 新政策将要影响很多人。
将要.en: The new policy will affect many people.

将要.zh: 如果一切顺利，我们将要提前完成项目。
将要.en: If everything goes smoothly, we will complete the project ahead of schedule.

底下.en: The cat is under the table.

底下.zh: 你把书放在抽屉底下就行了。
底下.en: Just put the book under the drawer.

底下.zh: 他在床底下找到了钥匙。
底下.en: He found the keys under the bed.

底下.zh: 虽然楼下很吵，但底下这层还算安静。
底下.en: Although upstairs is noisy, this floor down here is relatively quiet.

底下.zh: 我们住在山底下的小村子里。
底下.en: We live in a small village at the foot of the mountain.

途中.en: I ran into a friend on the way.

途中.zh: 我在去公司的途中买了早餐。
途中.en: I bought breakfast on my way to the office.

途中.zh: 旅行途中我们拍了很多照片。
途中.en: We took many photos during the trip.

途中.zh: 虽然途中下起了雨，但我们还是按时到了。
途中.en: Although it rained on the way, we still arrived on time.

途中.zh: 他打电话说途中堵车，会晚一点到。
途中.en: He called to say there was a traffic jam on the way, so he'd be a bit late.

美食.en: There is a lot of delicious food here.

美食.zh: 我们一起去尝尝当地的美食吧。
美食.en: Let's go try the local cuisine together.

美食.zh: 这家餐厅的美食真的很不错。
美食.en: The food at this restaurant is really good.

美食.zh: 每到一个地方，我都会寻找特色美食。
美食.en: Whenever I go to a place, I look for local specialties.

美食.zh: 她不仅会做饭，还经常研究新的美食做法。
美食.en: She not only cooks but also often researches new ways to make delicious food.

鲜.zh: 水果要买新鲜的才好吃。
鲜.en: Fruit tastes best when it's fresh.

鲜.zh: 早上市场里的蔬菜都很鲜。
鲜.en: The vegetables in the morning market are all very fresh.

鲜.zh: 虽然价格贵一点，但这个牌子的牛奶特别鲜。
鲜.en: Although it's a bit more expensive, this brand of milk is especially fresh.
He likes to drink freshly squeezed orange juice.

热闹.zh: 节日的时候，广场上非常热闹。
热闹.en: During festivals, the square is very bustling.

热闹.zh: 这家新开的火锅店生意很热闹。
热闹.en: This newly opened hotpot restaurant is doing a bustling business.

热闹.zh: 虽然平时人不多，但周末这里特别热闹。
热闹.en: Although it's not crowded on weekdays, it's especially lively on weekends.

热闹.zh: 公园里一群老人唱歌跳舞，热闹极了。
热闹.en: A group of elderly people were singing and dancing in the park, it was extremely lively.

点头.zh: 我问她是否同意，她轻轻点了点头。
点头.en: I asked if she agreed, and she nodded slightly.

点头.zh: 老板听完我的建议，满意地点了点头。
点头.en: After hearing my suggestion, the boss nodded with satisfaction.

点头.zh: 他一句话没说，只是点头示意我继续。
点头.en: He didn't say a word, just nodded to signal me to continue.

点头.zh: 虽然心里不太赞成，但他还是勉强点了点头。
点头.en: Although he didn't really agree, he still nodded reluctantly.

散步.zh: 晚饭后我喜欢在公园里散步。
散步.en: After dinner, I like to take a walk in the park.

散步.zh: 他每天早晨都会散步半小时。
散步.en: He takes a walk for half an hour every morning.

散步.zh: 因为天气好，我决定出门散步一会儿。
散步.en: Because the weather is nice, I decided to go out for a short walk.

散步.zh: 散步不仅锻炼身体，还能放松心情。
散步.en: Walking not only exercises the body but also relaxes the mind.

顺序.zh: 做题的时候要按照顺序来，不要跳。
顺序.en: When doing the problems, follow the order and don't skip.

顺序.zh: 请把这几本书按顺序放好。
顺序.en: Please put these books in order.

顺序.zh: 虽然名单很长，但老师是按顺序念名字的。
顺序.en: Although the list is long, the teacher called names in order.

顺序.zh: 我们得先确定一下发言的顺序。
顺序.en: We need to first decide the order of speaking.

低于.zh: 这次考试他的分数低于平均水平。
低于.en: His score on this exam was below average.

低于.zh: 如果价格低于一百块，我就买。
低于.en: If the price is below 100 yuan, I'll buy it.

低于.zh: 这款手机的质量并不低于那些高端品牌。
低于.en: The quality of this phone is not lower than those high-end brands.

低于.zh: 因为收入低于标准，他们可以申请补助。
低于.en: Because their income is below the standard, they can apply for subsidies.

瓜.en: Eating watermelon in summer is the best way to beat the heat.

瓜.zh: 妈妈买了一个大冬瓜回来。
瓜.en: Mom bought a big winter melon.

瓜.zh: 虽然瓜看起来很熟，但吃起来不怎么甜。
瓜.en: Although the melon looks ripe, it doesn't taste very sweet.

瓜.zh: 他喜欢把哈密瓜切成小块当零食。
瓜.en: He likes to cut cantaloupe into small pieces as a snack.

懒.en: Too lazy, don't want to move.

懒.zh: 他最近很懒，连作业都不想做。
懒.en: He's been very lazy lately, he doesn't even want to do homework.

懒.zh: 你别再懒了，快起来干活。
懒.en: Don't be lazy anymore, get up and work.

懒.zh: 因为太懒，他错过了很多机会。
懒.en: Because he was too lazy, he missed a lot of opportunities.

懒.zh: 我有时候很懒，只想躺在床上看手机。
懒.en: Sometimes I'm very lazy, I just want to lie in bed and look at my phone.

院长.en: The dean went to a meeting.

院长.zh: 我们院长人很好，很关心学生。
院长.en: Our dean is a very good person, he cares a lot about students.

院长.zh: 今天下午院长要来检查工作。
院长.en: The dean is coming to inspect the work this afternoon.

院长.zh: 院长说了，这个项目很重要。
院长.en: The dean said that this project is very important.

院长.zh: 如果你有问题，可以直接找院长谈。
院长.en: If you have a problem, you can go directly to the dean to talk.

大夫.en: This doctor's medical skills are excellent.

大夫.zh: 昨天我去医院，大夫给我开了药。
大夫.en: Yesterday I went to the hospital, the doctor prescribed me medicine.

大夫.zh: 我妈妈就是一位大夫，工作很忙。
大夫.en: My mom is a doctor, she's very busy at work.

大夫.zh: 如果你不舒服，赶紧去找大夫看看。
大夫.en: If you feel unwell, go see the doctor quickly.

准时.en: He goes to work on time every day.

准时.zh: 你要准时来，别让大家等你。
准时.en: You have to come on time, don't make everyone wait for you.

准时.zh: 虽然下雨了，但他还是准时到了。
准时.en: Although it was raining, he still arrived on time.

准时.zh: 这个活动很重要，请务必准时参加。
准时.en: This event is very important, please be sure to attend on time.

盒子.zh: 我把礼物放在盒子里了。
盒子.en: I put the gift in the box.

盒子.zh: 地上有一个纸盒子，是谁的？
盒子.en: There's a cardboard box on the floor, whose is it?

盒子.zh: 那个盒子装满了玩具，很重。
盒子.en: That box is full of toys, it's very heavy.

盒子.zh: 你帮我把盒子打开，里面有个惊喜。
盒子.en: Help me open the box, there's a surprise inside.

上个月.zh: 上个月我去了一趟北京。
上个月.en: I went to Beijing last month.

上个月.zh: 上个月的房租我还没交。
上个月.en: I haven't paid last month's rent yet.

上个月.zh: 他上个月刚换了新工作。
上个月.en: He just changed to a new job last month.

上个月.zh: 上个月天气很热，这个月凉快多了。
上个月.en: Last month the weather was very hot, this month it's much cooler.

上个月.zh: 你上个月借给我的书，我还了没有？
上个月.en: Did I return the book you lent me last month?

前后.en: Around Spring Festival, it's hard to buy train tickets.
There are gardens in the front and back of the house.

前后.zh: 我前后等了两个小时才见到他。
前后.en: I waited a total of two hours before seeing him.
Before and after the exam, he was very nervous.

得意.en: He got first place and is very proud.

得意.zh: 你别太得意，下次可能输。
得意.en: Don't be too smug, you might lose next time.

得意.zh: 他考了满分，得意得不得了。
得意.en: He got a perfect score and is extremely pleased with himself.

得意.zh: 虽然很成功，但他并没有得意忘形。
得意.en: Although he was very successful, he didn't get carried away.

学费.en: This year's tuition has gone up again.
I work part-time to earn some tuition.

学费.zh: 他家里没钱，交不起学费。
学费.en: His family has no money, they can't afford the tuition.

学费.zh: 学校说学费可以分期付。
学费.en: The school said tuition can be paid in installments.

前方.en: There is a red light ahead.
Watch ahead, a car is coming.

前方.zh: 前方就是我们的目的地了。

礼貌.en: He is very polite to people.

礼貌.zh: 虽然她年纪小，但说话很有礼貌。
礼貌.en: Although she is young, she speaks very politely.

礼貌.zh: 去别人家做客一定要有礼貌。
礼貌.en: You must be polite when visiting someone's home.

礼貌.zh: 我觉得他刚才那样做不太礼貌。
礼貌.en: I think what he did just now was not very polite.

礼貌.zh: 如果你没有礼貌，别人就不愿意跟你做朋友。
礼貌.en: If you are not polite, others won't want to be friends with you.

毕业生.zh: 今天学校开了毕业生大会。
毕业生.en: The school held a graduate assembly today.

毕业生.zh: 他是一名优秀的毕业生。
毕业生们都在忙着找工作。
毕业生.en: The graduates are all busy looking for jobs.

毕业生.zh: 因为今年毕业生很多，所以竞争很激烈。
毕业生.en: Because there are many graduates this year, the competition is fierce.

毕业生.zh: 她作为毕业生代表上台发言，大家都为她鼓掌。
毕业生.en: As a graduate representative, she spoke on stage and everyone applauded for her.

歌声.en: Her singing voice is really nice.

歌声.zh: 我从远处就听到了她的歌声。
歌声.en: I could hear her singing from afar.

歌声.zh: 在音乐会上，大家的歌声非常动人。
歌声.en: At the concert, everyone's singing was very moving.

歌声.zh: 虽然他不认识歌词，但歌声里全是感情。
歌声.en: Although he didn't know the lyrics, his singing was full of emotion.

歌声.zh: 每天晚上，广场上都能听到老人们的歌声。
歌声.en: Every evening, you can hear the old people's singing in the square.

帅哥.en: Handsome guy, excuse me, what time is it now?

帅哥.zh: 他长得真帅，大家都叫他帅哥。
帅哥.en: He looks really handsome; everyone calls him handsome guy.

帅哥.zh: 虽然他是个帅哥，但性格很差。
帅哥.en: Although he is a handsome guy, his personality is terrible.

帅哥.zh: 她每次见到帅哥都会脸红，然后就不敢说话了。
帅哥.en: Every time she sees a handsome guy, she blushes and then dares not speak.

推迟.zh: 因为下雨，比赛推迟到下周。
推迟.en: Because of rain, the game is postponed to next week.

推迟.zh: 老板说面试时间要推迟半小时。
推迟.en: The boss said the interview time will be postponed by half an hour.

推迟.zh: 如果天气不好，我们就把活动推迟。
推迟.en: If the weather is bad, we will postpone the event.

推迟.zh: 他本来打算今天出发，后来临时推迟了。
推迟.en: He originally planned to leave today, but then postponed it at the last minute.

老家.zh: 今年春节我打算回老家。
老家.en: I plan to go back to my hometown this Spring Festival.

老家.zh: 他虽然在城市工作，但心里一直想着老家。
老家.en: Although he works in the city, he always thinks about his hometown.

老家.zh: 老家的空气比城市好多了。
老家.en: The air in my hometown is much better than in the city.

老家.zh: 每次回老家，我都会去看望爷爷奶奶。
老家.en: Every time I go back to my hometown, I visit my grandparents.

饼干.en: This box of biscuits was bought by my younger sister.

饼干.zh: 我喜欢把饼干泡在牛奶里吃。
饼干.en: I like to dip biscuits in milk and eat them.

饼干.zh: 虽然饼干很好吃，但吃多了容易胖。
饼干.en: Although biscuits are tasty, eating too many can make you gain weight.

饼干.zh: 他出门前在包里放了几块饼干，免得饿。
饼干.en: Before going out, he put a few biscuits in his bag to avoid hunger.

葡萄.en: Mom bought a bunch of purple grapes.
I don't like eating sour grapes.

葡萄.zh: 如果你把葡萄放在冰箱里，会更好吃。
葡萄.en: If you put the grapes in the fridge, they will taste better.

葡萄.zh: 夏天的时候，我们经常一边吃葡萄一边看电视。
葡萄.en: In the summer, we often eat grapes while watching TV.

抬头.en: He looked up and saw the sky.

抬头.zh: 走路的时候不要一直低头，偶尔也要抬头。
抬头.en: When walking, don't always look down; occasionally you should look up.

抬头.zh: 她一抬头，发现大家都在看她。
抬头.en: She looked up and found everyone looking at her.

抬头.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他偶尔会抬头活动一下脖子。
抬头.en: Although work is busy, he occasionally looks up to stretch his neck.

感人.en: The ending of the movie is especially touching.

感人.zh: 她讲了一个感人的爱情故事。
感人.en: She told a touching love story.

感人.zh: 虽然情节很简单，但还是很感人。
感人.en: Although the plot was very simple, it was still touching.

感人.zh: 每次看那段视频，我都觉得很感人，忍不住想哭。
感人.en: Every time I watch that video, I find it very touching and can't help but want to cry.

中年.zh: 他到了中年才学会放松。
中年.en: He only learned to relax when he reached middle age.

中年.zh: 中年人的生活压力通常很大。
中年.en: Middle-aged people usually have a lot of life stress.

中年.zh: 虽然才四十岁，但他已经显露出中年的疲惫。
中年.en: Although only forty, he already shows signs of middle-aged fatigue.

中年.zh: 很多中年人开始注重健康，因为身体不如以前了。
中年.en: Many middle-aged people start focusing on health because their bodies aren't what they used to be.

中年.zh: 她中年时换了工作，结果发现生活反而更精彩了。
中年.en: She changed jobs in middle age, and it turned out life became even more exciting.

院子.en: There is a big locust tree in the yard.
Grandma is airing the quilt in the yard.

院子.zh: 孩子们在院子里跑来跑去，玩得很开心。
院子.en: The children are running around in the yard, having a great time.

院子.zh: 我们家的院子不大，但种满了花花草草。
院子.en: Our yard isn't big, but it's full of flowers and plants.

院子.zh: 如果天气好，我们喜欢在院子里吃晚饭。
院子.en: If the weather is nice, we like to have dinner in the yard.

性别.zh: 这个工作不看性别，只看能力。
性别.en: This job doesn't look at gender, only ability.

性别.zh: 报名表上要填写性别和年龄。
性别.en: You need to fill in gender and age on the registration form.

性别.zh: 现在很多父母不再对孩子的性别有偏见了。
性别.en: Now many parents no longer have prejudice about their child's gender.

性别.zh: 虽然性别不同，但他们成了最好的朋友。
性别.en: Although they are of different genders, they became best friends.

性别.zh: 公司决定招聘更多女性员工来平衡性别比例。
性别.en: The company decided to hire more female employees to balance the gender ratio.

友情.zh: 他们的友情维持了二十年。
友情.en: Their friendship has lasted twenty years.

友情.zh: 真正的友情经得起时间的考验。
友情.en: True friendship can withstand the test of time.

友情.zh: 我特别珍惜大学时建立的友情。
友情.en: I especially cherish the friendships I made in college.

友情.zh: 虽然我们很少见面，但友情从来没变过。
友情.en: Although we rarely meet, the friendship has never changed.

友情.zh: 她需要帮助的时候，我立刻赶去了，这就是友情吧。
友情.en: When she needed help, I went right away — that's what friendship is, I guess.

袜子.zh: 这双袜子是羊毛的，特别暖和。
袜子.en: These socks are woolen and very warm.

袜子.zh: 他总把袜子乱扔，妈妈很生气。
袜子.en: He always throws his socks around, and his mom gets very angry.

袜子.zh: 今天穿了一双新袜子，脚感很舒服。
袜子.en: Today I wore a new pair of socks, and they feel very comfortable.

袜子.zh: 记得冬天出门前穿上厚袜子，不然脚会冻伤。
袜子.en: Remember to wear thick socks before going out in winter, or your feet will get frostbitten.

气候.en: The climate here is very dry.

气候.zh: 我不喜欢南方的潮湿气候。
气候.en: I don't like the humid climate of the south.

气候.zh: 全球气候变暖已经成了大问题。
气候.en: Global warming has become a big problem.

气候.zh: 因为气候太热，我们只好待在空调房里。
气候.en: Because the climate is too hot, we had to stay in the air-conditioned room.

气候.zh: 这个城市的气候四季分明，冬天冷夏天热。
气候.en: The climate in this city has four distinct seasons, cold in winter and hot in summer.

毛巾.en: He wiped his face with a towel.

毛巾.zh: 毛巾用久了要换新的，不然会滋生细菌。
毛巾.en: Towels should be replaced after long use, otherwise bacteria will grow.

毛巾.zh: 我洗完澡发现忘了拿毛巾。
毛巾.en: After I took a shower, I realized I forgot to bring a towel.

毛巾.zh: 去健身房的时候，别忘了带一条干净的毛巾。
毛巾.en: When going to the gym, don't forget to bring a clean towel.

办理.zh: 请在这里办理入住手续。
我需要办理一张新银行卡。
办理.en: I need to apply for a new bank card.

办理.zh: 办理护照需要带身份证和照片。
办理.en: To apply for a passport, you need to bring your ID and photos.

办理.zh: 这个业务可以在网上办理，不用去柜台。
办理.en: This service can be handled online, no need to go to the counter.

办理.zh: 他花了两个小时才办理完所有的文件。
办理.en: It took him two hours to finish processing all the documents.

分数.zh: 他的数学分数一直很高。
分数.en: His math scores have always been high.

分数.zh: 别太在意分数，学到东西才重要。
分数.en: Don't care too much about scores; learning something is what matters.

分数.zh: 因为分数不够，他没能考上那所大学。
分数.en: Because his scores weren't high enough, he didn't get into that university.

分数.zh: 老师说这次期中考试分数普遍偏低。
分数.en: The teacher said the scores on this midterm were generally low.

寒冷.en: Winter in the north is extremely cold.

寒冷.zh: 寒冷让他的手都冻僵了。
寒冷.en: The cold froze his hands stiff.

寒冷.zh: 为了抵御寒冷，他穿了三层衣服。
寒冷.en: To ward off the cold, he wore three layers of clothing.

寒冷.zh: 虽然天气寒冷，但大家还是坚持去晨跑。
寒冷.en: Although the weather was cold, everyone still insisted on going for a morning run.

寒冷.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚，喝一碗热汤是最幸福的事。
寒冷.en: On a cold night, drinking a bowl of hot soup is the happiest thing.

鲜花.zh: 她买了一束鲜花放在桌上。
鲜花.en: She bought a bunch of fresh flowers and put them on the table.

鲜花.zh: 这束鲜花是朋友送的生日礼物。
鲜花.en: This bouquet of flowers is a birthday gift from a friend.

鲜花.zh: 我喜欢在春天去花店买鲜花，因为那时候品种特别多。
鲜花.en: I like to go to the flower shop in spring to buy fresh flowers because there are many varieties then.

鲜花.zh: 他每天都给女朋友送一束鲜花，真是浪漫。
鲜花.en: He gives his girlfriend a bouquet of fresh flowers every day, how romantic.

鲜花.zh: 虽然鲜花很漂亮，但是它们很快就凋谢了。
鲜花.en: Although fresh flowers are beautiful, they wither quickly.

冬季.en: Winter is very cold, you need to wear more clothes.

冬季.zh: 我喜欢冬季，因为可以滑雪。
冬季.en: I like winter because I can go skiing.

冬季.zh: 这个冬季我们打算去哈尔滨看冰灯。
冬季.en: This winter we plan to go to Harbin to see the ice lanterns.

冬季.zh: 冬季的时候，北方会下很大的雪。
冬季.en: In winter, it snows heavily in the north.

冬季.zh: 虽然冬季很冷，但是一家人围在一起吃火锅很温暖。
冬季.en: Although winter is very cold, it's warm when the family gathers to eat hotpot.

葡萄酒.en: This bottle of wine tastes good.

葡萄酒.zh: 他喜欢在晚餐时喝一点葡萄酒。
葡萄酒.en: He likes to drink a little wine at dinner.

葡萄酒.zh: 法国的葡萄酒很有名，很多人都会买。
葡萄酒.en: French wine is very famous, many people buy it.

葡萄酒.zh: 我不太会选葡萄酒，所以每次都请朋友帮忙。
葡萄酒.en: I'm not good at choosing wine, so I always ask a friend for help.

葡萄酒.zh: 虽然葡萄酒很好喝，但也不要喝太多。
葡萄酒.en: Although wine tastes good, don't drink too much.

害羞.zh: 她有点害羞，不太敢说话。
害羞.en: She is a bit shy and doesn't dare to speak much.

害羞.zh: 小男孩害羞地躲在妈妈身后。
害羞.en: The little boy shyly hid behind his mother.

害羞.zh: 见到陌生人时，他常常会脸红害羞。
害羞.en: When meeting strangers, he often blushes and feels shy.

害羞.zh: 虽然她很害羞，但在舞台上表演时却很大方。
害羞.en: Although she is very shy, she is very natural when performing on stage.

害羞.zh: 别害羞，大家都是朋友，随便聊聊就好。
害羞.en: Don't be shy, we're all friends, just chat casually.

降落.en: The plane is about to land.

降落.zh: 直升机降落在楼顶的停机坪上。
降落.en: The helicopter landed on the rooftop helipad.

降落.zh: 因为天气不好，飞机推迟了降落时间。
降落.en: Because of bad weather, the plane delayed its landing time.

降落.zh: 降落伞打开后，他慢慢地落到了地面。
降落.en: After the parachute opened, he slowly landed on the ground.

降落.zh: 虽然降落时有点颠簸，但最后还是安全落地了。
降落.en: Although it was a bit bumpy during landing, we finally touched down safely.

剧院.zh: 我们今晚去剧院看话剧。
剧院.en: We're going to the theater to see a play tonight.

剧院.zh: 这家剧院已经有五十年的历史了。
剧院.en: This theater has a history of fifty years.

剧院.zh: 剧院里不能大声说话，要保持安静。
剧院.en: You can't talk loudly in the theater; keep quiet.

剧院.zh: 朋友推荐我去那个剧院看一场音乐剧，听说很不错。
剧院.en: My friend recommended me to go to that theater to see a musical, heard it's very good.

剧院.zh: 虽然剧院离我家很远，但我还是坐地铁去了。
剧院.en: Although the theater is far from my home, I still took the subway to go.

课堂.zh: 今天课堂上的讨论非常有趣。
课堂.en: Today's discussion in class was very interesting.

课堂.zh: 他每次在课堂上都积极回答老师的问题。
课堂.en: He always actively answers the teacher's questions in class.

课堂.zh: 因为迟到了，他不好意思走进课堂。
课堂.en: Because he was late, he felt embarrassed to enter the classroom.

课堂.zh: 虽然课堂纪律很严格，但我觉得这样对学习有好处。
课堂.en: Although classroom discipline is very strict, I think it's good for learning.

来得及.zh: 现在出发，应该来得及赶上火车。
来得及.en: If we leave now, we should be in time to catch the train.

来得及.zh: 你跑快点，还来得及买票！
来得及.en: Run faster, there's still time to buy tickets!

来得及.zh: 虽然离考试只有三天，但认真复习还来得及。
来得及.en: Although there are only three days until the exam, it's still possible to review seriously.

穷人.zh: 那个村子里的穷人很多。
穷人.en: There are many poor people in that village.

穷人.zh: 他虽然是穷人，但活得很快乐。
穷人.en: Although he is poor, he lives happily.

穷人.zh: 政府正在想办法帮助穷人改善生活。
穷人.en: The government is trying to help poor people improve their lives.

穷人.zh: 穷人有时候比富人更懂得珍惜。
穷人.en: Sometimes poor people know better how to appreciate things than rich people.

穷人.zh: 如果大家都伸出援手，穷人就能过上好日子。
穷人.en: If everyone lends a helping hand, poor people can live a better life.

咳嗽.zh: 他咳嗽得很厉害，需要吃药。
咳嗽.en: He coughs very badly and needs to take medicine.

咳嗽.zh: 感冒了就会咳嗽，要多喝水。
咳嗽.en: When you catch a cold, you cough; you should drink more water.

咳嗽.zh: 她一边咳嗽一边说话，听起来很难受。
咳嗽.en: She was coughing while talking, it sounded painful.

咳嗽.zh: 因为咳嗽，他晚上睡不好觉。
咳嗽.en: Because of coughing, he couldn't sleep well at night.

咳嗽.zh: 虽然咳嗽已经好多了，但还是不能吃辣的东西。
咳嗽.en: Although the cough is much better, I still can't eat spicy food.

研究生.zh: 我姐姐去年考上了研究生，现在每天都很忙。
研究生.en: My sister got into graduate school last year, and now she's very busy every day.

研究生.zh: 虽然他是研究生，但还经常去图书馆学习。
研究生.en: Although he is a graduate student, he often goes to the library to study.

研究生.zh: 我们实验室的研究生都很努力。
研究生.en: The graduate students in our lab are all very hardworking.

研究生.zh: 研究生毕业后，他打算继续读博士。
研究生.en: After graduating from graduate school, he plans to pursue a PhD.

出差.en: I have a business trip next week.

出差.zh: 老板让我去上海出差三天。
出差.en: The boss asked me to go to Shanghai on a business trip for three days.

出差.zh: 因为要出差，所以我提前订了机票。
出差.en: Because I have a business trip, I booked the flight in advance.
He often goes on business trips and is rarely at home.

出差.zh: 出差虽然累，但可以认识新朋友。
出差.en: Business trips are tiring, but you can meet new friends.

树林.zh: 周末我们去树林里散步，空气特别好。
树林.en: We went for a walk in the woods on the weekend; the air was really good.

树林.zh: 如果下雨，我就不去树林里跑步了。
树林.en: If it rains, I won't go running in the woods.

树林.zh: 树林里有很多小鸟和松鼠。
树林.en: There are many birds and squirrels in the woods.
She likes to paint in the woods.

高于.en: His score is higher than mine.

高于.zh: 今年公司的利润高于去年。
高于.en: This year's company profit is higher than last year's.

高于.zh: 由于成本高于预期，我们不得不调整价格。
高于.en: Because the costs are higher than expected, we have to adjust the price.

高于.zh: 这个城市的房价高于周边地区。
高于.en: Housing prices in this city are higher than the surrounding areas.

以内.zh: 请在十公里以内找一家酒店。
以内.en: Please find a hotel within ten kilometers.

以内.zh: 如果你能在预算以内买到，那就太好了。
以内.en: If you can buy it within the budget, that would be great.

以内.zh: 这个价格在一千元以内。
以内.en: This price is within one thousand yuan.

以内.zh: 我们必须在规定时间以内到达。
以内.en: We must arrive within the specified time.

目的地.zh: 旅行的目的地选好了吗？
目的地.en: Have you chosen the destination for the trip?

目的地.zh: 虽然路途很远，但到达目的地时大家都很开心。
目的地.en: Although the journey is long, everyone was happy when we arrived at the destination.

目的地.zh: 他打开导航，输入了目的地。
目的地.en: He opened the navigation and entered the destination.

目的地.zh: 这次徒步的目的地是一个小山村。
目的地.en: The destination of this hike is a small mountain village.

多种.zh: 这家店卖多种口味的冰淇淋。
多种.en: This shop sells multiple flavors of ice cream.

多种.zh: 因为需求多样，所以我们提供了多种方案。
多种.en: Because the demands are diverse, we provided multiple plans.

多种.zh: 他尝试了多种方法，终于成功了。
多种.en: He tried multiple methods and finally succeeded.

多种.zh: 植物园里种植了多种珍稀植物。
多种.en: The botanical garden grows multiple rare plants.

快递.zh: 我在网上买了东西，快递明天送到。
快递.en: I bought something online; the express delivery will arrive tomorrow.

快递.zh: 因为快递太多，所以快递员忙不过来。
快递.en: Because there are too many packages, the delivery person is too busy.

快递.zh: 这个快递是从上海寄来的。
快递.en: This express delivery is sent from Shanghai.
The express company also works on Saturdays.

酸奶.zh: 早上喝一杯酸奶对身体很好。
酸奶.en: Drinking a cup of yogurt in the morning is good for health.

酸奶.zh: 如果酸奶过期了，就不要喝了。
酸奶.en: If the yogurt is expired, don't drink it.

酸奶.zh: 超市里的酸奶种类很多。
酸奶.en: There are many kinds of yogurt in the supermarket.

酸奶.zh: 她做水果沙拉时加了一点酸奶。
酸奶.en: She added a little yogurt when making fruit salad.

气温.zh: 明天最低气温只有五度。
气温.en: Tomorrow's lowest temperature is only five degrees.

气温.zh: 虽然气温很低，但他只穿了一件外套。
气温.en: Although the temperature is very low, he only wore one coat.
Large temperature changes make it easy to catch a cold.

两边.zh: 这条路两边种了很多树，所以夏天很凉快。
两边.en: This road has many trees on both sides, so it's very cool in summer.

两边.zh: 两边意见不同，很难协调。
两边.en: The two sides have different opinions, making it hard to coordinate.

两边.zh: 我们小区两边都有超市，买东西很方便。
两边.en: Our neighborhood has supermarkets on both sides, so shopping is very convenient.
Stand in the middle of the two sides, don't move.

按时.en: Don't forget to take your medicine on time.

按时.zh: 虽然很忙，但他还是按时完成了工作。
按时.en: Although he was very busy, he still finished the work on time.
Going to bed on time every day is very important.

按时.zh: 我们得按时交作业，不然会被老师批评。
按时.en: We have to hand in our homework on time, otherwise the teacher will criticize us.

按时.zh: 他每天按时上下班，从不迟到。
按时.en: He goes to and from work on time every day and is never late.

暑假.en: Have you finished your summer vacation homework?

暑假.zh: 因为暑假很长，所以我想学一门新技能。
暑假.en: Because summer vacation is long, I want to learn a new skill.
I'm going to work a part-time job during summer vacation.

暑假.zh: 去年暑假我们全家去了云南旅游，非常开心。
暑假.en: Last summer vacation, our whole family went to Yunnan for a trip and had a great time.

暑假.zh: 暑假里我每天都会游泳。
暑假.en: I swim every day during summer vacation.

梦见.en: I've been dreaming about you a lot lately.

梦见.zh: 昨天晚上我梦见自己变成了一只鸟，很神奇。
梦见.en: Last night I dreamed I turned into a bird—it was amazing.

梦见.zh: 她梦见自己获奖了，醒来以后特别开心。
梦见.en: She dreamed she won an award, and was really happy after waking up.
I rarely dream about things from the past.

不光.en: He is not only smart but also hardworking.

不光.zh: 这家店不光东西好，而且价格也便宜。
不光.en: This store not only has good products but also has cheap prices.
It's not just that I can do it—you can too.

不光.zh: 这次旅行不光好玩，还学到了很多东西。
不光.en: This trip was not only fun but also taught me a lot.

不光.zh: 他不光会说中文，还会英文。
不光.en: He not only speaks Chinese but also English.

夏季.zh: 虽然夏季很热，但可以去游泳解暑。
夏季.en: Although summer is very hot, you can go swimming to cool off.

夏季.zh: 夏季的白天很长，晚上八点才天黑。
夏季.en: Summer days are long; it doesn't get dark until 8 p.m.

夏季.zh: 夏季到来前要准备好空调。
夏季.en: Prepare the air conditioner before summer arrives.

获奖.zh: 因为作品很优秀，所以她在比赛中获奖了。
获奖.en: Because her work was excellent, she won an award in the competition.
Were you happy after winning the award?

获奖.zh: 我们公司的新产品刚刚在国际展会上获奖。
获奖.en: Our company's new product just won an award at an international exhibition.

获奖.zh: 这部小说获奖后很受欢迎。
获奖.en: This novel became very popular after winning an award.

咸.zh: 虽然汤有点咸，但是味道还不错。
咸.en: Although the soup is a bit salty, the flavor is still good.
Do you like eating salted fish?

咸.zh: 做饭时盐放少了没味道，放多了又太咸。
咸.en: When cooking, too little salt makes it bland, but too much makes it too salty.
I can't eat things that are too salty.

咳.zh: 他咳了一晚上，所以今天去看医生了。
咳.en: He coughed all night, so he went to see the doctor today.

咳.zh: 空气不好，很多人都在咳，最好戴口罩。
咳.en: The air quality is bad; many people are coughing—better to wear a mask.

咳.zh: 他一边咳一边说话，让人听不清。
咳.en: He talks while coughing, making it hard for people to hear clearly.

爱国.zh: 虽然生活在国外，但他依然非常爱国。
爱国.en: Although he lives abroad, he is still very patriotic.

爱国.zh: 我们从小就要学会爱国，为国家做出贡献。
爱国.en: We must learn to be patriotic from a young age and contribute to our country.

爱国.zh: 老师经常教育我们要爱国爱家。
爱国.en: Teachers often teach us to love our country and our family.

体温.en: I have a cold, my temperature is a bit high.

体温.zh: 虽然他没发烧，但体温还是比平时高。
体温.en: Although he didn't have a fever, his temperature was still higher than usual.

体温.zh: 护士给他量了体温，说正常。
体温.en: The nurse took his temperature and said it was normal.

体温.zh: 体温计摔碎了，得买个新的。
体温.en: The thermometer broke, I need to buy a new one.

果汁.zh: 这杯果汁是鲜榨的，很甜。
果汁.en: This glass of juice is freshly squeezed and very sweet.

果汁.zh: 如果你渴了，冰箱里有果汁。
果汁.en: If you're thirsty, there's juice in the fridge.

果汁.zh: 小朋友都喜欢喝果汁，但糖分太高。
果汁.en: Kids all like juice, but the sugar content is too high.

果汁.zh: 我买了两瓶果汁，一瓶橙子一瓶苹果。
果汁.en: I bought two bottles of juice, one orange and one apple.

奖学金.zh: 她因为成绩好，拿到了学校的奖学金。
奖学金.en: Because of her good grades, she got the school's scholarship.

奖学金.zh: 要是你能拿到奖学金，爸妈会很高兴。
奖学金.en: If you can get a scholarship, your parents will be very happy.
The scholarship is enough to cover tuition.

奖学金.zh: 我们学校每年都有很多奖学金名额。
奖学金.en: Our school has many scholarship slots every year.

厨师.en: The chef at this place is very good.

厨师.zh: 他是一名五星级酒店的厨师。
厨师.en: He is a chef at a five-star hotel.

厨师.zh: 虽然他是厨师，但很少在家里做饭。
厨师.en: Although he is a chef, he rarely cooks at home.

厨师.zh: 我弟弟想当厨师，因为他喜欢做菜。
厨师.en: My younger brother wants to be a chef because he likes cooking.

加油站.zh: 我们的车快没油了，得找个加油站。
加油站.en: Our car is almost out of gas, we need to find a gas station.

加油站.zh: 因为油价涨了，加油站的生意反而更好。
加油站.en: Because gas prices went up, the gas station's business actually got better.

加油站.zh: 加油站旁边有个便利店。
加油站.en: There's a convenience store next to the gas station.

加油站.zh: 这个加油站二十四小时营业。
加油站.en: This gas station is open 24 hours.

郊区.en: My family lives in the suburbs.

郊区.zh: 郊区空气比市中心好很多。
郊区.en: The air in the suburbs is much better than in the city center.

郊区.zh: 虽然郊区安静，但上班不太方便。
郊区.en: Although the suburbs are quiet, commuting to work is not very convenient.

郊区.zh: 很多年轻人搬到郊区住了。
郊区.en: Many young people have moved to the suburbs.
Suburban housing prices are cheaper than in the city.

节约.zh: 为了节约时间，他直接叫了外卖。
节约.en: To save time, he ordered takeout directly.

节约.zh: 如果大家都节约用电，就能减少浪费。
节约.en: If everyone saves electricity, we can reduce waste.

节约.zh: 妈妈总是教我要节约钱。
节约.en: Mom always teaches me to save money.

节约.zh: 这个办法可以节约很多成本。
节约.en: This method can save a lot of costs.

打招呼.zh: 每次见到邻居，我都会主动打招呼。
打招呼.en: Every time I see a neighbor, I take the initiative to greet them.

打招呼.zh: 他虽然认识我，但从来不打招呼。
打招呼.en: Although he knows me, he never greets.

打招呼.zh: 在中国，见面打招呼是一种礼貌。
打招呼.en: In China, greeting when meeting is a form of politeness.

不便.zh: 因为没带伞，下雨天出门很不便。
不便.en: Because I didn't bring an umbrella, going out in the rain is very inconvenient.

不便.zh: 这个时间开会给大家带来不便。
不便.en: Having a meeting at this time causes inconvenience to everyone.

不便.zh: 虽然交通发达，但住在山里依然不便。
不便.en: Although transportation is developed, living in the mountains is still inconvenient.

不便.zh: 如果给您造成不便，请谅解。
不便.en: If it causes you inconvenience, please understand.

招聘.zh: 这个岗位招聘有经验的设计师。
招聘.en: This position is recruiting experienced designers.

招聘.zh: 因为业务扩张，我们开始招聘新人。
招聘.en: Because of business expansion, we started recruiting new people.
There are many companies at the job fair.

招聘.zh: 他们在招聘网站上发了广告。
招聘.en: They posted an ad on the recruitment website.

活泼.zh: 这只小狗特别活泼，整天跑来跑去。
活泼.en: This puppy is very lively, running around all day.

活泼.zh: 虽然他很活泼，但有时候也会安静下来。
活泼.en: Although he is lively, sometimes he also calms down.

活泼.zh: 我们班新来的同学性格很活泼，大家都喜欢她。
活泼.en: The new classmate in our class is very lively, everyone likes her.

活泼.zh: 你别看它年纪小，其实特别活泼可爱。
活泼.en: Don't judge by its young age, it's actually very lively and cute.

大自然.en: I like to go for walks in nature.

大自然.zh: 周末我们打算去郊外感受大自然。
大自然.en: This weekend we plan to go to the suburbs to experience nature.

大自然.zh: 城市里很少能看到真正的大自然。
大自然.en: In the city, you rarely see real nature.

大自然.zh: 如果多接触大自然，心情会变得很好。
大自然.en: If you connect more with nature, your mood will become very good.

大自然.zh: 从小生活在城市的孩子，应该多了解大自然。
大自然.en: Children who grow up in the city should learn more about nature.

签证.zh: 办美国签证需要准备很多材料。
签证.en: Applying for a US visa requires preparing a lot of documents.

签证.zh: 他因为签证问题没能按时出发。
签证.en: He couldn't leave on time because of visa issues.

签证.zh: 这次去日本旅游，签证办得很快。
签证.en: Traveling to Japan this time, the visa was processed quickly.

签证.zh: 如果你要去国外，一定要提前办好签证。
签证.en: If you are going abroad, be sure to get your visa in advance.

暖和.en: The weather is very warm today.

暖和.zh: 这件外套穿起来特别暖和。
暖和.en: This coat feels especially warm to wear.

暖和.zh: 虽然外面冷，但屋里很暖和。
暖和.en: Although it's cold outside, it's warm inside.

暖和.zh: 春天到了，气温一天比一天暖和。
暖和.en: Spring has arrived, and the temperature gets warmer day by day.

暖和.zh: 你多穿点，别着凉，还是屋里暖和。
暖和.en: Put on more clothes, don't catch a cold, it's warmer inside.

父子.en: This father and son look very alike.

父子.zh: 他们父子俩经常一起钓鱼。
父子.en: The father and son often go fishing together.

父子.zh: 虽然父子关系很好，但偶尔也会吵架。
父子.en: Although the father-son relationship is good, they occasionally argue.

父子.zh: 张先生和他的儿子是一对模范父子。
父子.en: Mr. Zhang and his son are a model father-son pair.

父子.zh: 父子之间要多沟通，才能互相理解。
父子.en: Fathers and sons need to communicate more in order to understand each other.

少见.en: This kind of bird is rare.

少见.zh: 像他这么有耐心的人真是少见。
少见.en: A person as patient as him is truly rare.

少见.zh: 在北京冬天见到下雪很常见，但打雷就少见了。
少见.en: Seeing snow in Beijing winter is common, but thunder is rare.

少见.zh: 现在年轻人用毛笔写字的，实在少见。
少见.en: Young people nowadays using a brush pen to write is really rare.

入学.en: The child starts school this September.

入学.zh: 小学入学需要准备户口本。
入学.en: For elementary school enrollment, you need to prepare the household registration booklet.

入学.zh: 因为年龄不够，他明年才能入学。
入学.en: Because he is not old enough, he can only enroll next year.

入学.zh: 新生入学那天，校园里非常热闹。
入学.en: On the day new students enrolled, the campus was very lively.

入学.zh: 如果你错过了入学时间，可以等下一年。
入学.en: If you miss the enrollment time, you can wait until next year.

打印.zh: 请帮我把这份文件打印一下。
打印.en: Please help me print this document.

打印.zh: 这台打印机坏了，打不了东西。
打印.en: This printer is broken, it can't print anything.

打印.zh: 虽然我发了电子版，但还是需要打印。
打印.en: Although I sent the electronic version, I still need to print it.

打印.zh: 你去打印店把照片打印出来吧，要彩色的。
打印.en: Go to the print shop and print out the photos, in color.

打印.zh: 如果打印质量不好，可以调整一下设置。
打印.en: If the print quality is poor, you can adjust the settings.

背包.zh: 出门旅行背一个背包就够了。
背包.en: Going on a trip, one backpack is enough.

背包.zh: 虽然他个子小，但背包里装了好多东西。
背包.en: Although he is small, he has a lot of stuff in his backpack.

背包.zh: 这个背包是防水的，下雨也不怕。
背包.en: This backpack is waterproof, so no worries in the rain.

背包.zh: 爬山的时候一定要背一个轻便的背包。
背包.en: When hiking, be sure to carry a lightweight backpack.

农村.en: My grandfather lives in the countryside.

农村.zh: 农村的空气比城市好很多。
农村.en: The air in the countryside is much better than in the city.

农村.zh: 虽然农村生活比较安静，但交通不太方便。
农村.en: Although life in the countryside is relatively quiet, transportation is not very convenient.

农村.zh: 现在很多年轻人从农村去城市打工。
农村.en: Nowadays many young people go from the countryside to work in the city.

农村.zh: 如果你想去农村体验生活，可以暑假去。
农村.en: If you want to experience life in the countryside, you can go during summer vacation.

巴士.en: I take the bus to work.

巴士.zh: 这辆巴士太挤了，我们等下一辆吧。
巴士.en: This bus is too crowded; let's wait for the next one.

巴士.zh: 因为路上堵车，巴士迟到了十分钟。
巴士.en: Because of traffic, the bus was ten minutes late.

巴士.zh: 从学校到市中心可以坐三路巴士，很方便。
巴士.en: You can take bus number three from school to the city center; it's very convenient.

巴士.zh: 我们坐巴士去机场，但是要注意别坐错方向。
巴士.en: We take the bus to the airport, but be careful not to go in the wrong direction.

列入.zh: 这个计划被列入今年的重点工作。
列入.en: This plan has been listed as a key task for this year.

列入.zh: 他的建议没有被列入讨论范围。
列入.en: His suggestion was not included in the scope of discussion.

列入.zh: 公司决定把新产品列入明年的开发名单。
列入.en: The company decided to include the new product in next year's development list.

列入.zh: 由于表现突出，他被列入优秀员工候选名单。
列入.en: Due to outstanding performance, he was included in the candidate list for outstanding employees.

列入.zh: 这次会议把环保议题列入了议程，所以大家都很重视。
列入.en: This meeting included environmental issues on the agenda, so everyone took it seriously.

老年.zh: 我奶奶是老年大学的学员。
老年.en: My grandma is a student at the university for the elderly.

老年.zh: 老年人在冬天要注意保暖。
老年.en: Elderly people should keep warm in winter.

老年.zh: 这个小区有很多老年活动中心，很方便。
老年.en: This neighborhood has many activity centers for the elderly; it's very convenient.

老年.zh: 虽然他已经进入老年，但心态还是很年轻。
老年.en: Although he has entered old age, he still has a young mindset.

老年.zh: 政府推出了新的政策，专门照顾独居老年人的生活。
老年.en: The government introduced new policies specifically to care for the lives of elderly people living alone.

分为.en: This book is divided into three parts.

分为.zh: 比赛分为初赛和决赛两个阶段。
分为.en: The competition is divided into two stages: the preliminary round and the final.

分为.zh: 我们班的学生分为两组，一组做实验，一组写报告。
分为.en: The students in our class are divided into two groups: one does the experiment, the other writes the report.

分为.zh: 这个课程分为基础班和进阶班，你可以根据自己的水平选择。
分为.en: This course is divided into basic and advanced classes; you can choose based on your level.

分为.zh: 公司员工按部门分为销售、技术、行政等几个部分。
分为.en: The company's employees are divided into several departments such as sales, technology, and administration.

体检.en: I'm going to have a physical exam tomorrow.

体检.zh: 公司每年都会安排员工免费体检。
体检.en: The company arranges free physical exams for employees every year.

体检.zh: 体检报告出来了，医生说我的血糖有点高。
体检.en: The physical exam report is out; the doctor said my blood sugar is a bit high.

体检.zh: 如果你经常熬夜，建议每年做一次全面体检。
体检.en: If you often stay up late, it's recommended to have a comprehensive physical exam every year.

体检.zh: 体检之前不能吃早饭，但是可以喝少量水。
体检.en: You can't eat breakfast before the physical exam, but you can drink a small amount of water.

听众.zh: 主持人问听众有没有问题要问。
听众.en: The host asked the audience if they had any questions.

听众.zh: 作为电台主持人，我很重视听众的意见。
听众.en: As a radio host, I value the opinions of the listeners.

听众.zh: 这场讲座的听众主要是大学生和年轻人。
听众.en: The audience for this lecture is mainly college students and young people.

听众.zh: 为了提高收听率，节目组经常和听众互动，比如抽奖送礼物。
听众.en: To improve listening rates, the program team often interacts with the audience, such as giving away gifts through lucky draws.

假日.en: I like to rest at home on holidays.

假日.zh: 这个假日我们一起去爬山吧。
假日.en: Let's go hiking together this holiday.

假日.zh: 假日期间高速公路经常堵车。
假日.en: During holidays, highways often get congested.

假日.zh: 由于假日安排，下周一不用上班。
假日.en: Due to the holiday schedule, we don't have to work next Monday.

假日.zh: 很多人选择在假日出国旅行，但我觉得在家更舒服。
假日.en: Many people choose to travel abroad during holidays, but I find it more comfortable to stay home.

少量.en: I only need a small amount of sugar.

少量.zh: 这道菜加少量盐就可以了。
少量.en: Just add a small amount of salt to this dish.

少量.zh: 医生说我每天可以喝少量咖啡。
少量.en: The doctor said I can drink a small amount of coffee every day.

少量.zh: 少量饮酒可能对心脏有益，但过量就不好了。
少量.en: Drinking a small amount of alcohol may be good for the heart, but too much is bad.

少量.zh: 实验需要加入少量催化剂，否则反应会很慢。
少量.en: The experiment requires adding a small amount of catalyst, otherwise the reaction will be very slow.

着火.zh: 那栋楼昨晚着火了，还好没人受伤。
着火.en: That building caught fire last night; luckily no one was hurt.

着火.zh: 如果电器着火了，千万不要用水去泼。
着火.en: If an electrical appliance catches fire, never pour water on it.

着火.zh: 因为线路老化，仓库突然着火了。
着火.en: Due to aging wiring, the warehouse suddenly caught fire.

着火.zh: 听到楼下着火了，他立刻带着家人跑了出来。
着火.en: Hearing that the floor below was on fire, he immediately ran out with his family.

高温.en: It's high temperature today; remember to drink more water.

高温.zh: 高温天气容易中暑，最好少出门。
高温.en: High temperature weather can easily cause heatstroke; better to go out less.

高温.zh: 工厂在高温下工作时要注意安全。
高温.en: When working under high temperatures in the factory, safety must be paid attention to.

高温.zh: 由于持续高温，学校决定停课两天。
高温.en: Due to continuous high temperatures, the school decided to suspend classes for two days.

积累.zh: 他通过每天读书积累了很多知识。
积累.en: He accumulated a lot of knowledge by reading every day.

积累.zh: 工作经验是一点一点积累起来的。
积累.en: Work experience is accumulated bit by bit.

积累.zh: 我们要积累人脉，对以后有帮助。
积累.en: We need to build up connections, which will help us in the future.

积累.zh: 你平时积累的零花钱够买这个礼物吗？
积累.en: Is the pocket money you've saved up enough to buy this gift?

积累.zh: 虽然刚开始很难，但积累多了就简单了。
积累.en: Although it's hard at first, it becomes easier once you've accumulated more.

食堂.en: Let's eat at the cafeteria at noon.

食堂.zh: 食堂今天的菜不太好吃。
食堂.en: The food in the cafeteria today isn't very good.

食堂.zh: 新开的食堂离宿舍很近，很方便。
食堂.en: The newly opened cafeteria is very close to the dorm, so it's convenient.

食堂.zh: 因为食堂人多，我们只好打包带走。
食堂.en: Since the cafeteria was crowded, we had to get takeout.

食堂.zh: 食堂阿姨对我特别好，每次多给我打一点。
食堂.en: The cafeteria auntie is especially nice to me and always gives me a bit extra.

离不开.en: I can't live without my phone.
People nowadays can't do without the internet.

离不开.zh: 她做饭很好吃，我们都离不开她了。
离不开.en: She cooks so well that we can't do without her.

离不开.zh: 这个城市的发展离不开外来人口。
离不开.en: The development of this city cannot do without migrant workers.

离不开.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我觉得自己离不开家人的支持。
离不开.en: Although work is busy, I feel I can't do without my family's support.

列为.zh: 这本书被列为必读书目。
列为.en: This book is listed as required reading.

列为.zh: 公司把他列为重点培养对象。
列为.en: The company has listed him as a key candidate for development.

列为.zh: 这个城市被列为旅游胜地之一。
列为.en: This city is listed as one of the tourist attractions.

列为.zh: 老师把这次考试列为期中成绩的一部分。
列为.en: The teacher listed this exam as part of the midterm grade.

列为.zh: 由于表现突出，他被列为今年的优秀员工。
列为.en: Due to outstanding performance, he was listed as this year's outstanding employee.

出行.zh: 节假日出行的人特别多。
出行.en: There are especially many people traveling during holidays.

出行.zh: 为了安全，出行前记得检查车况。
出行.en: For safety, remember to check the car condition before traveling.

出行.zh: 他喜欢坐地铁出行，因为不堵车。
出行.en: He likes to travel by subway because there are no traffic jams.

出行.zh: 最近天气不好，出行一定要带伞。
出行.en: The weather has been bad lately, so be sure to bring an umbrella when you go out.

海水.en: The seawater here is very blue.

海水.zh: 小时候我特别喜欢喝海水，结果被呛到了。
海水.en: When I was little, I really liked drinking seawater, but I ended up choking.

海水.zh: 因为污染，这片海水变得浑浊了。
海水.en: Due to pollution, this area of seawater has become murky.

海水.zh: 他们在海边玩了一天，身上都是海水味。
海水.en: They played at the beach all day, and their bodies smelled of seawater.

秋季.zh: 我最喜欢秋季，因为不冷也不热。
秋季.en: I like autumn best because it's neither cold nor hot.

秋季.zh: 秋季是丰收的季节，果园里有很多水果。
秋季.en: Autumn is the harvest season, and there are many fruits in the orchard.

秋季.zh: 到了秋季，树叶都变黄了，特别好看。
秋季.en: When autumn comes, the leaves turn yellow and look especially beautiful.

秋季.zh: 秋季运动会马上就要开始了，大家都在积极准备。
秋季.en: The autumn sports meet is about to start, and everyone is actively preparing.

景色.en: The scenery here is really beautiful.

景色.zh: 从山顶看下去的景色让我惊呆了。
景色.en: The view from the top of the mountain amazed me.

景色.zh: 虽然城市很繁华，但我更喜欢大自然的景色。
景色.en: Although the city is bustling, I prefer natural scenery.

景色.zh: 他拍了很多照片，想把美丽的景色都留下来。
景色.en: He took many photos to preserve the beautiful scenery.

景色.zh: 这条小路两边的景色特别适合散步。
景色.en: The scenery on both sides of this path is especially suitable for walking.

表格.zh: 表格里有一些信息填错了。
表格.en: Some information in the form was filled in incorrectly.

表格.zh: 你把表格打印出来就行，不用手写。
表格.en: You can just print out the form; no need to write by hand.

表格.zh: 人事部让我重新交一份表格，因为漏了一项。
表格.en: The HR department asked me to resubmit a form because one item was missing.

表格.zh: 为了方便统计，我们做了一个简单的表格。
表格.en: For easy statistics, we made a simple table.

零食.zh: 妈妈不让我吃太多零食。
零食.en: Mom won't let me eat too many snacks.

零食.zh: 看电影的时候我喜欢买点零食边看边吃。
零食.en: I like to buy some snacks and eat them while watching a movie.

零食.zh: 这家店卖的零食种类很多，价格也不贵。
零食.en: This shop sells a wide variety of snacks at reasonable prices.

零食.zh: 虽然知道吃零食对身体不好，但我还是忍不住。
零食.en: Although I know that eating snacks is bad for my health, I still can't help it.

功课.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.

功课.zh: 我写完功课才去看电视。
功课.en: I only watch TV after finishing my homework.

功课.zh: 虽然功课很多，但我还是先玩了会儿游戏。
功课.en: Although there is a lot of homework, I still played games for a while first.

功课.zh: 妈妈检查了我的功课，说我做得不错。
功课.en: Mom checked my homework and said I did well.

表扬.zh: 他因为帮助同学受到了表扬。
表扬.en: He was praised for helping a classmate.

表扬.zh: 我今天被老板表扬了，特别开心。
表扬.en: I was praised by my boss today, I'm really happy.

表扬.zh: 虽然她这次考得不好，但妈妈还是表扬了她的努力。
表扬.en: Although she didn't do well on this test, her mom still praised her effort.

表扬.zh: 大家表扬他做事认真，而且从不抱怨。
表扬.en: Everyone praised him for being serious about his work and never complaining.

一般来说.zh: 一般来说，周末人会很多。
一般来说.en: Generally speaking, weekends are very crowded.

一般来说.zh: 虽然天气不好，但一般来说火车不会晚点。
一般来说.en: Although the weather is bad, generally speaking the train won't be late.

一般来说.zh: 一般来说，女孩子比男孩子说话早。
一般来说.en: Generally speaking, girls start talking earlier than boys.

一般来说.zh: 他做事很细心，不过一般来说他也会犯点小错误。
一般来说.en: He is very careful, but generally speaking he still makes small mistakes.

硕士.en: Her older sister is a master's degree holder.

硕士.zh: 我打算读完本科再考硕士。
硕士.en: I plan to finish my bachelor's and then apply for a master's.

硕士.zh: 他现在在读硕士，每天都很忙。
硕士.en: He is currently studying for a master's degree and is very busy every day.

硕士.zh: 虽然硕士毕业不容易，但她还是坚持下来了。
硕士.en: Although getting a master's degree is not easy, she still persisted.

硕士.zh: 我们公司招人要求至少是硕士学历。
硕士.en: Our company requires at least a master's degree for hiring.

相片.zh: 我们去年在公园拍了很多相片。
相片.en: We took a lot of photos at the park last year.

相片.zh: 虽然相片有点模糊，但是回忆很美好。
相片.en: Although the photo is a bit blurry, the memories are beautiful.

相片.zh: 奶奶很喜欢看老相片，因为里面有很多故事。
相片.en: Grandma loves looking at old photos because they have many stories.

房租.zh: 这个月的房租你交了吗？
房租.en: Have you paid this month's rent?

房租.zh: 房租太贵了，我想换个地方住。
房租.en: The rent is too expensive; I want to move somewhere else.

房租.zh: 因为房租涨价，他决定跟朋友合租。
房租.en: Because the rent went up, he decided to share an apartment with a friend.

房租.zh: 我每个月工资的一大半都交了房租。
房租.en: Most of my monthly salary goes to paying rent.

房租.zh: 虽然房租不便宜，但这附近交通很方便。
房租.en: Although the rent isn't cheap, the transportation nearby is very convenient.

查找.zh: 你能帮我查找一下这个单词吗？
查找.en: Can you help me look up this word?

查找.zh: 你可以用手机查找附近的餐厅。
查找.en: You can use your phone to search for nearby restaurants.

查找.zh: 因为找不到钥匙，他一直在查找可能的地方。
查找.en: Because he couldn't find the keys, he kept searching possible places.

查找.zh: 我上网查找了很多攻略，才决定去哪里旅行。
查找.en: I looked up many travel guides online before deciding where to go.

大姐.zh: 大姐，请问这条路怎么走？
大姐.en: Excuse me, miss (older sister), how do I get to this road?

大姐.zh: 我家大姐今年三十岁了。
大姐.en: My eldest sister is thirty years old this year.

大姐.zh: 我们大姐很能干，家里的事都是她管。
大姐.en: Our eldest sister is very capable; she takes care of all the household matters.

大姐.zh: 虽然大姐平时很严厉，但对我们特别好。
大姐.en: Although our eldest sister is usually strict, she is very good to us.
Big sister, the dishes you made are really delicious!

牙膏.zh: 我喜欢用这款牙膏，因为味道很清新。
牙膏.en: I like using this toothpaste because the taste is very fresh.

牙膏.zh: 虽然牙膏贵一点，但效果确实好。
牙膏.en: Although the toothpaste is a bit more expensive, the effect is really good.

牙膏.zh: 每天早晚都要刷牙，牙膏不能少。
牙膏.en: You need to brush your teeth every morning and evening; toothpaste is essential.

春季.en: Spring has arrived, and the flowers are blooming.

春季.zh: 虽然春季很舒服，但花粉过敏的人很多。
春季.en: Although spring is very pleasant, many people have pollen allergies.

春季.zh: 我们计划春季去日本看樱花。
春季.en: We plan to go to Japan to see cherry blossoms in spring.

春季.zh: 因为春季雨水多，出门记得带伞。
春季.en: Because there is a lot of rain in spring, remember to bring an umbrella when going out.

房东.zh: 我的房东每个月都会来检查房子。
房东.en: My landlord comes to check the house every month.

房东.zh: 虽然房东很友好，但是房租有点贵。
房东.en: Although the landlord is friendly, the rent is a bit expensive.

房东.zh: 昨天房东跟我说要涨房租了。
房东.en: Yesterday the landlord told me the rent is going up.

房东.zh: 房东太太总是提醒我们关好窗户。
房东.en: The landlady always reminds us to close the windows properly.

时间表.zh: 这个时间表是下个学期的课程安排。
时间表.en: This timetable is the course schedule for next semester.

时间表.zh: 因为时间表变了，所以我们要重新安排。
时间表.en: Because the schedule changed, we need to rearrange.

时间表.zh: 我的工作时间表每天都不一样。
时间表.en: My work schedule is different every day.

时间表.zh: 请把新的时间表发到我的邮箱。
时间表.en: Please send the new schedule to my email.

收听.en: I listen to the news every day.

收听.zh: 很多人喜欢在开车时收听广播。
收听.en: Many people like to listen to the radio while driving.

收听.zh: 如果你有时间，可以收听这个节目。
收听.en: If you have time, you can listen to this program.

收听.zh: 我经常用手机收听音乐。
收听.en: I often listen to music on my phone.

收听.zh: 这个电台的节目很受欢迎，很多人都收听。
收听.en: This radio station's programs are very popular; many people listen.

网页.zh: 我昨天做了一个很漂亮的网页。
网页.en: I made a very nice web page yesterday.

网页.zh: 虽然网页内容很多，但加载很快。
网页.en: Although the web page has a lot of content, it loads quickly.

网页.zh: 你需要输入网址才能访问那个网页。
网页.en: You need to enter the URL to access that web page.

网页.zh: 请把这个网页分享给朋友们。
网页.en: Please share this web page with friends.

刷牙.zh: 我每天早上和晚上都要刷牙。
刷牙.en: I brush my teeth every morning and evening.

刷牙.zh: 因为吃了甜食，所以记得刷牙。
刷牙.en: Because you ate sweets, remember to brush your teeth.

刷牙.zh: 小孩子应该学会自己刷牙。
刷牙.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth themselves.

刷牙.zh: 刷牙的时候要上下刷才能刷干净。
刷牙.en: When brushing teeth, you need to brush up and down to clean thoroughly.

填写.zh: 在报名之前，你需要填写个人信息。
填写.en: Before registering, you need to fill in personal information.

填写.zh: 如果填写有误，我们可以帮你修改。
填写.en: If there is a mistake in the filling, we can help you correct it.

填写.zh: 她在申请表上填写了地址和电话。
填写.en: She filled in the address and phone number on the application form.

填写.zh: 请用黑色笔填写所有空白处。
填写.en: Please fill in all blanks with a black pen.

细心.en: He is very careful in doing things.

细心.zh: 老师提醒我们要细心检查作业。
细心.en: The teacher reminded us to carefully check our homework.

细心.zh: 因为他不细心，所以犯了很多错误。
细心.en: Because he was not careful, he made many mistakes.

细心.zh: 细心的人更容易发现生活中的美。
细心.en: Careful people are more likely to find beauty in life.

细心.zh: 这份工作需要细心和耐心。
细心.en: This job requires carefulness and patience.

听力.en: My listening ability is not very good.

听力.zh: 多听中文歌可以提高你的听力。
听力.en: Listening to more Chinese songs can improve your listening.

听力.zh: 虽然听力很难，但是多练习就会进步。
听力.en: Although listening is hard, you will improve with more practice.

听力.zh: 听力考试的时候要集中注意力。
听力.en: During the listening test, you need to concentrate.

听力.zh: 我每天都会做十分钟的听力练习。
听力.en: I do ten minutes of listening practice every day.

乒乓球.zh: 每个周末我们都去体育馆打乒乓球。
乒乓球.en: Every weekend we go to the gym to play table tennis.

乒乓球.zh: 因为乒乓球是中国的国球，所以很多人都会打。
乒乓球.en: Because table tennis is China's national sport, many people can play it.

乒乓球.zh: 他乒乓球打得非常好，拿过冠军。
乒乓球.en: He plays table tennis very well, has won championships.

乒乓球.zh: 我们公司有一个乒乓球比赛。
乒乓球.en: Our company has a table tennis competition.

导游.en: The tour guide is very enthusiastic.

导游.zh: 这个导游带我们去了很多有趣的地方。
导游.en: This tour guide took us to many interesting places.

导游.zh: 如果导游说得太快，你可以让他慢一点。
导游.en: If the guide speaks too fast, you can ask him to slow down.

导游.zh: 导游给我们介绍了当地的历史文化。
导游.en: The tour guide introduced us to the local history and culture.

导游.zh: 一个好的导游能让旅行更精彩。
导游.en: A good tour guide can make the trip more wonderful.

小吃.zh: 虽然是小吃，但味道很好。
小吃.en: Although it's a snack, the taste is good.
Night markets have a lot of snacks.

小吃.zh: 我们去小吃街尝尝当地的小吃吧。
小吃.en: Let's go to the snack street to try local snacks.

小吃.zh: 这家店的小吃又便宜又好吃。
小吃.en: This shop's snacks are cheap and tasty.

叶子.en: The leaves on the tree turned yellow.

叶子.zh: 秋天到了，叶子都落下来了。
叶子.en: Autumn arrived, leaves all fell down.

叶子.zh: 因为风大，地上的叶子被吹得到处都是。
叶子.en: Because the wind is strong, the leaves on the ground are blown everywhere.

叶子.zh: 这片叶子的形状很特别。
叶子.en: The shape of this leaf is very special.

叶子.zh: 奶奶喜欢收集好看的叶子做书签。
叶子.en: Grandma likes to collect beautiful leaves to make bookmarks.

打折.zh: 商场打折的时候人特别多。
打折.en: When the mall has a sale, there are a lot of people.

打折.zh: 如果打折的话，我就多买几件。
打折.en: If it's on sale, I'll buy a few more.

打折.zh: 双十一很多商品都打折。
打折.en: On Singles' Day, many products are on sale.

打折.zh: 这家店常年打折，但质量不太好。
打折.en: This store has sales all year, but the quality is not good.

特价.en: This special price is a good deal.

特价.zh: 超市里的特价商品快卖完了。
特价.en: The special-priced items in the supermarket are almost sold out.

特价.zh: 虽然是特价，但日期快过期了。
特价.en: Although it's a special price, the expiration date is near.

特价.zh: 我今天买了好多特价的东西。
特价.en: I bought a lot of special-priced things today.

特价.zh: 你看到那个特价的洗发水了吗？很便宜。
特价.en: Did you see that shampoo on special? It's very cheap.

词语.zh: 学习中文要记住很多词语。
词语.en: Learning Chinese requires remembering many words.

词语.zh: 如果你不认识这个词语，可以查字典。
词语.en: If you don't know this word, you can look it up in the dictionary.

词语.zh: 老师让我们用新学的词语造句。
词语.en: The teacher asked us to make sentences with the new words.

词语.zh: 这篇文章里有很多生僻的词语。
词语.en: This article has many obscure words.

登机.zh: 请拿好登机牌准备登机。
登机.en: Please hold your boarding pass and prepare to board.

登机.zh: 因为天气不好，登机时间推迟了。
登机.en: Because of bad weather, the boarding time was delayed.
The boarding gate is on the second floor, turn right.

登机.zh: 我们要提前一个小时到机场，这样才能按时登机。
登机.en: We need to arrive at the airport an hour early so we can board on time.

堵车.zh: 早高峰的时候特别容易堵车。
堵车.en: During morning rush hour, it's especially easy to get traffic jams.

堵车.zh: 如果堵车的话，我们可能迟到。
堵车.en: If there's a traffic jam, we might be late.

堵车.zh: 这条路一到周末就堵车。
堵车.en: This road gets jammed every weekend.

堵车.zh: 因为前面出了事故，所以堵车堵了半小时。
堵车.en: Because there was an accident ahead, the traffic jam lasted half an hour.

说明书.zh: 这台机器的说明书是英文的。
说明书.en: The manual for this machine is in English.

说明书.zh: 如果你不会用，就照着说明书操作。
说明书.en: If you don't know how to use it, follow the manual.

说明书.zh: 买电器的时候别忘了拿说明书。
说明书.en: When buying appliances, don't forget to take the manual.

说明书.zh: 说明书上写着要先充电再用。
说明书.en: The manual says to charge it first before using.

味儿.zh: 厨房里有一股烧焦的味儿。
味儿.en: There's a burnt smell in the kitchen.

味儿.zh: 虽然这个酸奶很好喝，但有一种怪味儿。
味儿.en: Although this yogurt is tasty, it has a strange flavor.

味儿.zh: 你闻闻这个花，味儿真香。
味儿.en: Smell this flower, it smells really fragrant.

味儿.zh: 新买的鞋子有股塑料味儿，得放一放。
味儿.en: The new shoes have a plastic smell, need to air them out.

转弯.zh: 开车的时候转弯要打转向灯。
转弯.en: When driving, you need to use your turn signal when turning.

转弯.zh: 如果他没转弯，我们就会走错路。
转弯.en: If he didn't turn, we would go the wrong way.

转弯.zh: 这个弯很急，转弯要慢一点。
转弯.en: This turn is sharp, need to turn slowly.

转弯.zh: 我在这条路上开了很久，终于找到了转弯的地方。
转弯.en: I drove on this road for a long time and finally found the place to turn.

期末.zh: 期末快到了，我得开始复习了。
期末.en: The end of term is coming, I need to start reviewing.

期末.zh: 我们期末有个小组项目要交。
期末.en: We have a group project to submit for finals.

期末.zh: 因为期末成绩很重要，所以我最近都在图书馆。
期末.en: Because final grades are very important, I've been at the library lately.

期末.zh: 期末考完试，我们就放假了。
期末.en: After the final exams, we'll have a holiday.

期末.zh: 虽然期末很累，但是想到暑假就开心了。
期末.en: Even though finals are exhausting, thinking about summer break makes me happy.

西红柿.zh: 我买了几个西红柿，晚上做汤。
西红柿.en: I bought a few tomatoes to make soup tonight.

西红柿.zh: 西红柿炒鸡蛋是我最爱吃的菜。
西红柿.en: Tomato scrambled eggs is my favorite dish.

西红柿.zh: 这个西红柿很新鲜，颜色也好看。
西红柿.en: This tomato is very fresh and has a nice color.

西红柿.zh: 如果你不喜欢吃生的，可以把西红柿炒一下。
西红柿.en: If you don't like eating raw, you can stir-fry the tomatoes.

西红柿.zh: 冰箱里的西红柿快坏了，你记得今天吃掉。
西红柿.en: The tomatoes in the fridge are going bad, remember to eat them today.

低温.zh: 明天低温只有零度，多穿点。
低温.en: Tomorrow's low temperature is only zero degrees, dress warmer.
This medicine needs to be stored at low temperature.

低温.zh: 虽然今天低温，但太阳很好，不觉得冷。
低温.en: Although today's temperature is low, the sun is nice so it doesn't feel cold.

低温.zh: 低温天气容易感冒，你要注意保暖。
低温.en: Low temperature weather makes it easy to catch a cold, you should keep warm.

低温.zh: 烤箱用低温慢慢烤，肉会更嫩。
低温.en: Baking at low temperature in the oven slowly makes the meat more tender.

作文.zh: 这篇作文要求写五百字。
作文.en: This essay requires five hundred characters.

作文.zh: 我的作文被老师表扬了。
作文.en: My composition was praised by the teacher.

作文.zh: 你作文写完了吗？记得要检查语法。
作文.en: Have you finished your composition? Remember to check the grammar.

作文.zh: 因为他平时爱读书，所以作文写得很好。
作文.en: Because he usually loves reading, his compositions are very good.

作文.zh: 每次写作文，我都先列一个提纲。
作文.en: Every time I write an essay, I first make an outline.

高考.en: This year's college entrance exam is on June 7th.

高考.zh: 他为了高考每天学习到很晚。
高考.en: He studies until very late every day for the gaokao.

高考.zh: 虽然高考压力很大，但是努力就会有回报。
高考.en: Even though the gaokao pressure is huge, hard work pays off.

高考.zh: 我姐姐高考考了很好的分数，进了名牌大学。
高考.en: My sister got a great score on the gaokao and entered a top university.

高考.zh: 高考结束后，大家都松了一口气。
高考.en: After the gaokao ended, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

动画片.zh: 弟弟每天都要看动画片。
动画片.en: My younger brother watches cartoons every day.

动画片.zh: 这部动画片的画风很可爱。
动画片.en: The art style of this cartoon is very cute.

动画片.zh: 我小时候最喜欢看《猫和老鼠》这部动画片。
动画片.en: When I was little, my favorite cartoon was Tom and Jerry.

动画片.zh: 虽然动画片是给孩子看的，但大人也会喜欢。
