动画片.en: Although cartoons are made for children, adults can also enjoy them.

动画片.zh: 如果你有空，我推荐你看一部新的动画片。
动画片.en: If you have time, I recommend you watch a new cartoon.

低价.zh: 这家店的东西都是低价。
低价.en: Everything in this store is low-priced.

低价.zh: 双十一的时候，很多商品都低价促销。
低价.en: During Singles' Day, many products are sold at low prices.

低价.zh: 虽然低价，但质量还不错。
低价.en: Although the price is low, the quality is not bad.

低价.zh: 如果你想买便宜货，可以看看低价区的商品。
低价.en: If you want to buy bargains, you can check the low-price section.

低价.zh: 他们用低价吸引了很多顾客。
低价.en: They attracted many customers with low prices.

操场.en: Let's go run on the playground.

操场.zh: 下午操场上有足球比赛。
操场.en: There's a soccer match on the field this afternoon.

操场.zh: 因为天气好，操场上全是人。
操场.en: Because the weather is nice, the playground is full of people.

操场.zh: 学校操场旁边种了很多树。
操场.en: There are many trees planted next to the school playground.

操场.zh: 放学后，孩子们在操场上玩得很开心。
操场.en: After school, the children are playing happily on the playground.

上楼.zh: 你帮我上楼拿一下快递。
上楼.en: Please go upstairs and get the package for me.

上楼.zh: 电梯坏了，我们只能走上楼。
上楼.en: The elevator is broken, we have to walk upstairs.
She went upstairs to call her mom for dinner.

上楼.zh: 如果你累了，就先上楼休息吧。
上楼.en: If you're tired, go upstairs and rest first.

上楼.zh: 他上楼的时候不小心摔了一跤。
上楼.en: He accidentally fell when going upstairs.

下楼.en: I'll come downstairs right away, wait a moment.

下楼.zh: 他下楼去便利店买水了。
下楼.en: He went downstairs to the convenience store to buy water.

下楼.zh: 因为电梯坏了，我们只能走下楼。
下楼.en: Because the elevator is broken, we have to walk downstairs.

下楼.zh: 你下楼的时候顺便帮我扔一下垃圾。
下楼.en: When you go downstairs, take out the trash for me.

下楼.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，下楼要小心。
下楼.en: Grandma is old, she needs to be careful going downstairs.

美景.en: The beautiful scenery at the top of the mountain is really beautiful.

美景.zh: 我们在海边欣赏了一天的美景。
美景.en: We enjoyed the beautiful scenery by the sea all day.

美景.zh: 虽然天气不好，但那里的美景还是值得看。
美景.en: Although the weather was bad, the beautiful scenery there is still worth seeing.

美景.zh: 他每次出门都会用相机记录美景。
美景.en: Every time he goes out, he uses his camera to capture the beautiful scenery.

美景.zh: 从飞机上看，城市的夜景也是美景。
美景.en: From the plane, the city's night view is also beautiful scenery.

皮鞋.en: This pair of leather shoes is very expensive.

皮鞋.zh: 他昨天买了一双新皮鞋。
皮鞋.en: He bought a new pair of leather shoes yesterday.

皮鞋.zh: 因为下雨，他的皮鞋都湿了。
皮鞋.en: Because it rained, his leather shoes got wet.

皮鞋.zh: 穿皮鞋走路时间长了脚会疼。
皮鞋.en: Wearing leather shoes for a long time will make your feet hurt.

皮鞋.zh: 他不喜欢穿皮鞋，觉得太正式了。
皮鞋.en: He doesn't like wearing leather shoes because he thinks they are too formal.

快餐.en: I eat fast food for lunch.

快餐.zh: 快餐虽然方便，但不健康。
快餐.en: Fast food is convenient, but it's not healthy.

快餐.zh: 他经常在上班路上买快餐吃。
快餐.en: He often buys fast food on his way to work.

快餐.zh: 现在的快餐种类越来越多，价格也不贵。
快餐.en: Nowadays, there are more and more types of fast food, and the prices are not expensive either.

快餐.zh: 孩子想吃快餐，但妈妈觉得不健康。
快餐.en: The child wants to eat fast food, but mom thinks it's unhealthy.

点名.en: The teacher calls the roll before class.

点名.zh: 今天班长点名的时候发现有人没来。
点名.en: When the class monitor called the roll today, he found someone was absent.

点名.zh: 他点名批评了那几个迟到的同学。
点名.en: He named and criticized those students who were late.

点名.zh: 下次开会前先点名，别漏了人。
点名.en: Before the next meeting, call the roll first so no one is missed.

点名.zh: 如果被点名了，就要站起来回答。
点名.en: If you are called on, you have to stand up and answer.

话剧.en: Let's go watch a stage play.

话剧.zh: 今晚有一场很好看的话剧。
话剧.en: There's a very good stage play tonight.

话剧.zh: 她喜欢看话剧，但男朋友喜欢看电影。
话剧.en: She likes watching stage plays, but her boyfriend likes watching movies.

话剧.zh: 这部话剧的演员演得非常精彩。
话剧.en: The actors in this stage play performed wonderfully.

话剧.zh: 听说周末的话剧票已经卖完了。
话剧.en: I heard that the tickets for the weekend stage play are already sold out.

茶叶.en: This pack of tea leaves is very fragrant.

茶叶.zh: 爸爸喜欢用绿茶茶叶泡茶喝。
茶叶.en: Dad likes to make tea using green tea leaves.

茶叶.zh: 茶叶放久了味道会变差。
茶叶.en: Tea leaves stored for a long time will taste worse.

茶叶.zh: 他每次去杭州都会买一些当地的茶叶。
茶叶.en: Every time he goes to Hangzhou, he buys some local tea leaves.

茶叶.zh: 虽然茶叶很好，但冲泡的方法也很重要。
茶叶.en: Although the tea leaves are good, the brewing method is also important.

登山.zh: 周末我们一起去登山吧。
登山.en: Let's go mountain climbing together this weekend.

登山.zh: 登山虽然很累，但能看到美丽的风景。
登山.en: Although mountain climbing is tiring, you can see beautiful scenery.

登山.zh: 他每个周末都会去附近的山上登山。
登山.en: He goes mountain climbing on the nearby hill every weekend.

登山.zh: 登山的时候一定要穿舒服的鞋。
登山.en: When mountain climbing, you must wear comfortable shoes.

降温.en: It's going to get colder tomorrow.
It's getting cold, remember to wear more clothes.

降温.zh: 因为突然降温，很多人感冒了。
降温.en: Because of the sudden temperature drop, many people caught colds.

降温.zh: 这几天降温降得厉害，出门要小心。
降温.en: The temperature has dropped sharply these days, be careful when going out.

降温.zh: 虽然白天暖和，但晚上降温很快。
降温.en: Although it's warm during the day, it cools down quickly at night.

孙女.zh: 奶奶每天都会接孙女放学。
孙女.en: Grandma picks up her granddaughter from school every day.

孙女.zh: 他孙女今年刚上小学一年级。
孙女.en: His granddaughter just started first grade this year.

孙女.zh: 虽然孙女很调皮，但奶奶还是特别疼她。
孙女.en: Although the granddaughter is naughty, grandma still dotes on her.

孙女.zh: 她的孙女最喜欢吃姥姥做的菜。
孙女.en: Her granddaughter loves the dishes made by her maternal grandmother.

大巴.zh: 去机场可以坐机场大巴。
大巴.en: You can take the airport bus to the airport.

大巴.zh: 大巴比火车便宜，但时间久一些。
大巴.en: The coach is cheaper than the train, but it takes longer.

大巴.zh: 今天路上堵车，大巴晚了一个小时。
大巴.en: There was a traffic jam today, so the coach was an hour late.

大巴.zh: 他从学校坐大巴到火车站再转地铁。
大巴.en: He takes a coach from school to the train station and then transfers to the subway.

垃圾桶.en: Throw the trash into the trash can.

垃圾桶.zh: 厨房的垃圾桶满了，该换了。
垃圾桶.en: The kitchen trash can is full; it's time to change it.

垃圾桶.zh: 你看到那个蓝色的垃圾桶了吗？
垃圾桶.en: Did you see that blue trash can?

垃圾桶.zh: 虽然垃圾桶就在旁边，他还是把纸扔在地上。
垃圾桶.en: Even though the trash can was right there, he still threw the paper on the ground.

垃圾桶.zh: 新买的垃圾桶放在客厅角落里，挺好看的。
垃圾桶.en: The new trash can is placed in the corner of the living room and looks quite nice.

树叶.zh: 秋天到了，树叶落了一地。
树叶.en: Autumn has arrived, and the leaves have fallen all over the ground.
The wind blew, and the leaves rustled.

树叶.zh: 我捡了一片好看的树叶当书签。
树叶.en: I picked up a pretty leaf to use as a bookmark.

树叶.zh: 如果下雨的话，树叶上的水珠会特别好看。
树叶.en: If it rains, the water droplets on the leaves will look especially beautiful.

高价.en: This phone sells at a high price.

高价.zh: 他愿意出高价买那幅画。
高价.en: He is willing to pay a high price for that painting.

高价.zh: 虽然东西好，但高价让人犹豫。
高价.en: Although the product is good, the high price makes people hesitate.

高价.zh: 我们不想花高价住这种酒店。
高价.en: We don't want to spend a high price to stay in this kind of hotel.

高价.zh: 因为需求量很大，这些票被炒到了高价。
高价.en: Because the demand is huge, these tickets have been driven up to high prices.

转机.en: We have a layover in Hong Kong.

转机.zh: 转机时间只有两个小时，别走远。
转机.en: The layover time is only two hours; don't go far.

转机.zh: 这个航班需要在首尔转机。
转机.en: This flight requires a transfer in Seoul.

转机.zh: 虽然机票便宜，但转机太麻烦了。
转机.en: Although the ticket is cheap, the layover is too troublesome.

转机.zh: 他错过了转机，只好在机场过夜。
转机.en: He missed his connecting flight and had to spend the night at the airport.

塑料袋.en: Plastic bags are not environmentally friendly.

塑料袋.zh: 请给我一个塑料袋装东西。
塑料袋.en: Please give me a plastic bag to hold things.

塑料袋.zh: 超市现在不免费提供塑料袋了。
塑料袋.en: Supermarkets no longer provide plastic bags for free.

塑料袋.zh: 我把旧塑料袋收起来，下次再用。
塑料袋.en: I put away the old plastic bags to use again next time.

塑料袋.zh: 虽然很方便，但我们应该少用塑料袋。
塑料袋.en: Although they are very convenient, we should use fewer plastic bags.

年底.en: It's very busy at the end of the year.

年底.zh: 年底我们公司要开年会。
年底.en: Our company is having an annual meeting at the end of the year.

年底.zh: 他打算年底辞职去旅行。
年底.en: He plans to quit his job at the end of the year and travel.

年底.zh: 很多商场年底都会打折促销。
年底.en: Many malls have sales and promotions at the end of the year.

年底.zh: 因为年底要结算，所以财务部现在最忙。
年底.en: Because the year-end settlement is coming, the finance department is the busiest now.

母女.en: This mother and daughter look very alike.
The mother and daughter went shopping together.

母女.zh: 虽然有时吵架，但母女感情很好。
母女.en: Although they sometimes argue, the mother-daughter bond is very strong.

母女.zh: 那对母女在公园里散步，有说有笑。
母女.en: That mother and daughter are walking in the park, chatting and laughing.

交警.en: The traffic police are directing at the intersection.
The traffic police told him to pull over.

交警.zh: 下雨天交警还是站在外面工作。
交警.en: Even on rainy days, the traffic police still work outside.

交警.zh: 如果你闯红灯，交警会罚款。
交警.en: If you run a red light, the traffic police will fine you.

交警.zh: 那位交警态度很好，耐心指路。
交警.en: That traffic police officer had a good attitude and patiently gave directions.

健身房.en: I go to the gym to run.
He goes to the gym three times a week.

健身房.zh: 健身房离我家很近，走路五分钟。
健身房.en: The gym is very close to my home, a five-minute walk.

健身房.zh: 虽然办了卡，但我很少去健身房。
健身房.en: Although I got a membership, I rarely go to the gym.

健身房.zh: 这家健身房设备很新，人也少。
健身房.en: This gym has very new equipment and few people.

车位.en: There are no parking spaces here.
It's really hard to find a parking space.
The parking spaces in the community are insufficient.

车位.zh: 因为车位紧张，很多人把车停在路边。
车位.en: Because parking spaces are tight, many people park on the street.

车位.zh: 这个商场地下有五百个车位。
车位.en: This mall has five hundred parking spaces underground.

冰雪.en: It's all ice and snow outside.
Be careful driving in icy and snowy weather.

冰雪.zh: 孩子看到冰雪特别兴奋。
冰雪.en: The child gets very excited when seeing ice and snow.

冰雪.zh: 虽然冰雪很大，但我们还是出门了。
冰雪.en: Although there was heavy ice and snow, we still went out.

冰雪.zh: 这场冰雪把路都封了，只能待在家里。
冰雪.en: This ice and snow has blocked the roads, so we can only stay at home.

应聘.en: He went for a job interview today.
I want to apply for a job at this company.

应聘.zh: 应聘前要把简历准备好。
应聘.en: You need to prepare your resume before applying.

应聘.zh: 她应聘了好几个职位，都没成功。
应聘.en: She applied for several positions but didn't succeed.

应聘.zh: 如果你要应聘，最好先了解一下公司背景。
应聘.en: If you want to apply, it's best to first learn about the company's background.

养成.en: You need to develop good habits.
He has formed the habit of waking up early.

养成.zh: 小时候养成的习惯很难改。
养成.en: Habits formed in childhood are hard to change.

养成.zh: 多读书可以养成独立思考的能力。
养成.en: Reading more can help develop the ability to think independently.

养成.zh: 他通过每天锻炼养成了强健的体魄。
养成.en: He developed a strong physique through daily exercise.

打针.en: I'm most afraid of getting injections.
I have to go to the hospital for a shot today.

打针.zh: 小孩打针时哭得很厉害。
打针.en: The child cried a lot when getting the injection.

打针.zh: 医生让我打针，说这样好得快。
打针.en: The doctor told me to get a shot, saying it would help me recover faster.

打针.zh: 虽然打针很疼，但是为了健康必须忍一忍。
打针.en: Although getting a shot hurts, you have to endure it for your health.

窗子.en: There's a tree outside the window.
The windows in this room are very big.
It's raining, and I forgot to close the window.

窗子.zh: 他把窗子擦得干干净净，亮得反光。
窗子.en: He cleaned the window so spotlessly that it reflected light.

母子.en: This mother and son have a good relationship.
The mother and son went shopping together.

母子.zh: 他们是一对母子，长得很像。
母子.en: They are a mother and son who look very alike.
Both mother and child are safe, and the baby is very healthy.

母子.zh: 虽然母子经常吵架，但心里都爱着对方。
母子.en: Although the mother and son often argue, they love each other deep down.

零钱.en: I don't have any change on me.

零钱.zh: 坐公交车需要准备零钱。
零钱.en: You need to prepare change for taking the bus.

零钱.zh: 他把零钱都放进存钱罐里了。
零钱.en: He put all the change into the piggy bank.

零钱.zh: 买东西时如果没零钱，可以用手机支付。
零钱.en: If you don't have change when buying something, you can use mobile payment.

理发.en: I'm going to get a haircut.

理发.zh: 我平时都去小区门口那家理发店，便宜又方便。
理发.en: I usually go to the barbershop at the entrance of the neighborhood; it's cheap and convenient.

语法.en: The grammar of this sentence is incorrect.

语法.zh: 学好语法对写作很有帮助。
语法.en: Learning grammar well is very helpful for writing.

语法.zh: 他语法掌握得不错，但口语还需要练习。
语法.en: He has a good grasp of grammar, but his spoken language still needs practice.

语法.zh: 别太纠结语法，先大胆开口说中文。
语法.en: Don't obsess too much over grammar; first, boldly start speaking Chinese.

便于.en: This makes it easier to manage.

便于.zh: 把文件放在一起便于查找。
便于.en: Putting documents together makes them easy to find.

便于.zh: 这个软件设计得很人性化，便于新手使用。
便于.en: This software is designed to be user-friendly, making it easy for beginners to use.

便于.zh: 为了方便联系，他写下了便于记忆的电话号码。
便于.en: To facilitate contact, he wrote down a phone number that is easy to remember.

安检.en: Come in after the security check.

安检.zh: 每次坐飞机都要过安检，很麻烦。
安检.en: Every time I fly, I have to go through security, which is annoying.

安检.zh: 地铁站的安检队伍排得很长。
安检.en: The security check line at the subway station is very long.

安检.zh: 安检的时候，工作人员让我打开箱子。
安检.en: During the security check, the staff asked me to open my suitcase.

安检.zh: 因为带了水，我过安检时被拦住了。
安检.en: I was stopped at security because I brought water.

月底.en: I need to pay rent at the end of the month.

月底.zh: 这个月底我们公司要开年会。
月底.en: Our company is having an annual meeting at the end of this month.
He gets very busy at the end of every month.

月底.zh: 月底之前记得把报告交上来。
月底.en: Remember to submit the report before the end of the month.

月底.zh: 工资一般会在月底发，所以我现在没钱。
月底.en: Salary is usually paid at the end of the month, so I have no money now.

白酒.en: Northerners often drink baijiu during the New Year.

白酒.zh: 这瓶白酒度数太高了，我喝不了。
白酒.en: This bottle of baijiu is too strong, I can't drink it.

白酒.zh: 聚会时他喝了两杯白酒就醉了。
白酒.en: He got drunk after two glasses of baijiu at the party.

白酒.zh: 虽然他爱喝白酒，但为了健康还是少喝点好。
白酒.en: Although he likes baijiu, he should drink less for his health.

景点.en: This scenic spot is very beautiful.

景点.zh: 国庆节期间景点人特别多。
景点.en: During National Day, the scenic spots are especially crowded.

景点.zh: 来北京一定要去故宫这个景点。
景点.en: When you come to Beijing, you must visit the Forbidden City scenic spot.

景点.zh: 我们选了三个景点，一天玩完。
景点.en: We picked three scenic spots and finished them in one day.

景点.zh: 夏天去海边景点玩，记得涂防晒霜。
景点.en: When visiting seaside scenic spots in summer, remember to apply sunscreen.

降价.zh: 双十一很多商品都会降价。
降价.en: Many items go on sale during Singles' Day.

降价.zh: 超市里的牛奶降价促销，我买了好几箱。
降价.en: The milk in the supermarket was on sale, so I bought several cartons.

降价.zh: 这件衣服原价五百，现在降价到三百。
降价.en: This clothes was originally 500, now it's reduced to 300.

降价.zh: 他们降价是为了吸引更多顾客。
降价.en: They lowered prices to attract more customers.

排球.zh: 我们学校排球队赢了比赛。
排球.en: Our school's volleyball team won the match.

排球.zh: 周末约了几个朋友去打排球。
排球.en: I made plans with a few friends to play volleyball this weekend.

排球.zh: 排球需要团队配合，一个人打不了。
排球.en: Volleyball requires teamwork; you can't play it alone.

排球.zh: 她个子高，打排球很有优势。
排球.en: She's tall, so she has an advantage in volleyball.

干杯.zh: 聚会结束时大家干杯庆祝。
干杯.en: Everyone cheered to celebrate at the end of the party.
Come on, cheers to our friendship!

干杯.zh: 他举起酒杯，大声说干杯。
干杯.en: He raised his glass and shouted 'cheers'.

干杯.zh: 虽然我不喝酒，但还是以茶代酒干杯。
干杯.en: Although I don't drink alcohol, I still cheers with tea instead.

通知书.zh: 我收到大学录取通知书了。
通知书.en: I received the university admission notice.

通知书.zh: 通知书上写着开学日期是九月一号。
通知书.en: The notice says the school start date is September 1st.

通知书.zh: 他等了两个月才等到通知书。
通知书.en: He waited two months for the notice.

通知书.zh: 拿到通知书那天，全家都很开心。
通知书.en: The whole family was very happy the day the notice arrived.

回信.en: Please reply as soon as possible.

回信.zh: 我给他写了回信，但还没寄。
回信.en: I wrote a reply to him, but haven't sent it yet.

回信.zh: 等收到他的回信我再做决定。
回信.en: I'll make a decision after I receive his reply.
She didn't reply, maybe she's too busy.

零下.zh: 北方冬天经常零下十几度。
零下.en: Northern winters often see temperatures of minus ten degrees.

零下.zh: 零下的时候出门一定要穿羽绒服。
零下.en: When it's below zero, you must wear a down jacket when going out.

零下.zh: 天气预报说明天零下八度，多穿点。
零下.en: The weather forecast says it will be minus eight degrees tomorrow, wear more clothes.

零下.zh: 虽然零下很冷，但滑雪特别好玩。
零下.en: Although it's freezing below zero, skiing is really fun.

摄氏度.zh: 今天气温38摄氏度，太热了。
摄氏度.en: Today's temperature is 38 degrees Celsius, it's too hot.

摄氏度.zh: 空调设到26摄氏度最舒服。
摄氏度.en: Setting the air conditioner to 26 degrees Celsius is the most comfortable.

摄氏度.zh: 医生说体温超过37.3摄氏度就要注意。
摄氏度.en: The doctor said if your body temperature exceeds 37.3 degrees Celsius, you need to be careful.

摄氏度.zh: 外面零下5摄氏度，记得多穿点。
摄氏度.en: It's minus 5 degrees Celsius outside, remember to wear more clothes.

摄氏度.zh: 我听说明天最高气温只有15摄氏度，要降温了。
摄氏度.en: I heard tomorrow's high is only 15 degrees Celsius, it's going to get colder.

复印.en: Please help me photocopy this document.

复印.zh: 你可以去楼下复印店复印身份证。
复印.en: You can go to the copy shop downstairs to photocopy your ID card.

复印.zh: 我复印了三份合同，一份给你。
复印.en: I photocopied three copies of the contract, one for you.

复印.zh: 因为打印机坏了，我没办法复印。
复印.en: Because the printer is broken, I can't make copies.

复印.zh: 他把护照复印了一份，留作备份。
复印.en: He made a photocopy of his passport and kept it as a backup.

中餐.zh: 我比较喜欢中餐，特别是川菜。
中餐.en: I prefer Chinese food, especially Sichuan cuisine.

中餐.zh: 在国外很难吃到正宗的中餐。
中餐.en: It's hard to get authentic Chinese food abroad.

中餐.zh: 虽然中餐很好吃，但有时候太油腻了。
中餐.en: Although Chinese food is delicious, sometimes it's too greasy.

中餐.zh: 这家餐厅的中餐做得特别地道，值得一试。
中餐.en: The Chinese food at this restaurant is really authentic, worth a try.

十字路口.zh: 在十字路口右转就到了。
十字路口.en: Turn right at the intersection and you'll be there.

十字路口.zh: 十字路口有很多车，要小心。
十字路口.en: There are many cars at the intersection, be careful.

十字路口.zh: 如果你看到十字路口，就停下来等红灯。
十字路口.en: If you see the intersection, stop and wait for the red light.

十字路口.zh: 那个十字路口没有红绿灯，每次过马路都很危险。
十字路口.en: That intersection has no traffic lights, it's dangerous every time you cross the street.

普通话.zh: 我的普通话不太好，还在学。
普通话.en: My Mandarin isn't very good, I'm still learning.

普通话.zh: 在中国，大家都说普通话。
虽然我是广东人，但我也能说标准的普通话。
普通话.en: Although I'm from Guangdong, I can still speak standard Mandarin.

普通话.zh: 学习普通话需要多听多说，还要注意声调。
普通话.en: Learning Mandarin requires listening and speaking a lot, and also paying attention to tones.

外交官.zh: 外交官的工作很有趣，但也很辛苦。
外交官.en: A diplomat's job is interesting but also very hard.

外交官.zh: 她爸爸是驻法国的外交官。
外交官.en: Her father is a diplomat stationed in France.

外交官.zh: 成为外交官需要懂好几门外语。
外交官.en: Becoming a diplomat requires knowing several foreign languages.

外交官.zh: 我表哥在北京当外交官，经常去世界各地出差。
外交官.en: My cousin works as a diplomat in Beijing and often travels around the world for work.

培训班.en: How much is this training class?

培训班.zh: 我报了一个英语培训班。
培训班.en: I signed up for an English training class.
There are a lot of training classes during summer vacation.

培训班.zh: 因为工作太忙，我没时间去培训班。
培训班.en: Because work is too busy, I don't have time for the training class.

培训班.zh: 这个培训班的老师很有经验，教得特别好。
培训班.en: The teachers in this training class are very experienced and teach really well.

打印机.en: The printer is out of paper.

打印机.zh: 你能帮我修一下打印机吗？
打印机.en: Can you help me fix the printer?
The newly bought printer works great.

打印机.zh: 我家的打印机坏了，得买一个新的。
打印机.en: My home printer is broken, I have to buy a new one.

打印机.zh: 办公室的打印机又出故障了，真烦人。
打印机.en: The office printer broke down again, so annoying.

国籍.zh: 他有两个国籍，中国和加拿大。
国籍.en: He has two nationalities, Chinese and Canadian.
I'm not sure about her nationality.

国籍.zh: 申请签证时需要填写国籍信息。
国籍.en: You need to fill in nationality information when applying for a visa.

国籍.zh: 虽然他在美国长大，但他的国籍还是中国。
国籍.en: Although he grew up in the US, his nationality is still Chinese.

自学.zh: 自学需要很强的自律性。
他自学了编程，现在找到了好工作。
自学.en: He self-studied programming and now has found a good job.

自学.zh: 如果你自学的话，可以省很多钱。
自学.en: If you self-study, you can save a lot of money.

自学.zh: 我自学了一年的英语，但口语还是不太好。
自学.en: I self-studied English for a year, but my spoken English is still not very good.

父女.en: The father and daughter have a very good relationship.

父女.zh: 虽然父女平时见面不多，但关系特别亲密。
父女.en: Although the father and daughter don't see each other often, their relationship is very close.

父女.zh: 这次旅行是父女一起去的。
父女.en: This trip was taken by the father and daughter together.

父女.zh: 父女俩在公园里散步，聊得很开心。
父女.en: The father and daughter were walking in the park, chatting happily.
They are a father and daughter.

汽水.en: I want to drink a bottle of soda.

汽水.zh: 天气太热了，我们去买两瓶汽水吧。
汽水.en: It's too hot, let's go buy two bottles of soda.

汽水.zh: 如果你不喝汽水，我就喝果汁。
汽水.en: If you don't drink soda, I'll drink juice.
Kids all like to drink soda.

汽水.zh: 吃饭的时候他总要配一瓶汽水。
汽水.en: He always has a bottle of soda with his meal.

馒头.en: I ate steamed buns for breakfast.

馒头.zh: 北方人喜欢吃馒头，南方人喜欢吃米饭。
馒头.en: Northerners like to eat steamed buns, southerners like to eat rice.

馒头.zh: 因为馒头很便宜，所以很多人买。
馒头.en: Because steamed buns are cheap, many people buy them.

馒头.zh: 妈妈蒸的馒头特别好吃。
馒头.en: The steamed buns my mom makes are especially delicious.

馒头.zh: 他一边吃馒头一边喝粥。
馒头.en: He eats steamed buns while drinking porridge.

充电器.zh: 你能借我一下充电器吗？
充电器.en: Can you lend me a charger?

充电器.zh: 我忘了带充电器，所以手机快没电了。
充电器.en: I forgot to bring my charger, so my phone is almost out of battery.
This charger is a fast charger.

充电器.zh: 旅行的时候一定要带上充电器。
充电器.en: When traveling, you must bring a charger.

车速.zh: 这个路段限速，车速不能超过六十。
车速.en: This section has a speed limit, the speed cannot exceed 60.

车速.zh: 为了安全，车速应该慢一点。
车速.en: For safety, the speed should be a bit slower.

车速.zh: 你觉得这辆车的车速怎么样？
车速.en: What do you think of this car's speed?

车速.zh: 高速上车速低于最低限制会被罚款。
车速.en: Driving under the minimum speed on the highway will get a fine.

红包.en: During Chinese New Year, we give red envelopes.

红包.zh: 他给孩子包了一个大红包。
红包.en: He gave the child a big red envelope.

红包.zh: 虽然红包不大，但是心意到了。
红包.en: Although the red envelope is not big, the intention is there.
WeChat red envelopes are very convenient.

红包.zh: 结婚的时候亲友都会送红包。
红包.en: During weddings, relatives and friends give red envelopes.

师生.zh: 学校里师生之间应该互相尊重。
师生.en: In school, teachers and students should respect each other.
Not just teacher-student, but also friends.

师生.zh: 这次活动是师生一起参加的。
师生.en: This activity was attended by teachers and students together.

师生.zh: 师生们都在为期末考试做准备。
师生.en: Both teachers and students are preparing for the final exam.

后头.zh: 房子后头有一个小花园。
后头.en: There is a small garden behind the house.
You go first, I'll come later.
The road behind is not easy to walk.

后头.zh: 这件事后头可能还有别的问题。
后头.en: There might be other problems later regarding this matter.

游玩.en: We go to the park to play.

游玩.zh: 周末带孩子去海边游玩。
游玩.en: Take the kids to the beach to play on the weekend.

游玩.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去景点游玩。
游玩.en: If the weather is good, we'll go sightseeing at the scenic spot.

游玩.zh: 游玩的时候要注意安全。
游玩.en: Be careful about safety when playing.

游玩.zh: 这次游玩大家都很开心。
游玩.en: Everyone had a great time on this outing.

本科.en: He is studying for an undergraduate degree.

本科.zh: 本科毕业后他想继续读研究生。
本科.en: After graduating from undergraduate, he wants to continue to graduate school.

本科.zh: 虽然本科专业是计算机，但他现在做销售。
本科.en: Although his undergraduate major was computer science, he now works in sales.

本科.zh: 本科和专科的区别是什么？
本科.en: What is the difference between undergraduate and associate degree?

本科.zh: 很多公司招聘要求本科以上学历。
本科.en: Many companies require a bachelor's degree or above for recruitment.

流利.zh: 虽然他只学了两年中文，但是已经说得非常流利了。
流利.en: Although he has only studied Chinese for two years, he already speaks it very fluently.

流利.zh: 面试的时候，他流利地用英语回答了所有问题。
流利.en: During the interview, he answered all the questions fluently in English.

流利.zh: 我希望能像你一样流利地讲法语。
流利.en: I hope I can speak French as fluently as you do.

前头.en: The shop up ahead is very tasty.

前头.zh: 你往前走，前头第三个路口右转就到了。
前头.en: Go straight ahead, turn right at the third intersection in front, and you'll be there.

前头.zh: 因为前头堵车，我们迟到了。
前头.en: We were late because there was a traffic jam up ahead.
There is someone waiting for you up ahead.

前头.zh: 坐车的时候别坐前头，后头更安全。
前头.en: Don't sit in the front of the car; the back is safer.

坏处.zh: 虽然手机很方便，但坏处也不少，比如伤眼睛。
坏处.en: Although phones are very convenient, they also have many downsides, like hurting your eyes.

坏处.zh: 如果你只看到好处，看不到坏处，可能会后悔。
坏处.en: If you only see the advantages and not the disadvantages, you might regret it.
Do you know the downsides of staying up late?

坏处.zh: 买便宜货的坏处是质量一般不太好。
坏处.en: The downside of buying cheap stuff is that the quality is usually not great.

试题.en: Today's exam questions are very hard.

试题.zh: 老师把去年的试题发给我们做练习。
试题.en: The teacher gave us last year's exam questions for practice.

试题.zh: 因为时间不够，最后几道试题我没做完。
试题.en: Because I ran out of time, I didn't finish the last few exam questions.
This exam paper has fifty questions.

试题.zh: 你复习的时候，可以多看看以前考过的试题。
试题.en: When you review, you can look at past exam questions more.

结账.zh: 吃完饭别急着走，我先去结账。
结账.en: Don't rush off after the meal; let me go pay the bill first.

结账.zh: 因为人很多，等了好久才轮到我们结账。
结账.en: Because there were many people, we waited a long time before it was our turn to pay.
Excuse me, where do I pay?

结账.zh: 今天这顿饭我来请，你不用管结账的事。
结账.en: I'm treating today's meal, so you don't need to worry about paying.

期中.zh: 这学期期中成绩占总分的百分之三十。
期中.en: This semester, the midterm grade counts for 30% of the total score.

期中.zh: 虽然期中没考好，但期末还有机会。
期中.en: Although I didn't do well on the midterm, there's still a chance in the final.

期中.zh: 你期中复习得怎么样了？
期中.en: How is your midterm review going?

期中.zh: 老师说明天公布期中考试的成绩。
期中.en: The teacher said the midterm exam results will be announced tomorrow.

网址.en: This website address can't be opened.

网址.zh: 你把网址发给我，我马上点进去看看。
网址.en: Send me the website address, and I'll click on it right away to take a look.

网址.zh: 如果你忘了网址，可以上网搜一下。
网址.en: If you forget the website address, you can search for it online.
What is the correct website address?

网址.zh: 我收藏了一个很有用的学习网址，分享给你。
网址.en: I bookmarked a very useful learning website address and I'll share it with you.

千克.en: I bought two kilograms of apples.

千克.zh: 这个行李箱重量不能超过二十千克。
千克.en: This suitcase's weight cannot exceed twenty kilograms.

千克.zh: 因为限重，我托运的行李只有十五千克。
千克.en: Because of the weight limit, my checked baggage is only fifteen kilograms.
How many jin is one kilogram equal to?

千克.zh: 健身教练建议我每天摄入不超过一点五千克的食物。
千克.en: My fitness trainer suggested I consume no more than 1.5 kilograms of food per day.

节假日.zh: 节假日我一般在家休息。
节假日.en: On holidays, I usually rest at home.

节假日.zh: 国庆节和春节是最重要的节假日。
节假日.en: National Day and Spring Festival are the most important holidays.

节假日.zh: 虽然节假日人很多，但我还是喜欢出去旅游。
节假日.en: Although there are many people during holidays, I still like to travel.
Stores are very busy during the holidays.

节假日.zh: 公司规定节假日加班可以拿三倍工资。
节假日.en: Company policy says you can get triple pay for working overtime on holidays.

叫作.en: This dish is called Kung Pao Chicken.

叫作.zh: 有一种很甜的蛋糕叫作提拉米苏。
叫作.en: There is a very sweet cake called Tiramisu.

叫作.zh: 我以前养过一只猫，它叫作小白。
叫作.en: I used to have a cat, and it was called Xiao Bai.

叫作.zh: 这个地方叫作丽江，风景特别美。
叫作.en: This place is called Lijiang, and the scenery is especially beautiful.

举例.en: Give an example and talk about it.

举例.zh: 这个问题很难，你能举例说明一下吗？
举例.en: This question is hard, can you illustrate it with an example?

举例.zh: 举例来说，这个方案不可行。
举例.en: For example, this plan is not feasible.
The teacher asked us to give examples.

举例.zh: 举例能帮助理解复杂的概念。
举例.en: Giving examples can help understand complex concepts.

零花钱.en: My pocket money is not enough.

零花钱.zh: 每个月妈妈给我两百块零花钱。
零花钱.en: Mom gives me 200 yuan pocket money every month.

零花钱.zh: 因为乱花零花钱，这个月我很快就没钱了。
零花钱.en: Because I spent pocket money recklessly, I quickly ran out of money this month.
How do you usually use your pocket money?

零花钱.zh: 他把零花钱都存起来买游戏了。
零花钱.en: He saved up all his pocket money to buy a game.

多样.zh: 这个商场的东西种类很多样，什么都有。
多样.en: The items in this mall are very diverse in type; they have everything.

多样.zh: 虽然大家观点多样，但最终还是达成了共识。
多样.en: Although everyone's views were diverse, they eventually reached a consensus.

多样.zh: 这个公司的产品设计很多样，满足了不同的需求。
多样.en: This company's product designs are diverse, meeting different needs.

售货员.en: The sales assistant is very enthusiastic.

售货员.zh: 我问售货员这件衣服有没有大号。
售货员.en: I asked the sales assistant if this clothes has a larger size.

售货员.zh: 因为售货员态度不好，我换了一家店。
售货员.en: Because the sales assistant had a bad attitude, I switched to another store.

售货员.zh: 这个售货员看起来有点累。
售货员.en: This sales assistant looks a bit tired.

售货员.zh: 那个售货员给我推荐了好几款手机。
售货员.en: That sales assistant recommended several mobile phones to me.

长江.zh: 长江是中国最长的河流。
长江.en: The Yangtze River is the longest river in China.

长江.zh: 虽然我没去过长江，但我看过很多照片。
长江.en: Although I haven't been to the Yangtze River, I've seen many photos.

长江.zh: 长江两岸的风景非常漂亮。
长江.en: The scenery on both sides of the Yangtze River is very beautiful.

长江.zh: 坐船游览长江是一次难忘的体验。
长江.en: Taking a boat trip along the Yangtze River is an unforgettable experience.

电灯.zh: 睡觉之前记得关掉电灯。
电灯.en: Remember to turn off the electric light before sleeping.

电灯.zh: 因为电灯太亮，我有点睡不着。
电灯.en: Because the electric light is too bright, I can't fall asleep.
The electric light in this room is LED.

电灯.zh: 他打开电灯，房间一下子亮了起来。
电灯.en: He turned on the electric light, and the room suddenly lit up.

口语.en: My spoken language is not very good.

口语.zh: 要提高口语水平，多说多练是关键。
口语.en: To improve oral proficiency, speaking and practicing more is key.

口语.zh: 虽然我笔试成绩不错，但口语还需要加强。
口语.en: Although my written exam score is good, my spoken language still needs improvement.
The oral exam is scheduled on Friday.

口语.zh: 她每天花一小时练习英语口语。
口语.en: She spends an hour every day practicing English oral skills.

寒假.zh: 今年寒假我打算去滑雪。
寒假.en: This winter vacation I plan to go skiing.

寒假.zh: 因为寒假很短，所以我没安排长途旅行。
寒假.en: Because winter vacation is very short, I didn't plan a long trip.
Have you finished your winter vacation homework?

寒假.zh: 他寒假在家看了好几本小说。
寒假.en: He read several novels at home during winter vacation.

矮小.en: He is short and small in stature.

矮小.zh: 虽然她身材矮小，但力气很大。
矮小.en: Although she is petite, she is very strong.

矮小.zh: 这棵矮小的树是我种的。
矮小.en: This short little tree was planted by me.

矮小.zh: 因为自己个子矮小，他常常被人忽视。
矮小.en: Because he is short, he is often overlooked.

矮小.zh: 那只矮小的狗跑得特别快。
矮小.en: That short little dog runs very fast.

差点儿.zh: 因为路上堵车，我差点儿没赶上飞机。
差点儿.en: Because of traffic jam, I almost missed the plane.

差点儿.zh: 这次考试很难，我差点儿不及格。
差点儿.en: This exam was very hard, I almost failed.

粗心.zh: 你太粗心了，钥匙又忘带了。
粗心.en: You're too careless, you forgot your keys again.

粗心.zh: 他因为粗心算错了账，被老板批评了。
粗心.en: He miscalculated the account because of carelessness and was criticized by the boss.

粗心.zh: 考试时粗心很容易丢分，你要仔细一点。
粗心.en: Being careless during exams easily loses points, you need to be more careful.

粗心.zh: 虽然他很聪明，但是做事总是很粗心。
粗心.en: Although he is very smart, he is always careless when doing things.

粗心.zh: 我发错了邮件，真是粗心大意。
粗心.en: I sent the wrong email, that was really careless and inattentive.

刷子.zh: 这把刷子太硬了，不适合刷墙。
刷子.en: This brush is too hard, not suitable for painting the wall.

刷子.zh: 他用刷子把鞋上的泥刷干净了。
刷子.en: He used a brush to clean the mud off his shoes.

刷子.zh: 画画的时候，不同的刷子效果不一样。
刷子.en: When painting, different brushes have different effects.

刷子.zh: 我买了一把新刷子，准备给阳台刷漆。
刷子.en: I bought a new brush and plan to paint the balcony.

刷子.zh: 厨房的刷子该换了，上面都有细菌了。
刷子.en: The kitchen brush needs to be replaced, it has bacteria on it.

报考.zh: 明年我打算报考北京大学。
报考.en: Next year I plan to apply to Peking University.

报考.zh: 他报考了三个学校，最后被第二个录取了。
报考.en: He applied to three schools and was finally admitted to the second one.

报考.zh: 如果你要报考研究生，现在就该准备材料了。
报考.en: If you want to apply for graduate school, you should start preparing materials now.

报考.zh: 她犹豫了很久，最后还是决定报考艺术系。
报考.en: She hesitated for a long time, but finally decided to apply to the art department.

报考.zh: 很多人都报考了那个热门专业，竞争非常激烈。
报考.en: Many people applied to that popular major, the competition is very fierce.

亚运会.zh: 今年亚运会在杭州举办。
亚运会.en: This year's Asian Games are held in Hangzhou.

亚运会.zh: 他为了看亚运会，特意请了三天假。
亚运会.en: He took three days off specifically to watch the Asian Games.

亚运会.zh: 亚运会的门票很难买，我排了好久的队。
亚运会.en: The tickets for the Asian Games were hard to get; I waited in line for a long time.

亚运会.zh: 虽然亚运会结束了，但大家对体育的热情还在。
亚运会.en: Although the Asian Games are over, people's passion for sports remains.

亚运会.zh: 我朋友是志愿者，他在亚运会期间负责接待外国运动员。
亚运会.en: My friend is a volunteer; he was responsible for receiving foreign athletes during the Asian Games.

起到.zh: 这个药能起到止痛的作用。
起到.en: This medicine can play a role in relieving pain.

起到.zh: 你的鼓励对我起到了很大的帮助。
起到.en: Your encouragement has been a great help to me.

起到.zh: 新政策起到了稳定房价的效果。
起到.en: The new policy has had the effect of stabilizing housing prices.

起到.zh: 虽然只是简单的一句话，却起到了意想不到的作用。
起到.en: Although it was just a simple sentence, it had an unexpected effect.

起到.zh: 在团队里，每个人都能起到自己的作用。
起到.en: In a team, everyone can play their own role.

笔试.zh: 这次笔试很难，我差点没做完。
笔试.en: This written exam was very hard; I almost didn't finish it.

笔试.zh: 面试之前要先通过笔试。
笔试.en: You have to pass the written exam before the interview.

笔试.zh: 他的笔试成绩很高，但面试表现一般。
笔试.en: His written exam score was very high, but his interview performance was average.

笔试.zh: 明天的笔试考两个小时，记得带好准考证。
笔试.en: Tomorrow's written exam lasts two hours, remember to bring your admission ticket.

笔试.zh: 我准备了很久，希望这次笔试能通过。
笔试.en: I've prepared for a long time, hoping to pass this written exam.

电动车.en: I ride an electric bike to work every day.

电动车.zh: 电动车的电池越来越不耐用了。
电动车.en: The battery of the electric bike is getting less durable.

电动车.zh: 最近电动车出了新规定，上路要戴头盔。
电动车.en: There's a new regulation for electric bikes recently; you have to wear a helmet on the road.

电动车.zh: 他把电动车停在楼下，结果被偷了。
电动车.en: He parked his electric bike downstairs, and it got stolen.

电动车.zh: 虽然电动车很方便，但充电还是有点麻烦。
电动车.en: Although electric bikes are very convenient, charging them is still a bit troublesome.

考生.zh: 今年考生人数比去年多了不少。
考生.en: The number of test takers this year has increased a lot compared to last year.

考生.zh: 考生们都在紧张地等待成绩公布。
考生.en: The test takers are all nervously waiting for the results to be announced.

考生.zh: 考场门口站满了送考生的家长。
考生.en: The entrance of the exam hall is full of parents seeing off test takers.

考生.zh: 有些考生提前半小时就交卷了。
考生.en: Some test takers handed in their papers half an hour early.

考生.zh: 监考老师提醒考生把手机放在外面。
考生.en: The proctor reminded the test takers to put their phones outside.

景区.zh: 这个景区风景很美，值得一去。
景区.en: This scenic area is very beautiful and worth a visit.

景区.zh: 国庆节期间景区人太多了，到处排队。
景区.en: During the National Day holiday, the scenic area was too crowded, with lines everywhere.

景区.zh: 很多景区都推出了优惠政策吸引游客。
景区.en: Many scenic areas have introduced preferential policies to attract tourists.

景区.zh: 我们去的那个景区门票太贵了，性价比不高。
景区.en: The tickets for the scenic area we went to were too expensive, not good value for money.

景区.zh: 为了保护环境，景区禁止游客乱扔垃圾。
景区.en: To protect the environment, the scenic area prohibits tourists from littering.

隔开.zh: 这两张桌子要隔开一点。
隔开.en: These two tables need to be spaced apart a bit.

隔开.zh: 他用了块木板把房间隔开了。
隔开.en: He used a wooden board to partition the room.

隔开.zh: 疫情期间，人们被要求隔开一米距离。
隔开.en: During the pandemic, people were required to keep a one-meter distance apart.

隔开.zh: 虽然我们被隔开了，但心还是连在一起的。
隔开.en: Although we are separated, our hearts are still connected.

隔开.zh: 这道墙把两个院子隔开了，但声音还是能传过来。
隔开.en: This wall separates the two courtyards, but the sound can still travel through.

网友.en: I made an appointment to meet my internet friend.

网友.zh: 虽然我们是网友，但聊得特别好。
网友.en: Although we are internet friends, we chat very well.
I have an internet friend who is British.

网友.zh: 网友之间也要注意安全。
网友.en: Even among internet friends, you need to be careful about safety.

网友.zh: 她跟网友一起打游戏，玩得很开心。
网友.en: She plays games with her internet friend and has a lot of fun.

抄写.en: The teacher asked us to copy the text.

抄写.zh: 他一边抄写一边记单词，效率很高。
抄写.en: He copies and memorizes words at the same time, which is very efficient.

抄写.zh: 这份合同需要抄写一份留底。
抄写.en: This contract needs to be copied for record-keeping.
Don't be lazy, hurry up and copy it.

抄写.zh: 因为字太潦草，我只好重新抄写一遍。
抄写.en: Because the handwriting was too messy, I had to copy it again.

月饼.en: We eat mooncakes on Mid-Autumn Festival.

月饼.zh: 今年我们买了蛋黄月饼和五仁月饼。
月饼.en: This year we bought egg yolk mooncakes and five-nut mooncakes.

月饼.zh: 虽然月饼好吃，但别吃太多。
月饼.en: Although mooncakes are delicious, don't eat too many.

月饼.zh: 朋友送了我一盒冰皮月饼。
月饼.en: A friend gave me a box of snow skin mooncakes.

预习.en: I need to preview the text tomorrow.

预习.zh: 如果提前预习，上课会轻松很多。
预习.en: If you preview in advance, class will be much easier.

预习.zh: 做完作业以后，别忘了预习明天的内容。
预习.en: After finishing homework, don't forget to preview tomorrow's lesson.

预习.zh: 我习惯晚上预习第二天的新课。
预习.en: I'm used to previewing the next day's new lesson in the evening.

京剧.en: My grandpa loves watching Peking opera.

京剧.zh: 虽然京剧是国粹，但年轻人不太了解。
京剧.en: Although Peking opera is a national treasure, young people don't know much about it.

京剧.zh: 周末我们去剧院看了一场京剧表演。
京剧.en: On the weekend we went to the theater to watch a Peking opera performance.
Peking opera facial masks are very beautiful.

京剧.zh: 她学了三年的京剧，唱得非常好。
京剧.en: She has studied Peking opera for three years and sings very well.

纯净水.en: Give me a bottle of purified water.

纯净水.zh: 外出时我一般都带一壶纯净水。
纯净水.en: When I go out, I usually bring a jug of purified water.

纯净水.zh: 虽然自来水也能喝，但我更爱喝纯净水。
纯净水.en: Although tap water is drinkable, I prefer purified water.

纯净水.zh: 这家公司专门生产纯净水。
纯净水.en: This company specializes in producing purified water.

干活儿.zh: 今天天气太热，干活儿的时候记得多喝水。
干活儿.en: It's too hot today; remember to drink more water while working.

干活儿.zh: 既然拿了钱，就得好好干活儿。
干活儿.en: Since you're getting paid, you should work well.

干活儿.zh: 我爸在工地干活儿，很辛苦。
干活儿.en: My dad works on a construction site; it's very tough.
Don't just stand there, come and work.

分之.zh: 百分之三十的人同意这个方案。
分之.en: Thirty percent of people agree with this plan.

分之.zh: 虽然只有百分之一的机会，但我还想试试。
分之.en: Although there's only a one percent chance, I still want to try.

分之.zh: 他花了五分之二的钱买书。
分之.en: He spent two-fifths of his money on books.

分之.zh: 十分之九的学生及格了。

填空.en: This fill-in-the-blank question requires filling in the blank.

填空.zh: 考试的时候，填空题一定要仔细读题。
填空.en: During the exam, you must read the questions carefully for fill-in-the-blank items.

填空.zh: 先做选择题，再做填空，时间比较合理。
填空.en: Do the multiple-choice questions first, then the fill-in-the-blanks; it's a better use of time.

填空.zh: 老师让我们在空格里填空。
填空.en: The teacher asked us to fill in the blanks.
Fill-in-the-blank questions are easier than short-answer questions.

学时.en: This course has thirty class hours.

学时.zh: 每个学期需要修满规定的学时才能毕业。
学时.en: Each semester you need to complete the required class hours to graduate.

学时.zh: 虽然学时不多，但内容很丰富。
学时.en: Although the class hours are not many, the content is very rich.

学时.zh: 钢琴课一个学时收费两百。
学时.en: Piano lessons cost two hundred per class hour.
How many class hours have you taken in total?

短信.en: I sent you a text message.
Did you receive my text message?

短信.zh: 他昨天给我发了三条短信，但我没回。
短信.en: He sent me three text messages yesterday, but I didn't reply.

短信.zh: 因为手机没电了，所以她的短信我没看到。
短信.en: Because my phone was dead, I didn't see her text message.

短信.zh: 等会儿我再给你发短信告诉你地址。
短信.en: I'll text you the address later.

放暑假.en: We have summer vacation in July.
Where do you want to go during summer vacation?

放暑假.zh: 放暑假以后，我要去外婆家住两周。
放暑假.en: After summer vacation starts, I'm going to stay at my grandma's for two weeks.

放暑假.zh: 虽然放暑假了，但他每天还在学习。
放暑假.en: Although summer vacation has started, he still studies every day.

放暑假.zh: 放暑假的时候，我打算找一份兼职工作。
放暑假.en: During summer vacation, I plan to find a part-time job.

没想到.zh: 没想到会在这里遇到你。
没想到.en: I didn't expect to meet you here.

没想到.zh: 他居然赢了比赛，真没想到。
没想到.en: He actually won the game, I really didn't expect that.

没想到.zh: 没想到今天会下雨，我没带伞。
没想到.en: I didn't expect it to rain today, so I didn't bring an umbrella.

没想到.zh: 原本以为很难，没想到做起来这么简单。
没想到.en: I thought it would be hard, but I didn't expect it to be so easy.

没想到.zh: 没想到她这么快就学会了开车，真厉害。
没想到.en: I didn't expect her to learn to drive so quickly, amazing.

名牌儿.en: This bag is a famous brand.

名牌儿.zh: 她喜欢买名牌儿的衣服。
名牌儿.en: She likes to buy designer clothes.

名牌儿.zh: 这件名牌儿外套太贵了，我买不起。
名牌儿.en: This branded coat is too expensive, I can't afford it.

名牌儿.zh: 虽然不是什么名牌儿，但质量很好。
名牌儿.en: Although it's not a famous brand, the quality is good.

名牌儿.zh: 他总爱炫耀自己的名牌儿手表。
名牌儿.en: He always likes to show off his luxury watch.

微信.zh: 我用微信和妈妈视频聊天。
微信.en: I use WeChat to video chat with my mom.

微信.zh: 你把那张照片发到微信群里吧。
微信.en: Send that photo to the WeChat group.

微信.zh: 因为微信很方便，所以大家现在很少发短信了。
微信.en: Because WeChat is very convenient, people rarely send text messages now.

微信.zh: 我的微信钱包里还有五十块钱。
微信.en: I still have fifty yuan in my WeChat wallet.

下个月.en: I'm going to Beijing next month.

下个月.zh: 下个月开始，房租要涨了。
下个月.en: Starting next month, the rent will increase.

下个月.zh: 考试在下个月十号，你要抓紧准备。
下个月.en: The exam is on the tenth of next month, so you need to prepare quickly.

下个月.zh: 如果能请假的话，下个月我想出去旅游。
下个月.en: If I can take leave, I want to travel next month.

下个月.zh: 下个月是我生日，你打算送我什么礼物？
下个月.en: Next month is my birthday, what gift do you plan to give me?

有劲儿.zh: 睡了一觉后，我觉得浑身有劲儿。
有劲儿.en: After sleeping, I feel full of energy all over.
